title: Female Appointment Setter / Virtual Assistant — Base Pay + Recurring Commissions
description:
# Appointment Setter / Virtual Assistant (Philippines) — Base Pay + Recurring Commissions



## About the Role



We're looking for a skilled, motivated, and tech-savvy Filipino Virtual Assistant to join our growing marketing agency as an Appointment Setter.



You'll work with U.S.-based medical spas and aesthetics businesses, following up with leads generated through
 and Instagram ads, booking appointments, collecting appointment deposits, and managing daily CRM activities.



This is a long-term opportunity with **guaranteed weekly base pay, recurring monthly commissions, and additional performance-based earning potential.**



## Compensation & Earning Potential



**Training Period:**

- $115 for your first week of paid training.



**After Training:**

- $150 per week guaranteed base pay.

- **15% recurring monthly commission** on each client subscription assigned to you.

- Each client subscription is $897/month, meaning **you earn $134.55 per month for every client account you manage.**

- Additional commission on every appointment deposit collected through your lead follow-up efforts.

- You'll be responsible for managing up to 5 client accounts.



**Here's What Your Monthly Earnings Could Look Like:**



- **1 client:** $134.55/month in subscription commissions

- **3 clients:** $403.65/month in subscription commissions

- **5 clients:** $672.75/month in subscription commissions



With all 5 client accounts assigned, your potential monthly earnings would be approximately **$1,322.75 ($650 average monthly base pay + $672.75 in recurring commissions)**, PLUS additional commissions from appointment deposits collected.



Your earnings grow as you take on additional client accounts and generate results.



## Key Responsibilities



- Promptly follow up with new leads generated through
 and Instagram advertising.

- Call, text, qualify, and convert leads into booked appointments.

- Follow up with unresponsive leads and missed appointments.

- Secure appointment deposits and ensure bookings are properly confirmed.

- Manage appointment scheduling, lead pipelines, and contact records inside HighLevel CRM.

- Handle basic CRM tasks, including updating contact information, managing opportunities, and maintaining accurate records.

- Manage appointment setting, lead follow-up, and basic CRM responsibilities for up to 5 client accounts simultaneously.

- Complete additional administrative tasks during slower periods.



## Requirements



- Female applicants only.

- Fluent English with excellent spoken communication and phone etiquette.

- Previous experience in phone-based appointment setting, sales, or lead conversion.

- Comfortable making outbound calls and handling objections.

- Experience using CRM software (HighLevel / GoHighLevel experience is a major plus).

- Highly tech-savvy, organized, and able to learn new systems quickly.

- Ability to manage multiple client accounts without sacrificing responsiveness or quality.

- Reliable internet connection and a quiet environment for making calls.

- Self-motivated, dependable, and comfortable working independently.

- Available to work during U.S. business hours.



## What We Offer



- Guaranteed weekly base pay after training.

- Recurring monthly commissions based on assigned client subscriptions.

- Additional commissions for appointment deposits collected.

- Paid training and clear operating procedures.

- Established lead-generation systems with a consistent flow of new leads.

- Long-term, stable work with opportunities to increase your earnings.

- The opportunity to work with a growing U.S.-based agency specializing in medical spa marketing and AI-powered appointment booking.



## How to Apply



Please include the following in your application:



1. A brief introduction about yourself and your relevant experience.

2. Your experience with appointment setting, outbound calling, and CRM software.

3. Whether you've previously used HighLevel / GoHighLevel.

4. A short voice recording introducing yourself so we can evaluate your spoken English and communication skills.



**We're looking for someone who can take ownership of their assigned accounts, follow up consistently, and turn leads into confirmed, deposit-secured appointments.**



If you're organized, confident on the phone, and motivated by performance-based earnings, we'd like to hear from you.

title: Video Editor & Social Media Content Creator (Reels, YouTube, Instagram)
description:
Hours: Flexible, with 2–3 hours of overlap with California time (PST) for check-ins



About us



We’re a home remodeling and home building company in California. Our videographer films job sites, before-and-afters, client walkthroughs and behind-the-scenes content. We’re looking for a creative editor who will turn that raw footage into scroll-stopping content for Instagram, YouTube, our website and other platforms.



You’ll be the person who turns our footage into content. Our videographer shoots and you do everything after that.



What you’ll do

Organize footage: Sort, label and file raw footage in our cloud storage (Google Drive/Dropbox) so any clip can be found quickly.

Edit short-form video: Create Reels, TikToks and YouTube Shorts with hooks, captions, music, transitions and pacing that keep people watching.

Edit long-form video: Produce YouTube videos such as project tours, before-and-afters and process videos, plus videos for our website.

Repurpose old footage: Dig through our archive of past projects and find new angles, compilations and trends to make fresh content from it.

Create posts: Make carousels, graphics, thumbnails and captions with hashtags for multiple Instagram accounts and other platforms.

Prepare content for approval: Upload finished content to our scheduling tool for approval, and keep a steady content calendar going.

Follow trends: Keep up with trending audio, formats and ideas in the home and remodeling space, and pitch new content ideas.



Requirements

At least 2 years of video editing experience, with a portfolio of short-form content (Reels, TikTok or Shorts) you edited yourself

Strong skills in Premiere Pro, CapCut, DaVinci Resolve or Final Cut

Experience with Canva or Photoshop for graphics and thumbnails

A strong creative eye: you know what makes someone stop scrolling

Good organization skills, since you’ll manage a large library of footage

Good written English for captions

A reliable computer that can handle 4K footage, plus a stable internet connection, because the files are large

Ability to work independently and meet a regular posting schedule



Nice to have



Experience with construction, home improvement, real estate or interior design content

Motion graphics experience (After Effects)

Experience with scheduling tools like Later, Planoly, Buffer or Metricool

Experience managing multiple brand accounts



How to apply

Start your application with the words “BEFORE AND AFTER” so we know you read the full post.



Send links to 3–5 short-form videos you edited, plus one YouTube video if you have one.

Tell us which editing software you use and what computer setup you have.

Briefly tell us about a reel you made that performed well, and why you think it worked.



Shortlisted applicants will do a short paid test edit using our real footage.

title: IT MSP Level 1/2 Technician
description:
JOB OVERVIEW



We are hiring a full-time, experienced technical support professional to support our U.S.-based customers across managed IT, cloud services, business communications, VoIP, and emerging AI technologies.



This is not an entry-level help desk position. We are specifically looking for an experienced technician who already has a strong foundation in computers, Windows, Microsoft 365, networking, troubleshooting, and customer support. Experience with business telecommunications, VoIP, SIP, cloud PBX systems, or related communications technologies is especially valuable.



We are offering compensation at the experienced/expert level because we want someone who knows how to troubleshoot problems, think independently, communicate professionally with customers, and take ownership of issues through resolution.



Our company has nearly 30 years of experience in managed IT and cloud services. MSP support remains an important part of our business, but the next generation of the company is increasingly focused on Cloudspire Voice and Cloudspire AI. The person joining our technical team will work across both sides of the business.



### Must Have (intermediate to advanced)



- Microsoft 365 administration: users, licenses, mailboxes, shared mailboxes, MFA, and Exchange Online basics

- Networking: IP addressing and subnets, DNS, DHCP, routing basics, VPNs, and firewalls

- Diagnosing connectivity and call quality issues such as packet loss, latency, and jitter, and knowing how to test for them

- At least 2 years in a hands-on Level 1/Level 2 support role, ideally at an MSP



### Primary Responsibilities



- Provide Level 1 and Level 2 help desk and technical support

- Troubleshoot Windows desktops, applications, connectivity, printers, email, and general end-user issues

- Administer and troubleshoot Microsoft 365 environments

- Use our RMM platform (NinjaOne) for endpoint monitoring, management, remote access, patching, and support

- Work with our endpoint security platform (SentinelOne), including reviewing alerts and assisting with threat mitigation

- Prior NinjaOne or SentinelOne experience is a plus but not required; we will train you

- Troubleshoot networking issues involving TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP, VPNs, routers, firewalls, Wi-Fi, and general connectivity

- Work extensively within our ticketing system while following documented procedures, priorities, escalation requirements, and service standards

- Document troubleshooting, changes, customer communications, and resolutions thoroughly and accurately



### VoIP & Cloud Communications



Telecommunications is an increasingly important part of this position. You will support our Cloudspire Voice platform and work with business-class VoIP systems, including:



- VoIP and SIP troubleshooting

- Cloud PBX administration

- Phone provisioning and configuration

- Extensions, users, hunt groups, auto attendants, call queues, and call routing

- Troubleshooting call quality, registration, connectivity, and signaling issues

- Number provisioning and related telecom support

- Supporting physical phones, softphones, and mobile applications

- Working directly with customers to diagnose and resolve communications problems



Strong prior VoIP, SIP, PBX, UCaaS, or telecommunications experience will be highly valued.



### AI & Emerging Technology



Cloudspire AI is one of the fastest-growing areas of our business. Prior AI experience is **not required**, but it is a significant advantage.



The technician will have an opportunity to learn and work with:



- AI voice agents

- AI-powered customer service and communications

- Agent prompting and configuration

- Call flows and automation

- API integrations

- Troubleshooting AI conversations and behaviors

- Connecting AI agents with business systems and communications platforms



We are looking for someone who is interested in learning these technologies rather than someone who wants to remain exclusively in traditional desktop support.



### Customer Service & Communication



Customer satisfaction is extremely important to us.



You will communicate directly with U.S.-based customers by telephone, email, tickets, and remote support sessions throughout the workday. You must be professional, patient, courteous, and confident speaking with customers.



*** Excellent spoken and written English is required. ***



Attention to detail is also critical. Tickets must be documented correctly, instructions must be followed carefully, configurations must be verified, and customer requests must be completed accurately.



### Additional Skills That Can Create Opportunity



We are a small technology company, so people who bring skills beyond their primary role can have opportunities to contribute in other areas.



Experience or interest in any of the following would be considered a significant bonus:



- Technology sales or pre-sales

- Conducting product demonstrations

- Customer relationship management

- Business development

- Lead generation

- Digital marketing

- Social media or LinkedIn outreach

- Helping identify additional services that would benefit an existing customer



These skills are **not requirements for the position**. Technical ability and customer support come first. However, someone who combines strong technical knowledge with communication, business, or sales ability could become especially valuable as the company grows.



### The Person We Are Looking For



We want an experienced technician who can investigate a problem rather than immediately escalate it.



The right person should be comfortable moving between a Windows computer problem, a Microsoft 365 issue, a network problem, a VoIP call-routing issue, and a Cloudspire configuration during the same day.



You should be:



- Technically experienced and naturally curious

- Strong at troubleshooting and problem solving

- Comfortable working independently

- Extremely attentive to detail

- Organized with tickets and documentation

- Dependable and consistent

- Professional with customers

- Interested in VoIP, communications, cloud technology, and AI

- Willing to continue learning as our products and technology evolve



We are looking for someone who wants a stable, long-term position and who can become an important member of our technical team.



### Schedule



This is a full-time, fully remote position supporting U.S.-based customers.



**Monday through Friday**

**8:00 AM to 5:00 PM U.S. Eastern Time**



Reliable attendance and availability during these hours are essential.



### How to Apply (voice recording required)



Applications without a voice recording will not be reviewed.



Record a 1 to 2 minute voice recording of yourself speaking to a customer as if you were on the phone: their whole office lost phone service 20 minutes ago, they're upset, and their clients are calling them. Explain what you're doing and what happens next.



Upload the recording to Vocaroo (vocaroo.com), Google Drive, or a similar service, make sure anyone with the link can listen, and paste the link at the top of your application message.



In your application message, also include:

- Your monthly pay expectation in USD

- Whether you can reliably work 8:00 AM to 5:00 PM U.S. Eastern, Monday to Friday

title: Social Media Manager & Video Editor Virtual Assistant
description:
We are looking for a creative, proactive, and detail-oriented Social Media Manager & Video Editor Virtual Assistant to support a U.S.-based teenage content creator who advocates for skin health, melanoma awareness, and skin cancer prevention.



The role involves researching social media trends, developing engaging content ideas, preparing scripts and filming instructions, editing short-form videos, and helping manage content for Instagram and TikTok. The content creator also collaborates with nonprofit organizations, so the VA will help organize content and ensure deadlines are met.



We are looking for someone who understands current social media trends, can create engaging content for a younger audience, and can work independently with minimal supervision.



SHIFT:

Flexible Philippine daytime hours, preferably 2 hours per day spread throughout the workweek. Must be available early in the week and before the weekend to prepare content for filming. No fixed U.S. business-hour shift is required.



Duties and Responsibilities



1. Social Media Content Planning

- Research current trends, content ideas, and video formats for Instagram and TikTok.

- Develop engaging content ideas related to skincare, hair, nails, sun protection, and lifestyle topics.

- Plan and organize content for nonprofit collaborations and regular social media posts.

- Maintain a content calendar and track posting deadlines.



2. Content Creation & Scriptwriting

- Create content briefs, video concepts, hooks, scripts, and captions.

- Prepare clear filming instructions, including shot lists, camera angles, and B-roll suggestions.

- Ensure filming briefs are ready before the weekend.

- Adjust content based on feedback and maintain the creator's natural voice.



3. Video Editing

- Edit short-form videos for Instagram Reels and TikTok.

- Add subtitles, on-screen text, music, transitions, and other engaging elements.

- Create thumbnails and video cover images.

- Review and revise videos based on feedback.

- Organize video files, drafts, and completed content.



4. Social Media Support

- Repurpose Instagram videos for TikTok.

- Prepare captions and publish approved TikTok content.

- Assist with scheduling content using Metricool or similar tools.

- Coordinate content approvals and provide regular progress updates.



Note: The content creator will continue managing her own Instagram posting and audience engagement.



Qualifications

- Proven experience in social media management, content creation, and short-form video editing.

- Strong understanding of Instagram Reels, TikTok trends, and audience engagement.

- Experience using video editing tools such as CapCut, Adobe Premiere Pro, or similar software.

- Ability to create engaging hooks, scripts, captions, and content ideas.

- Familiarity with Canva and social media scheduling tools.

- Experience using Metricool is an advantage.

- Strong written English communication skills.

- Creative, organized, detail-oriented, and able to manage deadlines.

- Ability to work independently and follow content guidelines.

- Experience creating beauty, skincare, wellness, or lifestyle content is a plus.

- Must be comfortable creating age-appropriate content for a teenage audience.



Key Expectations

- Be proactive in researching trends and suggesting fresh content ideas.

- Deliver content briefs before scheduled filming days.

- Produce high-quality videos and complete revisions on time.

- Maintain clear communication and keep content organized.

- Ensure skincare and health-related content is responsible, accurate, and appropriate for a teenage advocate.





If you believe you're a good fit for this position, please submit the following:

- Your updated resume in PDF format.

- A screenshot of your computer specifications and internet speed.

- Your WhatsApp number for communication.



Please use "REELS" as the subject line of your application.



We look forward to reviewing your application!

title: Insurance Customer Service & Account Specialist
description:
Nunez Agency is seeking an experienced, client-focused Insurance Customer Service & Account Specialist to be a primary point of contact for our clients while supporting our agents with technical policy administration. This role goes beyond answering basic calls—you will deliver high-touch customer service alongside quote preparation, policy servicing, property valuation reviews, and complex fiduciary/trust account updates for a California insurance agency. No insurance license is required.



Key Responsibilities

- Client Service & Policy Support: Serve as a responsive, helpful point of contact for incoming client calls and
s—handling billing questions, policy inquiries, endorsements, renewals, and cancellations with care and accuracy.

- Quote Preparation & Carrier Follow-Ups: Gather client and underwriting information to prepare accurate quotes across California carrier portals for licensed agents to review, and follow up on pending carrier requests.

- Valuation & Risk Documentation: Generate, review, and update property valuation reports (Replacement Cost Estimators) and coordinate with clients to collect needed underwriting or inspection documents.

- Fiduciary & Trust Administration: Assist clients, trustees, and representatives by properly organizing, updating, and verifying policy titling for fiduciaries, family trusts, estates, and mortgagee/loss payee requests.

- Account Organization: Maintain clean, accurate client records inside our Agency Management System (AMS) and proactively track renewals and pending tasks so nothing falls through the cracks.





Qualifications

- Insurance Customer Service Experience (Required): At least 1–2+ years of customer service and policy-servicing experience supporting a California insurance agency (Personal Lines and/or Commercial Lines). No P&C license required.

- Technical Insurance Familiarity: Working knowledge of California insurance workflows, including property valuation tools, policy endorsements, quoting prep, and trust/fiduciary policy titling.

- Systems Proficiency: Hands-on experience with insurance Agency Management Systems (AMS) and carrier portals.

- Warm, Clear Communication: Excellent spoken and written English with a patient, professional phone manner for assisting clients, underwriters, and fiduciary representatives.

- Strong Organization & Detail: Ability to multitask, manage a busy service queue, and keep client files organized and accurate.

- Remote Work Setup: Reliable high-speed internet, capable workstation, and verified internet and power backups.



Compensation & Benefits

- Base Rate: $600 – $800/month (Negotiable based on experience; non-commission base compensation)

- Team Recognition Program

- Paid Holidays: Eligible after 90 days of employment

- Paid Time Off (PTO): Eligible after 1 year of employment

- Training and supportive team environment



How to Apply (Mandatory Requirements) To be considered, please submit ALL of the following items in your application:

- Updated Resume highlighting your insurance customer service experience (including AMS and California carrier portals used).

- Recorded Video or Voice Introduction (1–2 minutes) briefly introducing yourself and walking through your experience with insurance customer service, quoting prep, valuations, or fiduciary/trust accounts.

- Internet Speed Test Screenshot (showing download/upload speeds and ping).

- Computer Specifications (screenshot or summary of processor/CPU, RAM, and operating system).

- Internet & Power Backup Details (specify your backup ISP/mobile data and power station/UPS/generator setup).

title: Amazon PPC Specialist
description:
Location: Remote

Employment Type: Full-time (9hrs), 8-hour shift with a 1-hour lunch break

Schedule: At least 5 hours of overlap with Pacific Time business hours



About the Role



Triple Line Brands is looking for an Amazon PPC Specialist to support the day-to-day advertising work for consumer brands across their Amazon marketplaces.

This is an execution and analysis-focused role. You will carry out advertising plans set by a Senior Amazon PPC Strategist, build and optimize campaigns, maintain account hygiene, analyze performance data, and prepare accurate reports. The Strategist will own account strategy and higher-judgment decisions, while you will own the accuracy, quality, documentation, and timely completion of assigned PPC work.

This role is well suited to someone who enjoys working with data, identifying inconsistencies, following structured processes, and translating clear performance targets into specific campaign changes.





What You’ll Do



Build, manage, and optimize Sponsored Products, Sponsored Brands, Sponsored Brands Video, and Sponsored Display campaigns based on approved advertising plans.

Conduct keyword and product-targeting research, search-term analysis and harvesting, negative targeting, and routine account reviews.

Translate account-specific ROAS, ACOS, CPC, conversion, and budget-pacing goals into appropriate bid, placement, targeting, and budget adjustments.

Download, organize, analyze, and validate advertising and performance data using Excel or Google Sheets.

Review datasets, reports, and dashboards for missing information, duplicates, incorrect filters, formula errors, unusual results, and inconsistencies between sources.

Monitor sales, spend, TACOS, ACOS, ROAS, CPC, conversion rate, and other relevant performance measures.

Diagnose significant performance gaps or fluctuations, identify likely root causes, and recommend appropriate actions for Strategist review.

Compile, check, and submit PPC performance reports accurately and on time.

Maintain campaign hygiene, including organized structures, naming conventions, targeting, budgets, and campaign uptime.

Document campaign changes, actions taken, test progress, results, and follow-up items.

Support the Senior PPC Strategist with data preparation, reporting, account research, audits, and other PPC-related tasks that help brands progress toward their goals.

Flag risks, blockers, unclear instructions, data issues, or decisions outside your guidelines to the Senior PPC Strategist.

Apply department standards and share practical feedback that could improve campaign execution, reporting, quality assurance, and team workflows.





What We’re Looking For



At least two years of hands-on Amazon PPC experience, with the full two years spent managing multiple Amazon advertising accounts or marketplaces at the same time for established consumer brands with meaningful ad spend.

Amazon agency experience is preferred.

Comfortable managing approximately 10 to 12 substantive brand-marketplace assignments when fully ramped, subject to account complexity and workload capacity.

Strong data analysis skills and exceptional attention to detail.

Experience reviewing and validating PPC datasets, reports, dashboards, or analytical models.

Ability to diagnose performance problems, identify likely root causes, and recommend appropriate actions.

Strong understanding of campaign structures, match types, bidding, placements, budget management, keyword targeting, product targeting, search-term harvesting, and negative targeting.

Ability to translate quantified performance goals into specific campaign optimization actions.

Strong proficiency with Excel or Google Sheets, including formulas, lookups, pivot tables, filters, and data validation.

Ability to identify reporting errors, inconsistencies between data sources, and meaningful changes in account performance.

Strong written and spoken English communication skills.

Ability to learn new brands, products, tools, and workflows quickly.

Comfortable working in a dynamic environment with multiple accounts and evolving priorities.

Organized, dependable, receptive to feedback, and proactive about communicating risks, blockers, and opportunities to improve team processes.

Familiarity with Helium 10, SmartScout, My Real Profit, Atom11, or similar platforms is an advantage.

Amazon DSP experience is a strong advantage, with advanced proficiency preferred but not required.

Experience working remotely with US-based brands or cross-functional teams is an advantage.





Why Join Us



You’ll work on a varied portfolio of Amazon brands with clear strategic direction and defined performance goals. You’ll receive account-specific coaching from a Senior PPC Strategist and support from advertising leadership while strengthening your campaign execution, data analysis, and reporting skills.





How to Apply



Please include a link to your résumé in your application and make sure we have permission to view it. If you have a portfolio of relevant Amazon PPC work, feel free to include a link to it as well.





Salary posted is negotiable

title: Ecommerce Customer Service Representative
description:
RCII is a multi-brand e-commerce business in the natural beauty and wellness space, serving families and adults who live with eczema and sensitive skin. Our customers are often parents of babies and young children, or adults going through a painful flare, and they come to us when they are tired and worried. We are bringing customer service in-house so that every customer is helped by someone who knows our products, follows through and gets it right the first time.

This is not a script-reading or ticket-closing role. It is designed for someone who takes ownership of the customer experience and wants to be trusted to resolve cases on their own.



You might be a fit if:

You write clearly, warmly and specifically, and you take pride in getting the details right.

You like owning a customer’s problem until it is fully solved.

You stay calm and kind when a customer is frustrated or upset.

You follow a process well and recognize when a situation needs something different.

You follow up without being reminded, and open cases bother you.

You want to learn a product line deeply enough to answer questions with confidence.

You are comfortable making a decision within clear guidelines, without waiting for approval.



This role is NOT a fit if:

You need someone to check every reply before it goes out.

You are uncomfortable with sensitive conversations, such as skin reactions or defective products.

You let tickets sit when the answer is not immediately obvious.



What you will own:

Customer
s, chats, calls and social messages in Gorgias.

Returns, exchanges, refunds and reshipments in Shopify and Corso.

Order tracking, delivery problems and shipping protection claims.

Cancellations, address changes and reshipments coordinated with our fulfillment warehouse.

Product questions about sizing, materials, allergies, care and use, plus product recommendations.

Accurate tags, internal notes and follow-up reminders so no customer has to chase us.

Sharing customer feedback and recurring issues with the Operations Lead.



You will be expected to:

Resolve standard cases yourself using our playbook.

Keep every customer updated while a case is pending.

Escalate only what truly needs a decision from leadership, with a clear recommendation.



What success looks like (first 90 days):

Customers receive a first reply within business hours, and nobody waits more than a day

Escalated cases are resolved in days, not weeks

No open tickets older than 30 days

Customers get real answers to product questions instead of a link to the website

Customer satisfaction scores rise above 4.5 star

You are trusted to handle the inbox independently



Required experience:

At least 2 years of customer service experience, ideally in e-commerce or online retail

Excellent written English

Experience with a help desk tool such as Gorgias, Zendesk or Freshdesk

Comfort working in Shopify or a similar e-commerce platform

A quiet workspace, a reliable internet connection and your own computer

Experience with Gorgias, Corso or a third-party fulfillment warehouse is helpful but not required.



How to apply:

Send your resume, a short note (no more than 200 words) on why this role interests you, and your reply to the customer message below. Use the subject line “Customer Service Agent”.



"Hi, I ordered two packs of cotton gloves in Medium, one in White and one in Natural. The Natural pair fits perfectly, but the White pair is noticeably bigger and longer at the wrist, and it’s rubbing against my skin and making my eczema worse. I’ve already washed and worn them. Can you help?"

description:
***** TO BE CONSIDERED AS AN APPLICANT, PLEASE SUBMIT YOUR MOST UP-TO-DATE RESUME AND A VIDEO INTRODUCTION TAILORED TO THIS JOB POSTING*****



Rental Operations Assistant



Job Type: Full-Time

Work Hours: Monday - Friday, 7:00 AM - 4:00 PM Pacific Time, with a 1-hour unpaid break.



Job Overview:

We are seeking a dependable and detail-oriented Rental Operations Assistant to support daily rental operations. In this role, you will process approved rental orders and routine off-rent requests received through a shared
 inbox, enter accurate information into Point of Rental (POR), and maintain organized records. You will work closely with the Inside Sales team to verify order details, prevent duplicate entries, and escalate incomplete or unclear requests.



The ideal candidate has experience in construction equipment rental or administrative order processing, strong attention to detail, and the ability to follow established procedures consistently. This is an administrative processing role, not a sales, dispatch, or management position.



Key Responsibilities:

* Monitor the shared rental orders inbox and track requests using the established status management process.

* Enter complete and approved rental orders into Point of Rental (POR).

* Process routine off-rent and rental termination requests, including customer-provided pickup instructions.

* Verify customer information, equipment details, rental dates and times, delivery locations, jobsite contacts, purchase orders (POs), job numbers, authorized rates, and special instructions against the original request.

* Maintain accurate system entries, record clear notes, and ensure completed requests are traceable to their original
s.

* Organize incoming requests and follow established procedures to prevent duplicate entries.

* Identify missing information, unclear equipment descriptions, conflicting instructions, and other exceptions before processing orders.

* Escalate questions regarding rates, equipment availability, delivery commitments, re-rents, breakdowns, and unusual customer issues to the Corona Inside Sales team.

* Handle straightforward phone orders after training and demonstrated competency, following an approved script and established procedures.

* Follow internal checklists and workflows to ensure accurate, consistent, and timely order processing.

* Support the Corona Inside Sales team by managing routine administrative requests and allowing the local team to focus on * more complex customer and operational matters.



Required Qualifications

* Experience in construction equipment rental, rental order processing, or a related administrative role is highly preferred.

* Familiarity with common construction equipment names, categories, and rental terminology is an advantage.

* Experience using Point of Rental (POR) or similar rental management software is preferred but not required.

* Strong written and verbal English communication skills.

* Excellent data-entry accuracy and attention to detail.

Branch Manager – Residential Cleaning Company



MaidPro Pasadena



Position: Full-Time Branch Manager

Location: Remote – Philippines

Schedule: Monday–Friday, 7:30 AM–5:00 PM Pacific Time

Languages: English required; Spanish strongly preferred



ABOUT THE POSITION



MaidPro Pasadena is looking for a dependable, organized, and motivated Branch Manager to help manage the day-to-day operations of our residential cleaning business in Pasadena, California.



You do not need experience in the residential cleaning industry. We have experienced managers who will train you on our systems, processes, and how we operate our branches.



We are looking for someone who is willing to learn, comfortable solving problems, good with people, and interested in becoming a long-term member of our team.

We are looking for someone who can stay organized, prioritize what needs attention first, and calmly work through problems as they arise.

Experience in operations, customer service, scheduling, dispatching, sales, administration, team leadership, BPO, or virtual assistance can all translate well to this position.

title: CCTV & Security Systems Virtual Assistant | Digital Watchdog (DW) Experience
description:
We are looking for a technically skilled and detail-oriented CCTV & Security Systems Virtual Assistant to support a US-based low-voltage and security systems company. The role primarily focuses on reviewing construction blueprints, marking device locations on project plans, and preparing accurate device and material takeoffs for project pricing. It will also involve programming and configuring security systems, as well as providing remote technical support to field technicians during installations and service calls.



Key Responsibilities



Part 1 – Plan Markup & Quantity Takeoff (Primary Responsibility)



- Review and interpret architectural and electrical blueprints, floor plans, and project drawings in PDF format.

- Identify and mark device locations on project plans using the company's markup system, including data jacks, CCTV cameras, intercoms, access control devices, WiFi access points, and other low-voltage equipment.

- Perform complete device and material counts for each project based on the plans and specifications provided.

- Prepare accurate takeoff reports and organized device/material counts to support cost estimation and pricing of proposed projects.

- Review marked-up plans and takeoff quantities for accuracy and completeness.

- Meet project deadlines while maintaining a high level of accuracy and attention to detail.



Part 2 – Security Systems Programming & Technical Support



- Program, configure, and set up IP cameras and Network Video Recorders (NVRs), particularly Hikvision and Digital Watchdog (DW Spectrum) systems.

- Configure and program IP-based and video intercom systems.

- Perform basic network configuration and troubleshooting, including IP addressing, Power over Ethernet (PoE), switches, routers, port forwarding, and remote viewing applications.

- Provide remote technical assistance to field technicians during system installations, configuration, and service calls.

- Troubleshoot camera, NVR, intercom, connectivity, and remote access issues.

- Coordinate with field technicians to help ensure proper system configuration and functionality.



Candidate Requirements



- Proven experience reading and interpreting construction blueprints, particularly architectural and electrical plans.

- Background in low-voltage systems, CCTV, security systems, or a related technical field.

- Hands-on experience programming and configuring IP cameras and NVRs, with strong preference for candidates experienced in Digital Watchdog (DW Spectrum). Hikvision experience is also an advantage.

- Working knowledge of IP-based and video intercom systems.

- Basic networking knowledge, including IP addressing, PoE, switches, routers, port forwarding, and remote viewing applications.

- Strong attention to detail and accuracy, particularly when marking device locations and performing quantity takeoffs.

- Good written and spoken English communication skills.

- Ability to work independently, manage multiple tasks, and meet deadlines.



Preferred Qualifications



- Experience in low-voltage estimating, device counting, and material takeoffs.

- Familiarity with access control systems and their components.

- Experience providing remote technical support to field technicians or installation teams.

- Experience working with US-based low-voltage or security systems contractors.

[About Coverland]

Coverland is a fast-growing US e-commerce brand selling car covers, floor mats, and other auto accessories, and our team is growing with it. We are looking for long-term partners, and we offer real room to grow your role and skills with us.



[The Role]

You will turn factory photos of our automotive accessories, mainly floor mats, into finished product images for our website and eBay listings. The goal is a clean image that shows customers the product's real shape and set configuration at a glance.



We provide the product photos and clear instructions. Most of our coordination is in writing, so you can focus on the retouching work.



[What You Will Do]

- 3+ years of professional photo retouching experience (product or e-commerce preferred)

- Advanced Photoshop skills: crease and fold removal, shape correction (Warp, Puppet Warp, Liquify), masking, compositing, and color correction

- Ability to show the product's actual shape and configuration accurately

- Ability to apply feedback and keep working files well organized

- Basic written English. Instructions and feedback are mostly written, so please read them carefully

title: Social Media Expert | Content Creator, Strategist & Community Manager
description:
Social Media Expert | Content Creator, Strategist & Community Manager



**Job Type:** Full-Time | Remote  

**Hours:** 40 hours per week | U.S. Eastern Time (ET)  

**Starting Salary:** $4/hour, with opportunities for increases based on performance



 About Us



We are seeking an experienced, creative, and results-driven Social Media Expert to manage and grow multiple U.S.-based brands across **all major social media platforms**.



This is not simply a content creation or posting position. We need someone who understands the U.S. consumer market, thinks strategically, takes initiative, and knows how to turn social media activity into measurable business results.



Our ideal candidate understands that successful social media marketing involves more than attractive graphics. It's about capturing attention, communicating value, building communities, encouraging action, and driving growth.



Key Responsibilities



**Social Media Strategy & Content Creation**

- Develop and execute strategic monthly content calendars across all relevant social media platforms.

- Manage content for
, Instagram, LinkedIn, TikTok, YouTube, X 
), Pinterest, Threads, and other platforms as appropriate for each brand.

- Create engaging short-form videos, Reels, Stories, YouTube Shorts, carousels, graphics, static posts, and other platform-specific content.

- Adapt content formats, messaging, tone, and creative approaches to each platform's audience and best practices.

- Write compelling, natural-sounding American English captions, headlines, hooks, and calls to action (CTAs).

- Understand how to create content that encourages users to click, comment, share, follow, subscribe, register, or make an inquiry.

- Research trends, competitors, platform updates, and emerging opportunities.

- Schedule and publish content consistently while maintaining brand standards.



**Community Management & Organic Growth**

- Actively manage comments, direct messages, and audience engagement across platforms.

- Develop strategies to increase followers, engagement, subscribers, and community participation.

- Build authentic relationships with followers and potential customers.

- Identify opportunities to convert social media engagement into website traffic, leads, registrations, and sales.

- Proactively recommend strategies to expand organic reach and visibility.



**Performance, Analytics & Reporting**

- Monitor platform-specific KPIs, including reach, impressions, engagement, follower growth, clicks, traffic, and conversions.

- Prepare accurate weekly performance reports for each brand and platform.

- Evaluate which content formats, messaging, and CTAs are producing results.

- Identify underperforming content and recommend improvements.

- Use performance data to continuously refine content strategy.



## Critical Thinking & Independent Problem-Solving



**Strong critical thinking skills are essential.**



We are not looking for someone who simply follows instructions or waits to be told what to do.



You must be able to:

- Think independently and make sound marketing decisions.

- Understand the business objective behind every piece of content.

- Recognize ineffective messaging, weak creative concepts, or missed opportunities.

- Recommend improvements rather than simply completing assigned tasks.

- Understand why certain content performs well on one platform but may require a different approach on another.

- Research solutions, anticipate challenges, and take initiative.

- Manage multiple brands while maintaining quality, consistency, and accountability.



We value professionals who bring ideas, recommendations, and solutions.



## Required Qualifications



- **Proven experience managing social media for U.S.-based businesses or brands is REQUIRED.**

- Strong understanding of American consumers, cultural references, marketing trends, and communication styles.

- Demonstrated experience managing multiple social media platforms, not just one.

- Proven ability to increase organic reach, engagement, followers, and conversions.

- Strong portfolio showing content created and measurable results achieved.

- Excellent written and spoken English, including natural American English copywriting.

- Strong understanding of marketing psychology, persuasive messaging, hooks, and effective CTAs.

- Experience creating graphics, carousels, videos, and platform-specific content.

- Strong analytical, organizational, and problem-solving skills.

- Ability to work independently, prioritize tasks, and meet deadlines.

- Availability to work during U.S. Eastern Time business hours.



**Required Tools & Platforms**

-
, Instagram, LinkedIn, TikTok, YouTube, and other major social platforms

- Canva

- CapCut or comparable video editing software

- Meta Business Suite

- Social media scheduling and analytics tools

- AI tools such as ChatGPT or Claude



**Preferred Experience**

- Adobe Photoshop or Illustrator

- ClickUp or similar project management tools

- Hubstaff or similar time-tracking tools

- Motion graphics and video editing

- Social media lead generation, membership growth, and conversion campaigns



## What Success Looks Like



We measure success through meaningful business results, not simply the number of posts published.



Our expectations include:

- Consistent, high-quality, platform-appropriate content.

- Measurable growth in followers, reach, engagement, and community participation.

- Increased website traffic, leads, registrations, subscribers, and conversions.

- Effective CTAs aligned with each brand's business objectives.

- Proactive recommendations for improving content and campaign performance.

- Accurate weekly reporting and clear accountability for time spent across brands.

- Strong communication, creativity, and ownership of responsibilities.



## How to Apply



Please submit the following:



1. **U.S. Market Experience:** Examples of U.S.-based brands or businesses whose social media accounts you have managed.

2. **Portfolio:** Links to accounts and examples of graphics, videos, carousels, campaigns, and other content you personally created.

3. **Results:** Specific examples of measurable follower growth, engagement improvements, website traffic, leads, or conversions.

4. **CTA Example:** Share a post you created with an effective call to action and explain why you selected that CTA.

5. **Critical Thinking:** Describe a social media campaign or strategy that was underperforming. What did you change, and what were the results?

6. **Platform Experience:** Identify the social media platforms you have managed professionally and your level of experience with each.

7. **Availability:** Confirm your ability to work 40 hours per week during U.S. Eastern Time business hours.



**Applications without demonstrated U.S.-based social media experience and a relevant portfolio will not be considered.**



We are looking for a proactive, creative, analytical professional who understands that social media is not just about publishing content. It's about building audiences, strengthening brands, and delivering measurable growth.

This is NOT a basic ads execution, social media, or content creation role.



We are looking for a strategic performance marketer who can analyse advertising accounts, identify what is not working, determine why, recommend the right strategy, and take ownership of improving results.



ROLE RESPONSIBILITIES



* Conduct a comprehensive audit of existing Google Ads campaigns

HIGHLY PREFERRED

description:

We are looking for a part-time social media manager.  This person must be able to drive both strategy and tactics - not just facilitate what we ask them to do.  This is a strategic position that requires strategic views and opinions.



About Us: 

We are a concierge divorce and co-parenting mediation and coaching business.  Our unique founders' story is that we are ex-spouses and co-parents who used to be married to each other and who have been 50/50 co-parents for many years.  We combine this lived experience with professional expertise as attorneys, business executives, mediators, and divorce & co-parenting coaches.  We are based on Los Angeles, but provide our services globally.   



Our current assets / processes are as follows:



1. Squarespace built website that is visually appealing but not optimized for SEO / AEO.

2. An Instagram with 1,100 followers.  We post video and carousel content, but would like better direction on the subject matter and length of the videos.  We occasionally boost the posts.

3. Both founders have LinkedIn profiles with 500+ connections and 700+ followers.  We do try to post at least weekly, but would like guidance.

4. We alternate drafting a newsletter that we send out every 2 weeks to over 500 subscribers.  We just migrated this from Squarespace
 campaigns to Substack.

5. We have a Substack but have done very little with it.  We'd like to ramp up Substack as well as make it more of our hub (newsletters, webinar videos, other video), as evidenced by recently moving over the
 campaign to Substack.

6. We periodically host webinars and then post those on our website.  We also create social media video clips from them.

7.  We periodically appear on podcasts.  We also create social media video clips from these.



Experience / skills we are looking for:



1. Experience as a social media manager, developing broad social media strategy across all platforms, pitching that to executive teams, and executing the strategy.

2. Experience with all necessary software / tech stacks necessary to effectuate the social media strategy

2. Must have tactical / technical experience:

A. Instagram

B. LinkedIn

C. Substack

D. Some graphic creation software (Canva, AI, etc)

3. Nice to have but not required tactical / technical experience

A. SEO / AEO

B. Video editing



Interview process

A. Submit your resume / cover letter to us

B. A small group of finalists will be selected for a 5-hour paid social media strategy project

C. The position will be picked based upon the project.



Other notes

A. We are both attorneys and write much of our own copy.  We are also both proficient with ChatPGT and Claude.  You must understand when to use AI and when not to use AI.  Over reliance on AI will not work for this position as we know what is AI created / could do that ourselves.

B. You must be honest about your technical skills / experience.

C. Our clients and fees are high end / top of market.  Our social media must reflect that.

title: Property Maintenance & Facilities Manager
description:
We’re hiring a full-time, remote Property Maintenance & Facilities Manager to keep our self-storage properties clean, working and rentable, and to be the go-to person for every physical issue across our portfolio.

Role: Property Maintenance & Facilities Manager

Company: MulBen Partners

Location: Fully remote

Properties: Michigan, Ohio, Colorado, Idaho and Oregon

Type: Full-time, long-term independent contractor

Hours: Monday–Friday, 9am–5pm Eastern, plus on call for major weather events

Pay: $1,200–$1,700 USD per month, based on experience, paid via Wise

About MulBen Partners

MulBen Partners is a growing self-storage company that owns and operates 12 facilities across Michigan, Ohio, Colorado, Idaho and Oregon, and we’re adding more. We were founded by Ben and Brian, who still run the business day to day, and we have been in the self-storage industry for several years.

We are a small, entirely remote team. We don’t micromanage. We trust our people to own their area, make good decisions and get results. We are growing, and we’re looking for someone who wants to grow with us for the long haul. This is not a short-term role.

The role

You will be the main point of contact for the physical condition of every MulBen facility: repairs, maintenance, upkeep, cleanliness and appearance. You’ll work remotely with our on-site managers and local vendors and contractors to keep every property at our standard. You’ll get units back online fast and catch problems before customers notice them.

This role is for someone who thinks ahead. You’ll plan for the seasons, anticipate what each property needs in the coming weeks and months, and stay proactive rather than reactive.

Your main focus:

• Keep costs in check. Spend wisely and treat every dollar like your own.

• Keep us competitive. Make sure we pay fair market prices for quality work.

• Get multiple bids on every job. No job is awarded without comparing options.

• Build strong vendor relationships. Local contractors should know us and show up when we need them.

• React quickly when problems come up. Issues get acknowledged, assigned and moving fast.

You’ll work in Cubby, our self-storage management software, and across several gate access systems and camera platforms. The team communicates mainly through Microsoft Teams and
.

You’ll also learn the business beyond the physical side. You’re expected to fully understand our properties, our customers and how we operate. That includes learning Cubby and regularly helping the team handle customer and tenant issues. It isn’t your primary job, but it is part of the role.

Your first two weeks

Onboarding runs about two weeks:

• Learn our systems, including Cubby, our management software

• Get familiar with each of our facilities

• Train alongside our customer service team

After onboarding, you’ll own facilities maintenance and the physical condition of the entire portfolio.

Key responsibilities

Property upkeep and appearance

• Keep every facility maintained and looking sharp year-round.

• Schedule and manage landscaping, lawn mowing, leaf removal, fall cleanup and snow removal.

• Manage general upkeep, light repairs and maintenance projects as they come up.

• Plan seasonal work ahead of time so nothing falls behind.

Unit turnover

• Work with on-site managers to repair, clean and return unrentable units to inventory as quickly as possible.

• Track each unit from move-out to rent-ready, and remove whatever is slowing it down.

Vendor and contractor management

• Spend a large part of your day on the phone with service providers, vendors and contractors, including:

– Landscapers, lawn care and snow plow contractors

– Pest control companies

– Roofers

– Electricians (for example, replacing lights that are out)

– Gutter repair companies

– Security camera companies

– Gate and access-control vendors

– Garage and roll-up door companies

– Sign companies (new signage and updates)

• Build strong relationships with vendors over the phone. Treat them right, keep them honest and make sure we get the most competitive pricing.

• Find, vet and get multiple bids from local contractors on every job.

• Coordinate schedules, follow up on work and confirm it was completed to standard.

• Manage service contracts and renewals.

Site systems

• Make sure keypads, gates, camera systems and utilities are working at every location.

• Spot and escalate outages fast, and drive them to resolution.

Capital projects

• Help with larger capital items such as roofing, electrical work, new gate installs and building expansions.

• Collect bids, coordinate contractors and keep projects on schedule.

On-site manager coordination

• Be the main point of contact for our on-site managers, who report up to you on:

– Repairs and maintenance that need to be scheduled

– Supplies and materials that need to be ordered

• Communicate and coordinate with site managers across the portfolio constantly. This is a large part of the job.

• Guide them through issues and make sure they have what they need.

Purchasing

• Place supply orders such as locks, drop boxes and signage.

• Keep each site stocked before it runs out.

Customer and tenant support (secondary)

• Learn Cubby and understand each property, our customers and the business.

• Help the team handle customer and tenant issues as needed.

How success is measured

1. Properties meet our standard. Every facility is clean, well kept and looks good at every visit, in every season.

2. Units come back online fast. We track the time from move-out to rentable. Your goal is to keep it short by making sure units are cleaned, repaired and returned to inventory quickly.

3. Fewer repeat customer issues. Problems with gates, lights, doors and the grounds get fixed for good. Seasonal needs get handled before they become complaints.

4. Cost savings and efficiencies. We pay less for the same or better work through competitive bids, strong vendor relationships and smarter processes.

Who we’re looking for

Required

• Experience in real estate operations, property management or facilities maintenance (self-storage, multifamily, commercial or similar)

• Experience managing physical properties remotely, including working with US-based vendors and contractors

• Fluent written and spoken English, and comfortable spending much of the day on the phone building relationships with vendors and contractors

• Very organized, and able to track many properties, vendors and open issues at once

• Comfortable working independently and making decisions without being told every step

• Available Monday–Friday, 9am–5pm Eastern, and on call during major weather events such as large snowstorms

• Reliable internet and a professional home workspace

Nice to have

• Self-storage industry experience

• Experience with Cubby or other self-storage management software, gate access systems or security camera platforms

• Experience getting and comparing contractor bids or managing capital projects

• Knowledge of seasonal maintenance in cold-weather US climates (snow removal, winterization)

What you’re like

• Proactive. You see problems coming and handle them before they’re problems.

• Impactful from day one. You can step in, learn our properties quickly and start moving work forward.

• Calm under pressure. You think on your feet and handle several issues at once.

• In it for the long term. You want a stable, lasting role with a team you can grow with.

Compensation and schedule

• Pay: $1,200–$1,700 USD per month, based on experience

• Arrangement: Full-time independent contractor, paid monthly through Wise

• Hours: Monday–Friday, 9am–5pm Eastern. Our properties span several US time zones, so we’re somewhat flexible, but you need to be available during the core hours of the US workday. You’ll also be on call during major weather events such as large snowstorms.

• Long-term role: We’re hiring for a lasting position with room to grow as our portfolio expands.

How to apply

Send us your resume and a 2–5 minute video.

In the video, tell us about your relevant experience, why you’d be a good fit and why you’d like to join our team.

Shortlisted candidates will be invited to a video interview.

title: Experienced Solar CAD Designer, Permitting & Interconnection Specialist
description:
1. Proposal & Site Survey Audits (Intake QC)

Audit solar proposals sold by the sales team and new intake jobs to verify roof layout feasibility, structural viability, and code compliance (fire setbacks, obstructions, shading).



Review site survey photos and technician notes to confirm existing electrical service equipment (main panel ratings, busbars, utility meters), roof conditions, and viable conduit pathways.



Flag discrepancies early and specify required electrical upgrades (e.g., Main Panel Upgrades, derates, load-side vs. supply-side taps) before drafting begins.



2. Solar Plan Set Drafting & Engineering (AutoCAD)

Draft complete, accurate, and code-compliant PV and Energy Storage System (ESS) permit plan sets using AutoCAD.



Create detailed Single-Line Diagrams (SLDs) and Three-Line Diagrams tailored to specific equipment (Enphase, SolarEdge, Tesla, FranklinWH, etc.) and local utility/AHJ requirements.



Perform NEC-compliant electrical calculations, including wire sizing, conduit fill, voltage drop, OCPD ratings, and busbar compliance (120% rule).



Integrate structural attachments, racking specs, equipment spec sheets, and warning placards into cohesive permit packages.



3. AHJ Permitting & Inspection Coordination

Prepare and submit building and electrical permit applications to Authorities Having Jurisdiction (AHJs) via online portals (including SolarAPP+ where applicable) or direct
/PDF submissions.



Track permit statuses daily, respond promptly to AHJ plan-check redlines/corrections, and revise AutoCAD drawings as required to secure rapid approvals.



Coordinate directly with our in-house installation teams and municipal inspectors to schedule rough and final permit inspections, ensuring field crews have approved plan sets and inspection notes on hand.



4. Utility Interconnection & PTO

Prepare, submit, and manage Net Energy Metering (NEM) / Net Billing and utility interconnection applications from initial submission through Permission to Operate (PTO).



Upload final signed-off inspection cards and single-line diagrams to utility portals, resolving any utility engineering feedback or documentation holds.



Required Qualifications & Technical Skills

Proven US Solar Experience: Minimum 2–3 years of direct experience in US residential/commercial solar PV & battery storage CAD design, AHJ permitting, and utility interconnection.



AutoCAD Proficiency: Advanced command of AutoCAD for drafting solar site plans, roof layouts, and complex electrical Single-Line Diagrams (SLDs).



Code & Technical Knowledge: Strong working knowledge of the US National Electrical Code (NEC Articles 690, 705, 706), International Residential Code (IRC), and fire setback standards (IFC).



Software & Portal Familiarity: Experience with solar proposal tools (Aurora Solar, Solo, Helioscope, OpenSolar), CRM/project management tools, and US municipal/utility portals.



Communication & Autonomy: Fluent in written and spoken English. Must be proactive, highly organized, and capable of coordinating directly with US-based field crews, sales reps, and city inspectors during US business hours.



System & Work Requirements

Reliable, high-speed internet connection (minimum 25 Mbps) with a backup power/internet solution.

Dedicated workstation capable of running AutoCAD smoothly without lag.

Availability to work full-time aligned with US Pacific Standard Time (PST) business hours.

description:

ABOUT THE COMPANY



BRH International Inc. is a U.S.-based company headquartered in Las Vegas, Nevada, specializing in packaging, manufacturing, and distribution.



We have an established accounting team in the Philippines supporting our U.S. operations.



We're looking for an experienced Senior Accountant to join our team and report directly to our General Ledger Manager.



ABOUT THE POSITION



This is a hands-on accounting position responsible for general ledger accounting, account reconciliations, month-end closing, inventory accounting, and financial reporting.



We're looking for someone with strong accounting knowledge, excellent attention to detail, and the ability to work independently.



You should be able to identify accounting issues, investigate discrepancies, and recommend solutions without constant supervision.

Ensure transactions are properly recorded in accordance with U.S. GAAP.



Prepare audit schedules and supporting documentation for external auditors.



Identify accounting errors and recommend corrective entries.



Work closely with the General Ledger Manager to meet financial reporting deadlines.



Assist in improving accounting processes and internal controls.



REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS

Strong understanding of accounting principles and financial statements.



Solid experience with month-end and year-end closing.



Experience preparing journal entries, accruals, and account reconciliations.



Advanced Microsoft Excel skills, including PivotTables, XLOOKUP, and SUMIFS.



Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.



Good written and spoken English.



Ability to work independently, manage deadlines, and handle multiple accounting tasks.



Must be available to work full-time during U.S. Pacific Time business hours.



Reliable internet connection and suitable home working environment.



PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS



Experience working with U.S.-based companies.



Strong knowledge of U.S. GAAP.



Experience in inventory accounting, manufacturing, wholesale, or distribution.



Experience with ERP or accounting systems.



Experience preparing financial schedules for external audits.



Familiarity with intercompany transactions and reconciliations.



COMPENSATION AND BENEFITS



Starting Pay: $9.00 USD per hour.



Full-time position, 40 paid hours per week.



Paid overtime when required and approved, at applicable rates.



Long-term work-from-home opportunity.



Performance and salary review after 6 months.



Opportunity to grow within our accounting department.



HOW TO APPLY



Please submit your updated resume and answer the following questions:



Are you currently a licensed Philippine CPA?



How many years of accounting experience do you have?



Have you handled month-end closing and general ledger reconciliations independently?

Are you comfortable with the starting rate of $9 USD per hour plus paid overtime?



When are you available to start?



IMPORTANT:



We are looking for an experienced, hands-on Senior Accountant who can take ownership of assigned accounts and deliver accurate work with minimal supervision.



An active Philippine CPA license is required. Applicants without a CPA license will not be considered.

title: Customer Support & Compliance Analyst
description:
Position Overview:



This is a full-time, fully remote role for a Customer Support & Compliance Analyst supporting a financial institution that uses cryptocurrency and stablecoins to power its operations. This is a hybrid role, weighted toward compliance.



The majority of your time will be spent reviewing retail applicants from a compliance perspective: verifying identity documentation, requesting additional information, managing resubmissions, conducting customer due diligence and AML screening, and escalating high-risk cases. You'll work closely with the Compliance Manager to refine onboarding workflows and ensure adherence to global AML/CTF standards.



The remainder of your time will be spent on customer support: responding to customer inquiries, resolving issues, and maintaining a high level of customer service. Much of the compliance review work is customer-facing, since it means communicating clearly with applicants about what's needed and why.



About Us:



We're an innovative, rapidly growing crypto-native financial platform on a mission to put users in control of their wealth, making it easy to save, earn, and spend crypto. Positioned as a leading decentralized finance platform, we offer a fully integrated, non-custodial product suite spanning staking, automated yield, and payments that bridges crypto utility with real-world convenience.



With billions in assets under management and a lean, agile team, we're building sustainable, secure, and scalable financial infrastructure to onboard the next billion users to crypto. Our offerings include liquid staking, automated yield strategies, and crypto-native payment solutions like credit cards, enabling a comprehensive decentralized banking experience.



As we continue to scale, we're actively hiring talented, mission-driven individuals who want to shape the future of finance from the ground up.



Required Qualifications:



• 1+ years of hands-on KYC/AML or retail onboarding experience at a fintech, payments, bank, or crypto company. This is a requirement, not a preference. We're looking for someone who has already done this work elsewhere and does not need to learn it here

• Direct experience reviewing retail applications end to end: document verification, discrepancy resolution, and making approve, reject, or escalate decisions

• Working knowledge of AML/CTF requirements, FATF standards, and KYC best practices for retail customers

• Hands-on familiarity with identity verification platforms and screening databases. Please name the specific tools you've used

• Excellent written and verbal English. Native or near-native fluency

• Excellent problem-solving skills

• Able to balance multiple high-urgency tasks, and ruthlessly prioritize

• Detail-oriented, highly organized, and comfortable handling sensitive customer data

• Personal experience with cryptocurrencies, and a strong understanding of how they work

• Bachelor's degree in a relevant field is preferred



You must be available to work 40 hours a week and have flexibility on shift timing.



To apply, please record a 1-2 minute Loom video introducing yourself, the KYC or AML work you've done previously, and the verification tools you've used.

Full-Time | Remote | Philippines



Love Google Ads AND Meta Ads? Let's Talk!



Are you a Paid Media Strategist who loves getting hands-on with campaigns, digging into performance data, and finding new ways to drive results?



We're looking for an experienced Paid Media Strategist to join a growing U.S.-based digital marketing agency. You'll work across exciting client accounts, manage campaigns on Google and Meta, collaborate with a talented marketing team, and help turn smart advertising strategies into measurable results.

title: Sales and Client Coordinator
description:
Remote | Independent Contractor



Who We Are



Instant Impact Cleaning is a growing residential and commercial cleaning company based in Las Vegas, Nevada. We serve homeowners, businesses and other clients who value dependable service, clear communication, and a high standard of care.



We are continuing to grow our sales efforts and are looking for someone who is confident, personable, persistent, and genuinely great on the phone.



Who We Are Looking For



We’re looking for a Client Solutions Specialist who enjoys talking to people, is comfortable making outbound calls, and knows how to turn conversations into opportunities.



This is a sales-focused role.



A large portion of the position will initially involve calling businesses, working through prospect lists, reaching decision-makers, identifying potential cleaning opportunities, and consistently following up.



The role may also include inbound inquiries, residential leads, reactivation, partnerships, and other sales opportunities as the company grows.



You should be someone who does not hesitate to pick up the phone, is comfortable hearing “no,” and knows how to keep a conversation natural while still moving toward a next step.



What You Will Do



- Make outbound sales and prospecting calls

- Work to reach business owners, managers, and other decision-makers

- Identify and qualify potential cleaning opportunities

- Follow up consistently with prospects and open opportunities

- Handle inbound leads and inquiries when needed

- Ask thoughtful questions and listen for the real need

- Handle common objections confidently and professionally

- Guide prospects toward the appropriate next step

- Maintain accurate notes, follow-up tasks, and pipeline stages in GoHighLevel

- Work through existing leads and opportunities that have not yet converted

- Help identify new potential prospects, relationships, and revenue opportunities



What We Need From You



- Strong spoken and written English

- Previous experience in phone sales, outbound sales, appointment setting, lead generation, business development, or a similar role

- Extremely comfortable making outbound calls

- Confident, natural, and personable on the phone

- Comfortable speaking with gatekeepers and decision-makers

- Strong listening and objection-handling skills

- Persistent without being pushy

- Able to follow up without needing constant reminders

- Organized and comfortable working inside a CRM

- Reliable internet, computer, and professional calling environment

- Able to work during agreed Pacific Time business hours



Cleaning-industry experience is not required. We can teach our services and systems. We are much more interested in finding someone who can communicate, sell, and confidently pick up the phone.



To Apply

1. Why you believe you would be a strong fit for a phone-based sales role

Use vocaroo and provide us the link.

title: Vertex Clean Solutions -REMOTE SALES PROFESSIONAL

Position Overview



Vertex Clean Solutions is seeking highly experienced, results-driven Sales Professionals with extensive knowledge of the waste management and construction industries to expand our commercial client base and generate new business opportunities.



We are specifically looking for established sales professionals who understand construction sites, waste management operations, commercial project requirements, and B2B business development.

title: Sales Rep - US Home Cleaning Company - Phone, Text & CRM
description:
WHO WE ARE

We are a home cleaning company in South Florida, USA. We serve busy homeowners who want their time back. Leads come from our website, Google, referrals and local networking. We're growing and need a sales rep who can close and keep our pipeline clean.



WHAT YOU'LL DO

Sales

- Call and text new leads fast and turn them into booked cleans

- Follow up with leads who went quiet, past leads, and past customers

- Get leads on the phone; quotes are done remotely, no home visits



CRM (GoHighLevel)

- Own the sales pipeline: every lead has a name, a card, and the right stage

- Move cards as leads reply, get quoted, book, or are lost

- Check notes and tags before contacting anyone (promo codes, do-not-contact)

- Keep follow-ups paced; never mass-text our list

- Make sure no lead sits untouched: nobody falls through the cracks



Full training and call scripts provided.



WHAT WE'VE LEARNED (AND NEED YOU TO FIX)

- Leads slipped through because nobody owned the CRM

- Leads replied once, went quiet, and never got followed up

- Promo leads were missed because nobody checked how they came in

That's your job now.



REQUIREMENTS

- Excellent spoken English

- 2+ years of phone sales or appointment setting for US businesses

- Hands-on CRM experience (GoHighLevel preferred)

- Sales numbers you can share

- A good computer, headset, and reliable internet

- Clear sound on every call: a quiet room with no background noise (no roosters, kids, TV, traffic)

- Available Mon-Fri, US Eastern Time business hours. Starts part-time, can grow to full-time for the right person



PAY

- $5/hour base

- $3 for every new clean you book (paid once the clean is done)

- $10 for every recurring customer you sign (paid after their 2nd clean)

- All new hires start with a probationary period



PLUS

- Spanish

- Home services sales experience

- Real AI skills: building and running AI agents and automations that do actual work, not just chatting with ChatGPT



Apply only through OnlineJobs.ph. Anyone who contacts us outside OnlineJobs.ph is disqualified.



HOW TO APPLY (skip a step and we won't review it)

1. Type SPARKLE at the top of your message so we know you read the whole post.

2. Tell us your best sales result, with numbers.

3. Tell us which CRM you've managed.

4. Paste a link to a 60-90 second voice recording selling us a home cleaning. Record it where you'd actually work.
