title: Full-Stack Developer | Backend Integration & Software QA
description:
Location: Philippines (Remote)

Employment Type: Project-based / Part-time, with potential for ongoing employment

Industry: Australian Real Estate & Property Management Technology

Start Date: Immediate



About the Project



We are seeking an experienced Full-Stack Software Developer to assist with the final stages of development, integration, testing and commercial launch of an innovative software platform designed specifically for the Australian real estate and property management industry.



The software has already been developed and is approaching its commercial launch. We require a technically experienced individual to review the existing infrastructure, finalise outstanding integrations, optimise backend functionality and ensure the platform is ready to be licensed and sold to real estate agencies and property management businesses across Australia.



Previous experience working with Australian real estate CRM systems and property management software is essential.



This is not a project to build software from scratch. We are looking for someone who can take technical ownership of an existing product, proactively identify areas for improvement and ensure the platform is ready for commercial use.



Key Responsibilities



1. Australian Real Estate CRM & API Integrations



Review, develop and finalise integrations with Australian real estate CRM and property management systems.

Establish reliable connections between external platforms and the software.

Ensure property, client, agency and reporting data is accurately synchronised.

Troubleshoot API connections, webhooks, authentication and data mapping.

Identify integration limitations and develop appropriate technical solutions.

Ensure integrations are scalable across multiple real estate agencies.



2. Backend Development & Optimisation



Review and audit the existing codebase and software architecture.

Ensure databases, backend systems and server-side functionality operate correctly.

Identify and resolve existing bugs and technical issues.

Optimise software performance, reliability and scalability.

Complete outstanding development requirements.

Ensure automated workflows and data processing functions operate accurately.



3. Software Testing & Quality Assurance



Conduct comprehensive end-to-end testing of the platform.

Test all existing features, dashboards, integrations and user workflows.

Verify the accuracy of data, calculations and reporting functionality.

Identify, document and resolve software bugs.

Conduct performance and compatibility testing.

Ensure the software delivers a seamless and reliable user experience.

Conduct regression testing following updates and improvements.



4. Security, Licensing & Commercial Readiness



Review user authentication, account access and permissions.

Ensure customer data is securely separated between individual agencies.

Test customer onboarding, account creation and licensing functionality.

Ensure the platform can support multiple agencies and users simultaneously.

Identify potential security vulnerabilities and address them.

Ensure appropriate data protection, backup and recovery processes are in place.



5. Pre-Launch & Ongoing Technical Support



Work directly with the Australian-based project team.

Develop a prioritised roadmap of outstanding technical requirements.

Provide regular progress updates and communicate potential technical risks.

Complete final development and testing before commercial launch.

Maintain technical documentation for future development.

Provide ongoing technical support, maintenance and improvements following launch.



Required Skills & Experience



Demonstrated experience in full-stack software development.

title: Business Development & Revenue Supervisor
description:
IMPORTANT — About This Position:

THIS IS NOT A VIRTUAL ASSISTANT POSITION. We are hiring a genuine operations manager who happens to work remotely.

We are looking for an exceptionally intelligent, resourceful, practical, and ambitious person who thinks independently, exercises excellent judgment, and approaches problems as if they were running their own business.

This position will have significant responsibility for supervising our virtual assistants, handling complicated guest issues, overseeing daily operations, and helping grow and improve our business.

A particularly important focus will be Business Development, Revenue Management, Airbnb Listing Management, and Employee Recruitment & Development. You will help identify opportunities to expand our property portfolio, maximize revenue from existing properties, recruit and develop employees, and coordinate the setup of new properties.

We want someone who doesn't simply follow instructions or complete tasks, but understands the bigger picture, solves problems creatively, anticipates future problems, and continually improves how our business operates.

You will directly supervise our Filipino virtual assistants and local US cleaners and maintenance workers during your shifts and report to PBnB ownership/management.

IMPORTANT — Full-Time Commitment & Accountability:

This position requires your full professional attention and commitment during all scheduled working hours. Working for another employer, serving other clients, or performing freelance work simultaneously during PBnB shifts is strictly prohibited.

We are looking for someone who considers PBnB their primary professional commitment. Any other ongoing employment or freelance commitments must be disclosed before hiring and approved by management. Outside commitments must never interfere with your availability, performance, or responsibilities at PBnB.

We take accountability seriously. Employee performance is evaluated through work-quality audits, response-time tracking, task completion records, and other objective performance measures. PBnB may also implement work-activity monitoring software, potentially including time and activity tracking and periodic work-related screenshots during scheduled shifts, with appropriate notice and privacy safeguards.

We respect our employees' personal time and privacy. Our objective is to ensure that everyone is fully engaged, productive, and accountable during the hours they are being paid to work.

If you are looking for a remote position that you can work simultaneously with another job, this position will not be a good fit.

IMPORTANT — Our Approach to Airbnb Support & Guest Disputes:

The short-term rental industry has become increasingly competitive, and Airbnb's policies and support decisions are often unfavorable and unfair to hosts. Protecting our business requires us to be exceptionally strategic, resourceful, persistent, and willing to fight hard for our interests.

We are looking for someone who is tough, assertive, creative, and unafraid of confrontation or challenging authority. You must be comfortable pushing boundaries, questioning decisions, finding unconventional solutions, and using every available avenue to achieve favorable outcomes.

This is not a position for someone who automatically accepts "no" as an answer, blindly follows conventional approaches, or prioritizes pleasing people over protecting the business. We expect you to be a formidable advocate for PBnB, capable of navigating difficult disputes, challenging unfair decisions, and fighting relentlessly for every dollar legitimately owed to us.

We value results, strategic thinking, and the courage to challenge the status quo.

Schedule After Training (US Eastern Time):

Sunday: 10 AM–11 PM

Monday: 10 AM–11 PM

Tuesday: 4:30 PM–11 PM

Wednesday: 4:30 PM–11 PM

Thursday: 4:30 PM–11 PM

Friday: OFF

Saturday: OFF

Total: 42 working hours per week.

Breaks: 30 minutes for shifts of 8 hours or fewer; 60 minutes for shifts over 8 hours (to be taken in 15-minute intervals as able).

Vacation/PTO: 10 PAID Days Off Per Year.

13th-Month Bonus: For every full 12 months of employment completed with PBnB, you will receive an additional bonus equal to one month's regular base salary. This means that for every 12 months you work with us, you effectively earn the equivalent of 13 months of base salary. This bonus is earned only upon completing a full year of employment, beginning on your first employment anniversary and continuing on each subsequent anniversary. It is not paid early or prorated for incomplete years, except where required by applicable law. The advertised monthly salary already includes the annualized value of this bonus.

Training: Training will have flexible hours but typically between 10 AM–10 PM Eastern for 5 days a week and 30–40 hours a week. Training pay is $6 USD per hour. The training duration will depend on how quickly you learn and become fully ready to take on the job (with minimal help), but will be a minimum of 4 weeks and a maximum of 2 months.

Holidays/PTO: No US or Philippine holiday will automatically be a day off, and there is no additional holiday pay under this policy, except where required by applicable law.

Pay Schedule: Paydays are every 4 weeks on Tuesday nights. The pay period ends 2 weeks before payday. Payment takes 1–5 business days to transfer (2 seems most usual).

Company Overview:

Pinnacle Management LLC had humble beginnings, starting in 2018 when Founder Phil Bobbs started renting out the 2nd bedroom in his run-down house in downtown Raleigh occasionally on Airbnb. Eight years and hundreds of thousands of guests later, Pinnacle Management (affectionately called "PBnB" within the company) runs over 50 individual full-time short-term rentals in four cities on the East Coast, and continues to grow yearly.

Primary Responsibilities

1. Business Development & Property Acquisition

A major emphasis of this position is helping PBnB grow by identifying and pursuing profitable new properties and business opportunities.

You will:

Research and identify potential new rental properties in our existing markets and potentially new markets.

Search for houses and apartments suitable for rental arbitrage (renting properties long-term and operating them as short-term rentals).

Research potential property purchases and help identify opportunities to buy homes that would make profitable short-term rentals.

Find and contact landlords, property owners, investors, and other potential business partners.

Explain and present our rental arbitrage or property management proposals to prospective landlords and owners.

Research property rental rates, estimated Airbnb revenue, operating expenses, and potential profitability to help evaluate opportunities.

Follow up with prospective property owners and landlords, build relationships, and help move promising opportunities toward agreements.

Continually look for creative ways to expand PBnB's property portfolio and generate additional revenue.

You do not need to be an experienced real estate investor, but you must be commercially minded, persuasive, resourceful, and capable of researching opportunities and making intelligent business recommendations.

2. Revenue Management & Airbnb Listing Management

Another major focus of this position is maximizing revenue and profitability from our existing properties.

You will:

Regularly monitor the performance of our 50+ short-term rental properties, identifying properties that are not receiving as many bookings as expected.

Investigate possible reasons for poor booking performance, including pricing, competition, reviews, listing quality, photos, amenities, and other factors.

Use PriceLabs and other pricing tools to analyze and adjust nightly rates, discounts, minimum stays, and other pricing strategies.

Help maximize occupancy, nightly revenue, and overall profitability through thoughtful revenue management and yield management.

Monitor property review scores and identify when negative reviews or declining ratings may be affecting booking performance.

Regularly review and improve Airbnb listings, including titles, descriptions, photos, amenities, and other listing details.

Create and duplicate Airbnb listings and ensure that our active and backup listings are properly maintained.

Make sure properties have the necessary backup listings available and ready when needed.

Monitor Airbnb listings and accounts for warnings, flagged photos, restrictions, errors, and other problems that may affect visibility or bookings.

Investigate when a listing may need to be replaced or updated, including determining when a backup listing should be used, subject to Airbnb policies.

Monitor and manage Airbnb host accounts and identify problems requiring attention.

Continually research new strategies and opportunities to improve our listings, booking performance, and revenue.

You should be analytical, detail-oriented, commercially minded, and genuinely interested in discovering why a property is performing well or poorly and what can be done to improve it.

3. New Property Setups, Move-Ins & Move-Outs

You will help coordinate the complete process of launching new properties and closing properties when necessary.

Responsibilities include:

Planning and coordinating the setup of new short-term rental properties.

Arranging utilities, internet service, and other services required for new properties.

Researching, sourcing, and purchasing furniture, appliances, decorations, and household supplies within approved budgets.

Finding good deals on furniture and household items through
 Marketplace, Amazon, Walmart, and other retailers.

Communicating with sellers and coordinating furniture pickups and deliveries with local employees, movers, and delivery people.

Scheduling and coordinating movers, cleaners, maintenance workers, photographers, and other people involved in setting up new properties.

Working with local cleaners and setup personnel responsible for furnishing, decorating, organizing, and preparing new properties.

Ordering the supplies and furnishings needed to make properties fully ready for guests.

Coordinating photography, new Airbnb listings, and other preparations for launching a new property.

Keeping detailed checklists and schedules to ensure every part of a setup is completed correctly and on time.

Coordinating property move-outs and closures, including furniture removal, moving arrangements, canceling utilities, and other closing responsibilities.

You must be extremely organized, resourceful, cost-conscious, and capable of coordinating many moving parts without requiring constant management involvement.

4. Hiring, Recruiting & Employee Development

You will help ensure PBnB consistently hires and develops excellent employees and has sufficient staffing in every city.

Responsibilities include:

Creating and posting job advertisements for virtual assistants, cleaners, maintenance workers, and other positions.

Proactively searching for qualified candidates on hiring websites and other platforms.

Communicating with applicants, reviewing qualifications, and conducting initial interviews.

Helping evaluate candidates and making recommendations to management regarding hiring decisions.

Coordinating onboarding and training for new employees.

Helping create and improve employee training materials, tutorials, quizzes, assessments, and performance evaluations.

Identifying weaknesses in employee training and developing ways to improve employee knowledge and performance.

Ensuring we maintain a reliable pool of cleaners, maintenance workers, and backup service providers in each city.

Identifying employees with strong potential and helping them develop their abilities and advance within the company.

Continually improving our recruiting and training processes so we attract stronger employees and develop a more capable team.

We want someone with strong leadership instincts who can recognize talent, evaluate people intelligently, and help build a better-performing team.

5. Direct Supervision of Virtual Assistants

You will manage our guest messaging assistants during your shifts.

Responsibilities include:

Monitoring guest communications and daily operational tasks.

Auditing response times, work quality, and SOP compliance.

Identifying mistakes and performance deficiencies.

Coaching assistants and helping them improve.

Handling complicated issues escalated by assistants.

Evaluating performance and reporting results to management.

Maintaining a supportive but accountable team environment.

You must be comfortable making independent management decisions and holding other employees to high professional standards.

6. Complex Guest Issues and Dispute Resolution

You will personally manage difficult guest situations that require more than standard messaging templates.

This includes resolving complaints, evaluating refund requests, negotiating appropriate solutions, handling difficult customers, and making decisions that protect both the guest experience and the company's financial interests.

You must be diplomatic but firm, and comfortable saying no when requests are unreasonable.

7. Airbnb Support, AirCover, and Review Management

You will help manage:

Escalated Airbnb Support disputes.

Appeals of incorrect refunds and penalties.

AirCover damage and reimbursement claims.

Review disputes involving violations of Airbnb policies.

Accurate documentation, evidence gathering, and persistent follow-up.

We expect you to develop expert-level familiarity with Airbnb's written policies and use that knowledge to advocate effectively for the company.

8. Cleaner, Maintenance & Vendor Management

You will coordinate with cleaners, maintenance workers, and contractors across our markets.

This includes:

Reviewing reported maintenance issues and determining their urgency and priority.

Troubleshooting common property problems with guests, cleaners, and maintenance personnel.

Coordinating repairs and maintenance visits in a timely and cost-efficient manner.

Using Airtable to track maintenance issues and ensuring appropriate follow-up until completion.

Identifying when cleaners can investigate minor issues rather than unnecessarily dispatching maintenance workers.

Recognizing when specialized contractors or owner approval may be needed.

Ensuring cleaners and maintenance workers complete their assigned responsibilities correctly.

Coordinating staffing and scheduling to make efficient use of our local workers.

You must think strategically about staff utilization, vendor expenses, scheduling efficiency, accountability, and timely completion of work.

You will help ensure we always have reliable service-provider coverage.

Although the other PBnB Supervisor will have a greater focus on maintenance operations, you must also become knowledgeable and capable of managing maintenance issues independently during your shifts.

9. Business Process Improvement

We expect you to identify and solve operational problems proactively, rather than simply waiting for assignments.

You will help improve SOPs, training resources, templates, employee workflows, listing management procedures, revenue management processes, and other operational systems.

You should regularly develop practical proposals for increasing revenue, reducing expenses, improving service, strengthening employee performance, and preventing recurring problems.

We want someone who continually looks for better ways of doing things and takes the initiative to develop complete solutions rather than simply pointing out problems.

10. Other Operational and Management Responsibilities

You must also learn and be able to perform all standard virtual assistant responsibilities whenever coverage is needed.

These include guest messaging, booking management, cleaning schedules, supply orders, direct bookings, payment verification, Airbnb listing updates, reviews, and other property operations.

Additional responsibilities may include financial documentation, accounting, hiring, employee training, property maintenance coordination, and special management projects.

Minimum Qualifications

Excellent written and spoken English.

Previous management, supervisory, or operations experience.

Strong business sense and an interest in business development, revenue management, sales, real estate, or property management.

Excellent critical thinking and independent judgment.

Practical, resourceful, creative, and financially responsible decision-making.

Strong leadership and employee coaching abilities.

Exceptional reliability, integrity, and accountability.

Ability to manage multiple urgent issues while remaining organized.

Excellent computer skills and willingness to learn our software systems.

Strong analytical skills and an interest in understanding and improving business performance.

Excellent organizational, communication, and negotiation skills.

Ability to take ownership of complex projects and independently coordinate them through completion.

Reliable computer with at least two monitors, fast internet, and dependable smartphone connectivity.

Interest in a long-term management career.

Previous experience in US property management, Airbnb operations, revenue management, dynamic pricing, real estate, business development, hospitality operations, or employee recruitment and management is particularly valuable.

Compensation and Advancement

In addition to the base salary, we intend to offer performance-based earning opportunities tied to objectively measurable results. There will be opportunities to earn up to an additional $800 monthly in bonuses tied to objective performance measures.

These may include improved assistant performance, operational improvements, guest review outcomes, AirCover recoveries, successful Airbnb appeals, improved property revenue, successful business development efforts, and other measurable contributions to PBnB's growth and profitability.

We're looking for someone ambitious who genuinely wants to help run, grow, and improve a business—not simply perform a collection of tasks.

We are looking for someone who considers PBnB their primary professional commitment. Any other ongoing employment or freelance commitments must be disclosed before hiring and approved by management. Outside commitments must never interfere with your availability, performance, or responsibilities at PBnB.

We take accountability seriously. Employee performance is evaluated through work-quality audits, response-time tracking, task completion records, and other objective performance measures. PBnB may also implement work-activity monitoring software, potentially including time and activity tracking and periodic work-related screenshots during scheduled shifts, with appropriate notice and privacy safeguards.

We respect our employees' personal time and privacy. Our objective is to ensure that everyone is fully engaged, productive, and accountable during the hours they are being paid to work.

If you are looking for a remote position that you can work simultaneously with another job, this position will not be a good fit.



IMPORTANT — Our Approach to Airbnb Support & Guest Disputes:

The short-term rental industry has become increasingly competitive, and Airbnb's policies and support decisions are are often unfavorable an unfair to hosts. Protecting our business requires us to be exceptionally strategic, resourceful, persistent, and willing to fight hard for our interests.

We are looking for someone who is tough, assertive, creative, and unafraid of confrontation or challenging authority. You must be comfortable pushing boundaries, questioning decisions, finding unconventional solutions, and using every available avenue to achieve favorable outcomes.

This is not a position for someone who accepts "no" as an answer, blindly follows conventional approaches, or prioritizes pleasing people over protecting the business. We expect you to be a formidable advocate for PBnB, capable of navigating difficult disputes, challenging unfair decisions, and fighting relentlessly for every dollar owed to us.

We value results, strategic thinking, and the courage to challenge the status quo.



Schedule After Training (US Eastern Time):



Sunday: OFF



Monday: OFF



Tuesday: 10 AM–5 PM



Wednesday: 10 AM–5 PM



Thursday: 10 AM–5 PM 



Friday: 10 AM–11 PM



Saturday: 11 AM–11 PM



Breaks: 30 mins for shifts of hrs or less; 60 minutes for shifts over 8 hours (to be taken in 15 min intervals as able)



Vacation/PTO: 10 PAID Days Off Per Year

13th-Month Bonus: For every full 12 months of employment completed with PBnB, you will receive an additional bonus equal to one month's regular base salary. This means that for every 12 months you work with us, you effectively earn the equivalent of 13 months of base salary. This bonus is earned only upon completing a full year of employment, beginning on your first employment anniversary and continuing on each subsequent anniversary. It is not paid early or prorated for incomplete years. The advertised monthly salary already includes the annualized value of this bonus.

Training: Training will flexible hours but typically between 10am-10pm EST for 5 days a week and 30-40 hours a week. Training pay is $6 USD per hour. The training duration will depend on how quickly you learn and become fully ready to take on the job (with minimal help), but will be a minimum of 4 weeks and a maximum of 2 months.



Holidays/PTO : No US or PH holiday will be off automatically and there is no additional holiday pay.

Pay Schedule: Paydays are every 4 weeks on Tuesday nights. The pay period ends 2 weeks before payday. Payment takes 1-5 business days to transfer (2 seems most usual).



Company Overview:



Pinnacle Management LLC had humble beginnings, starting in 2018 when Founder Phil Bobbs started renting out the 2nd bedroom in his run-down house in downtown Raleigh occasionally on AirBnB. Eight years and hundreds of thousands of guests later, Pinnacle Management (affectionately called “PBnB” within the company) runs over 50 individual full-time short-term rentals in four cities on the East Coast, and continues to grow yearly.

Primary Responsibilities

1. Maintenance Management and Troubleshooting



A major emphasis of this position is coordinating maintenance for our properties efficiently and economically.



You will:

- Review and prioritize reported maintenance problems.

- Determine which issues are urgent and which can reasonably wait.

- Troubleshoot problems with guests, cleaners, and maintenance technicians.

- Understand common residential plumbing, HVAC, electrical, appliance, and general maintenance issues.

- Identify when cleaners can investigate minor issues instead of unnecessarily dispatching maintenance workers.

- Coordinate repairs across multiple properties and cities.

- Combine maintenance tasks when possible to reduce unnecessary trips and expenses.

- Recognize when licensed specialists or owner approval are needed.

- Manage maintenance tasks in Airtable, ensuring every issue receives appropriate follow-up through completion.

- Identify recurring maintenance problems and develop permanent solutions.

You do not need to be a professional tradesperson, but you must be practically knowledgeable, highly resourceful, and capable of communicating intelligently with technicians and contractors.



2. Direct Supervision of Virtual Assistants



You will manage our guest messaging assistants during your shifts.



Responsibilities include:

- Monitoring guest communications and daily operational tasks.

- Auditing response times, work quality, and SOP compliance.

- Identifying mistakes and performance deficiencies.

- Coaching assistants and helping them improve.

- Handling complicated issues escalated by assistants.

- Evaluating performance and reporting results to management.

- Maintaining a supportive but accountable team environment.

You must be comfortable making independent management decisions and holding other employees to high professional standards.



3. Complex Guest Issues and Dispute Resolution



You will personally manage difficult guest situations that require more than standard messaging templates.



This includes resolving complaints, evaluating refund requests, negotiating appropriate solutions, handling difficult customers, and making decisions that protect both the guest experience and the company's financial interests.



You must be diplomatic but firm, and comfortable saying no when requests are unreasonable.



4. Airbnb Support, AirCover, and Review Management



You will help manage:

- Escalated Airbnb Support disputes.

- Appeals of incorrect refunds and penalties.

- AirCover damage and reimbursement claims.

- Review disputes involving violations of Airbnb policies.

- Accurate documentation, evidence gathering, and persistent follow-up.

We expect you to develop expert-level familiarity with Airbnb's written policies and use that knowledge to advocate effectively for the company.



5. Cleaner and Vendor Management



You will coordinate with cleaners, maintenance workers, and contractors across our markets.



You must think strategically about staff utilization, vendor expenses, scheduling efficiency, accountability, and timely completion of work.



You will help ensure we always have reliable service-provider coverage.



6. Business Process Improvement



We expect you to identify and solve operational problems proactively, rather than simply waiting for assignments.



You will help improve SOPs, training resources, templates, maintenance procedures, employee workflows, and other operational systems.



You should regularly develop practical proposals for reducing expenses, improving service, and preventing recurring problems.



7. Other Operational and Management Responsibilities



You must also learn and be able to perform all standard virtual assistant responsibilities whenever coverage is needed.



These include guest messaging, booking management, cleaning schedules, supply orders, direct bookings, payment verification, Airbnb listing updates, reviews, and other property operations.



Additional responsibilities may include hiring and training, property setup and move-outs, administrative work, and financial documentation.



Minimum Qualifications

- Excellent written and spoken English.

- Previous management, supervisory, or operations experience.

- Strong understanding of residential property maintenance, troubleshooting, or property management.

- Excellent critical thinking and independent judgment.

- Practical, resourceful, and financially responsible decision-making.

- Strong leadership and employee coaching abilities.

- Exceptional reliability, integrity, and accountability.

- Ability to manage multiple urgent issues while remaining organized.

- Excellent computer skills and willingness to learn our software systems.

- Reliable computer with at least two monitors, fast internet, and dependable smartphone connectivity.

- Interest in a long-term management career.

Previous experience in US property management, Airbnb operations, residential maintenance coordination, facilities management, or hospitality operations is particularly valuable.



Compensation and Advancement



In addition to the base salary, we intend to offer performance-based earning opportunities tied to objectively measurable results. There will be opportunity to earn up to additional $800 monthly in bonuses tied to objective performance measures.



These may include improved assistant performance, operational improvements, guest review outcomes, AirCover recoveries, and successful Airbnb appeals.



We're looking for someone ambitious who genuinely wants to help run and improve a growing business—not simply perform a collection of tasks.

Position Summary:

We are seeking a highly organized, part-time Medical Lien Negotiator and Disbursement/Accounting Manager to bridge the gap between personal injury case settlement and final closure. In this role, you will be responsible for aggressively negotiating medical liens to maximize our clients' net recovery while meticulously managing the firm’s trust accounting, preparing settlement statements, and overseeing the final disbursement of funds.



Core Responsibilities

Lien Resolution & Negotiation

Trust Accounting & Financial Compliance

- IOLTA Management: Manage the firm’s Client Trust Account (IOLTA), ensuring strict compliance with state bar rules regarding the holding and disbursement of client funds.

title: Video Editor for Marketing Agency (Short-Form Ads | Ongoing Work)
description:
We're a US-based video marketing agency producing cinematic short-form video ads for our clients.

We're busy, which means steady, ongoing work for the right person.



This starts as a part-time, per-video arrangement. If you're good and reliable, this grows.

---



WHAT YOU'LL BE EDITING



Short-form vertical video ads (1-2 minutes), typically built around a script OR unscripted testimonials with b-roll and stock footage layered in. Clean, cinematic, and premium-looking content.



This is important: What we're NOT looking for is an editor who relies on flashy transitions, flying text, and motion effects to carry a video. If your best work is built around those things, we're probably not the right fit. If your best work is built around making footage feel intentional and polished - we want to hear from you. What we care about is the fundamentals: pacing decisions, choosing the best takes, b-roll selection, color correction, and clean storytelling.



---



WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR



We can teach technical skills. What's harder to find - and what we care about most - is two things:



1. Attention to detail and ability to learn from feedback. Before you send any edit, you've already watched it three times and caught every issue yourself. We understand mistakes happen, but we should never have to tell you something twice.



2. A good eye. Specifically when it comes to stock footage and b-roll. You know the difference between a clip that feels natural and cinematic versus one that looks awkward or like generic stock footage. 



---



PAY



We pay $75+ per video depending on length and complexity. Editors who deliver clean, revision-light work that we can approve quickly become invaluable. If you takes pride in getting it right before it ever lands in our inbox, there's room to earn more here.



REQUIREMENTS



— Adobe Premiere Pro 2025 / 2026 (required)

— The ability to edit at least 3-5 videos per week

— Fluent English, written and spoken

— Experience editing short-form testimonial videos, cinematic interview-style content, and lifestyle b-roll

— A computer capable of storing and handling 4K footage and graphics smoothly

— Strong communication and responsiveness - if we send a message, we expect a reply the same day

— Open-minded and willing to learn new systems and workflows



---



HOW TO APPLY



Do not just send your resume. We receive a lot of applications and we read every one - but here's how to make sure yours gets noticed:



Answer this question in your application: What is your favorite sport?



If you don't answer it, we won't move forward. It's a small thing, but it tells us you read carefully and follow instructions - which matters a lot in this role.



Also include:

- A short note about yourself and your editing experience

- Your portfolio

- 2–3 samples of your BEST work



Shortlisted applicants will be asked to complete a short skills test before any paid work begins. It won't take long, but it's how we make sure we're a good fit for each other.



Looking forward to hearing from you.

title: Marketing Operations Coordinator
description:
Company Background:

A quickly growing real estate investment company is seeking a new team member to help guide families through the process of purchasing their forever home. We pride ourselves on helping them by solving a problem they didn’t think there was a solution for.  We have had people cry because they were so thankful that we purchased their house or sold them a home.  We also help people buy a home that wouldn’t qualify for a traditional bank loan.  It is an excellent and exciting feeling!



Our positions do not require prior real estate experience because we will slowly teach the industry.  We have a hard-working yet fun and energetic team that is mainly remote-based.  We spend time on professional and personal development for all employees and end the week with Dad Joke Fridays.



This is an excellent opportunity to learn more about the real estate industry and the non-retail method of buying and selling properties.  You will work closely with the business owner and take on more responsibilities over time.  We are only looking for a full-time role but are flexible with our work schedule as we don’t track sick or time off days, you are a professional and would be treated that way.  



Messages from current team members: Here is a collection of short videos from existing team members on their thoughts on working with us.  We pride ourselves on our culture and would love to add you to our team:  Team Members Testimonials: 
  



The role:

You’ll keep our marketing running day to day across several brands and projects. You’ll also bring fresh ideas to the table. Our marketing manager sets the direction. You help shape it by spotting what’s new, especially in AI, and testing ideas that could reach more families. Priorities shift between paid ads, listings, Salesforce, local market launches, and new channels, so flexibility and curiosity matter more than a narrow specialty.



Responsibilities and Duties:

* Run daily and weekly checks on our current digital ads.

* Set up ads and campaign changes from written briefs, after approval.

* Build and maintain campaign records, reports, and lead data in Salesforce.

* Check new leads every day for missing or incorrect information, and flag problems.

* Prepare listing packets and listing-site inputs for homes we sell, and chase open items until each one is complete.

* Keep our process documents, Trello boards, and trackers up to date.

* Join brainstorming sessions and bring ideas of your own: new channels, new formats, better ways to reach buyers and sellers.

* Track how AI search tools talk about real estate and about us, and suggest ways to show up in their answers.

* Run small, approved tests on new ideas, measure what happens, and report back.



What we're looking for:

* Experience in marketing operations, marketing coordination, or digital ads support.

* Comfort in a CRM, ideally Salesforce, and in spreadsheets.

* An eye for emerging AI tools and how they could apply to real estate marketing.

* Careful attention to detail.

* Clear written and spoken English.

* Nice to have: real estate marketing, Spanish, Salesforce or similar automation tools.



You'll enjoy this role if you like:

* Turning a messy list into a finished checklist.

* Working through numbers and spotting what changed since yesterday.

* Juggling several projects without dropping details.

* Building things right the first time and documenting how you did it.

* Being the person the team counts on to make plans actually happen.

* Brainstorming and pitching ideas nobody has tried yet.

* Experimenting with new AI tools before they're mainstream.



Perks:

* $6.35/hr ($13,208/year)

* Quarterly Bonus when we hit our target numbers

* Flexible work schedule

* 13th month pay

* We want to make sure you are well compensated for your work efforts and are only looking for full-time employees.



Qualifications

* Bachelor’s Degree

* VA experience for at least 2 years

* Attention to detail across all projects

* Fluent in English - written and verbal

* Proficient with Google Drive/Docs/Sheets, Salesforce, Dropbox, and Slack

* Familiar with Mac; if you don't have one, we can help you get one if so desired 

* Consistent, reliable, and fast internet connection

  

---------------



Why should you join us over anyone and everyone else? 

1) Steady paycheck with the chance for bonuses based on performance 

2) Opportunity to work from home without a boss breathing down your neck 

3) Team environment where you work with others to share the workload



How do you know if you’re qualified for this opportunity? 

We don’t care if you have prior experience in the real estate field.  We can teach you everything you need to know about our clients and our field so you can excel at your job.  We can teach anyone with a good attitude who is self-motivated for more.  These are things you must demonstrate in the interview process. 



The working hours? 

As I stated before, our company is based in Texas, so we require you to work during US business hours, preferably 9:00 AM to 5:00 PM CST (with an hour off for lunch) or 10:00 AM to 6:00 PM CST.  There is some flexibility here, but you would interact with us during business hours and follow up with U.S. companies and families living in the Central Standard Time zone.



What about pay?

We are serious about hiring someone and are looking to fill this position ASAP.  I also want this to be a real job that can meet your financial needs.  We pay your 13th month pay, bonuses, annual pay increases, etc. 



What about the 13th Month? 

Do we pay the 13th month?  Of course, we do.  It’s part of Filipino culture, and we want to be a part of it too. We pay half of the 13th month in the 3rd quarter for school supplies, etc., for your kids (or whatever else you choose) and the other half right before Christmas. 



What happens next? 

Since our jobs are so popular, we generally get deluged with applicants.  So, I have designed a multi-part interview process to make the process simple and efficient for all parties.  



The first part of the interview process is designed to examine your English-speaking & writing skills, personality type, internet speed, and ability to follow directions. Please be advised that those who submit incomplete applications will be ignored.



If you make it through this first round, we will talk via video chat to answer any questions and get to know you better. 



We will then ultimately hire someone, potentially you!!!



How to Apply:

To submit your application for the job, please complete all of the following and
 them to us at 
 Please complete this quick assessment, as it will be our primary initial qualification: 

2. Video yourself looking at the camera and explain why you would be a good fit for this position. Then, send me a link to see your video. 

3. Perform an Internet speed test at 
, send a screenshot of your results, and include them in your
 with the video.

4. Along with your resume, send us the names of at least 3 references we can contact who would say good things about working with you.  This could be a priest, former employer, bank manager, school teacher, or anyone.  No more than 1 of these people can be a family member.

title: Remote Leasing Assistant
description:
About Us

Los Angeles property management company managing a large residential portfolio. Our leasing team turns rental applications into clean, owner-ready approval packages. Accuracy and consistency matter enormously — owners make decisions off our write-ups, and a single wrong number or missing verification creates real problems.



The Role

You will process rental applications from start to finish and produce owner-ready “vetted app” packages, following our detailed written SOP exactly. This is precise, checklist-driven work with real judgment: verifying income, reading financial documents, making verification calls, and composing structured summaries that go to property owners for approval.



What You'll Do

- Assemble complete application packages — confirm every adult applicant's ID, application, credit, and background check are present.

- Verify income against our 2.5×-rent threshold, converting pay frequencies correctly and applying our rules for overtime, gig, self-employed, and voucher income.

- Review 3 months of bank statements and the credit report; flag red flags (negative balances, sharp declines, derogatory items) accurately.

- Verify employment and rental history by phone with employers and landlords, and document the results in our standard language.

- Handle Section 8 / Housing Choice Voucher applications — capture voucher details, check bedroom-size match and expiration, and run the alternative income test.

- Compose the vetted-app
 in our exact format and subject-line convention, with correct routing — and catch the common errors before they go out.

- Monitor owner responses and prepare the congratulations letter and internal lease-for-approval once approved.

- Assemble the lease from the approved application and property record, then prepare and send the DocuSign envelope to the correct signer (which varies by property type).

- Monitor the leasing inbox throughout the day — owner approvals, outside-agent messages, and applicant replies — and move each file to its next step promptly.

What We're Looking For

- Exceptional attention to detail. This role lives or dies on accuracy — correct numbers, complete fields, no typos in addresses or figures.

- Strong written English (owner- and applicant-facing
s must be clean and professional) and clear spoken English (you'll call U.S. employers and landlords to verify).

- Comfort with numbers — percentages, pay-frequency conversions, and threshold math done reliably by hand.

- Ability to follow a long, detailed SOP precisely and apply judgment on edge cases rather than guessing.

- Discretion with sensitive financial and personal information.

- Reliable computer, stable internet (?25 Mbps) with a backup connection, and a backup-power plan.

- A plus: experience in property management, leasing, mortgage/loan underwriting, insurance, or BPO back-office work; AppFolio; or familiarity with U.S. Section 8 / HACLA.



How to Apply — Read Carefully

To be considered, your application MUST include all of the following. Applications missing any item will not be reviewed.

1. Internet speed proof. A Speedtest.net screenshot showing at least 25 Mbps download.

2. A quick math check (show your work): The rent is $2,095/month. An applicant's only income is a bi-weekly paycheck with gross pay of $3,391.83. (a) What is the minimum monthly income we require? (b) What is the applicant's monthly income? (c) Do they qualify?

3. A short writing sample. Write a brief, professional
 to an applicant telling them their bank statements were incomplete — you need the 3 most recent statements from one account, as PDFs (not screenshots).

4. Three short answers (a few sentences each): (a) Describe any experience you have reviewing financial documents, verifying information, or processing applications. (b) How do you make sure you don't miss details in repetitive work? (c) Your current internet provider and your backup plan for outages.

5. Your rate. Expected hourly rate in USD and earliest availability.

Why these? The math and writing questions mirror the actual daily work. Strong applications that follow instructions move to a short skills test, a video call, and reference checks.



Our Process

- Application review against the requirements above.

- Short skills test (process a sample rental application into a vetted-app write-up).

- Video interview.

- Reference checks, then offer.

title: Customer Service Representative (CSR) – U.S. Pest Control Company
description:
# Customer Service Representative (CSR) – U.S. Pest Control Company



**Company:** Rowland Pest Management  

**Location:** Remote – Philippines  

**Employment Type:** Full-Time  

**Starting Pay:** $6 USD per hour



## About Rowland Pest Management



Rowland Pest Management is a local, family-owned business operating in several Florida markets. We have been in business for over 10 years and are one of the highest-ranked pest control companies in our market.



Our team members and their families are our top priority. It is our mission to grow this company as quickly as possible without losing integrity, so that our team members can grow professionally and realize their full potential.



We hope you can come on this journey with us!



## About the Position



We are seeking a highly motivated, organized, and customer-focused **Customer Service Representative (CSR)** to join our growing team.



The ideal candidate will have previous customer service experience working with U.S.-based companies, preferably within the pest control industry.



This position requires someone who can confidently handle customer interactions, resolve concerns, manage scheduling, and help maintain strong customer relationships.



We are looking for someone who takes ownership of their responsibilities, pays close attention to detail, and can work independently with minimal supervision.



Fluency in spoken and written English, with excellent grammar and clear communication skills, is required.



This position will require ongoing video meetings with management and potentially other employees for training, coaching, and performance discussions. Occasionally, these meetings may require brief availability outside your normal shift.



## Responsibilities



- Answer inbound customer calls in a friendly, professional, and efficient manner.

- Assist customers with scheduling, rescheduling, and managing pest control appointments.

- Handle customer questions regarding services, billing, account information, and service agreements.

- Resolve customer complaints and service concerns while maintaining a positive customer experience.

- Assist with customer retention by identifying concerns, offering solutions, and helping prevent cancellations.

- Make outbound calls to follow up with customers regarding appointments, service requests, and account issues.

- Respond to customer
s, text messages, and other incoming communications.

- Accurately document all customer interactions and maintain updated account information.

- Coordinate with technicians, dispatchers, and management to ensure smooth daily operations.

- Identify opportunities to recommend additional pest control services when appropriate.

- Follow company procedures and maintain high standards for customer satisfaction and communication.

- Meet established performance expectations for call handling, customer satisfaction, productivity, and retention.

- Perform additional tasks and responsibilities as needed at management's discretion.



## Qualifications



- Previous customer service or call center experience working with a U.S.-based company (2+ years preferred).

- **Previous experience working for a U.S. pest control company is highly preferred.**

- Experience using FieldRoutes/PestRoutes or similar field service management software is a major advantage.

- Prior night shift experience is required.

- Strong command of the English language, both written and verbal, with little to no grammatical errors.

- Excellent communication, interpersonal, and problem-solving skills.

- Ability to handle difficult customer conversations professionally and confidently.

- Strong organizational skills and exceptional attention to detail.

- Ability to multitask while navigating multiple software systems.

- Ability to work independently with minimal supervision.

- Excellent time management and prioritization skills.

- Ability to type at least 40 words per minute.

- Comfortable working in a fast-paced, high-volume call center environment.



## Perks & Benefits



- 13th-month bonus

- 5 days of paid time off (PTO) during the first year

- 6 paid U.S. holidays

- Competitive starting salary

- Long-term, stable employment

- Opportunities for career advancement within a rapidly growing company

- Supportive, team-oriented work environment



## Schedule & Compensation



**Compensation:** Starting at $6 USD per hour.



**Schedule:** Monday–Friday, 8:00 AM–5:00 PM U.S. Eastern Time, including a 1-hour unpaid lunch break.



This position may require availability for a rotating half-day Saturday shift (8:30 AM–12:30 PM Eastern Time), approximately once per month or more as needed.



Applicants must be comfortable working overnight hours in the Philippines to accommodate U.S. business hours.



## Work-From-Home Requirements



Applicants must have:



- Reliable, high-speed internet connection

- High-quality microphone or headset

- Working webcam with clear video quality

- Quiet, organized, and professional home office setup

- Reliable computer capable of running multiple applications simultaneously

- A dependable and distraction-free work environment



## How to Apply



To apply, please submit your updated resume and a cover letter or introductory message highlighting your relevant customer service experience.



**All applicants must also submit a video recording (or video link) speaking in English that is at least 60 seconds long.**



In your video:



- Introduce yourself.

- Briefly explain your previous customer service experience.

- Discuss any experience working for a U.S. pest control company.

- Mention any CRM or scheduling software you have used.

- Explain why you would be a good fit for this position.



We encourage you to speak naturally and conversationally rather than reading directly from a script. Light notes or bullet points are acceptable, but please avoid reading word-for-word.



**Applications submitted without a video link will not be considered.**



The application process includes an examination, and selected candidates may be invited to participate in a screening interview, typing test, and additional skills assessments.



**IMPORTANT: Please include the word "Pest" in the subject line of your application.**



Applicants unwilling to participate in an interview or complete the required assessments need not apply.



Incomplete applications or applications that do not follow the instructions will not be considered.



We look forward to welcoming another great team member to Rowland Pest Management!

title: Low Voltage Systems Project Manager (Remote – US Projects)

title: Senior FP&A Analyst – Strategic Finance & Financial Modeling
description:
Senior FP&A Analyst – Strategic Finance & Financial Modeling

Location: Remote – Philippines

Job Type: Full-Time

Schedule: U.S. Pacific Time / Philippine Graveyard Shift

Compensation: $10–$12 USD per hour, depending on experience, qualifications, and financial modeling capabilities



About the Role

A growing U.S.-based company is looking for a highly analytical Senior FP&A Analyst with strong financial modeling experience to support management with forecasting, pricing, profitability analysis, scenario modeling, and strategic financial planning.



This is not a bookkeeping, general accounting, or basic financial reporting position.



We are looking for someone who can take financial and operational data, build models from scratch, identify what is driving the results, and help management determine what actions should be taken next.



The right person should be comfortable answering questions such as:

- What happens to gross margin if selling price, product cost, freight, tariffs, or volume changes?

- What selling price is required to achieve a target gross margin?

- Which products or customers are generating the strongest and weakest profitability?

- What is driving the difference between actual results, forecast, and budget?

- What combination of revenue growth, pricing, margin improvement, product mix, and cost reductions is required to achieve an EBITDA target?

- Where are the biggest financial opportunities or risks management should be focused on?



Key Responsibilities

- Build and maintain integrated financial models for revenue, gross profit, gross margin, operating expenses, and EBITDA.

- Develop annual budgets, rolling forecasts, and longer-term financial projections.

- Build pricing and profitability models using selling price, product cost, freight, duties/tariffs, landed cost, volume, and other business drivers.

- Perform scenario and sensitivity analysis for changes in pricing, volume, product mix, freight, sourcing, costs, and other assumptions.

- Develop models comparing different shipping and sourcing scenarios and their impact on landed cost and profitability.

- Determine required selling prices to achieve target gross margins.

- Analyze actual results versus budget and forecast and clearly explain the drivers behind variances.

- Develop EBITDA bridge and gap-to-target analysis.

- Analyze profitability by product, customer, and business line.

- Analyze historical customer purchasing behavior to identify trends, declining customers, cross-selling opportunities, and potential areas for revenue growth.

- Support working-capital analysis, including accounts receivable, inventory, and accounts payable.

- Build management dashboards and financial reporting that highlight trends, risks, and opportunities.

- Work with large datasets from accounting, ERP, sales, and operational systems.

- Perform ad hoc financial analysis for management.

- Present findings clearly and provide actionable recommendations rather than simply reporting numbers.

- Help improve and automate existing financial models and reporting processes.



What We Are Looking For

- Minimum 5 years of experience in FP&A, corporate finance, strategic finance, financial modeling, or a closely related role.

- Strong experience building financial models from scratch.

- Advanced Excel and/or Google Sheets skills.

- Strong understanding of P&L, revenue, COGS, gross margin, EBITDA, operating expenses, cash flow, and working capital.

- Hands-on experience with budgeting, forecasting, variance analysis, and scenario modeling.

- Experience with pricing, profitability, margin, or unit-economics analysis.

- Ability to work with large datasets and turn them into useful financial insights.

- Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.

- High attention to detail and accuracy.

- Ability to identify issues and opportunities proactively rather than waiting for management to request an analysis.

- Strong written and verbal English communication skills.

- Comfortable working directly with finance leadership and management.

- Must be comfortable working full-time U.S. Pacific Time hours / Philippine graveyard shift.



Preferred Qualifications

- CPA, CMA, CFA, MBA, or similar finance/accounting qualification.

- Experience with Power BI, Power Query, SQL, or similar analytics tools.

- Experience with QuickBooks Online or ERP systems.

- Experience in manufacturing, distribution, wholesale, inventory-based businesses, or e-commerce.

- Experience with landed-cost modeling, freight/logistics, duties, or tariffs.

- Experience with customer and product profitability analysis.

- Experience using AI or automation tools to improve financial analysis and reporting.



What Success Looks Like

We are not looking for someone who simply prepares reports.

We want someone who can look at the numbers and tell management:

What happened? Why did it happen? What is likely to happen next? What should we do about it?

You should be comfortable challenging assumptions, identifying unusual trends, and bringing issues or opportunities to management before being asked.



How to Apply

Please include the following with your application:

1. Your resume.

title: Senior FP&A / Financial Modeling Analyst
description:
Senior FP&A / Financial Modeling Analyst

Remote – Philippines | Full-Time

About the Role

A growing U.S.-based company is looking for a highly analytical Senior FP&A / Financial Modeling Analyst to support its Finance team.

This role will work closely with senior Finance leadership and will focus heavily on financial modeling, forecasting, profitability analysis, pricing, margins, and management decision support.

This is not a traditional accounting or bookkeeping position. We are looking for someone who can take financial and operational data, build reliable models, identify trends and opportunities, and turn the results into forward-looking analysis that helps management make better business decisions.

Key Responsibilities

- Build and maintain detailed financial models for revenue, gross profit, gross margin, EBITDA, and overall profitability.

- Develop product-level pricing and margin models incorporating selling price, product cost, freight, duties/tariffs, and other landed costs.

- Analyze gross margins against company targets and identify products, customers, or transactions that are below target.

- Develop scenario and sensitivity models to evaluate the impact of changes in:

  - Selling prices

  - Product costs

  - Freight and shipping methods

  - Duties and tariffs

  - Sales volume

  - Product mix

  - Other operating assumptions

- Analyze different shipping and sourcing scenarios and determine their impact on landed cost, gross margin, and profitability.

- Identify pricing opportunities and determine the selling prices required to achieve targeted gross margins.

- Develop models showing the financial impact of pricing increases, purchasing savings, freight savings, and other cost-reduction opportunities.

- Build and maintain EBITDA forecasts and bridge analyses showing the impact of pricing, volume, product mix, gross margin, freight, purchasing savings, and operating expenses.

- Support annual budgeting, monthly forecasting, and longer-term financial planning.

- Perform actual vs. budget and actual vs. forecast analysis and explain the key drivers behind variances.

- Analyze historical financial and operational trends and develop forward-looking projections.

- Work with large datasets from accounting, ERP, sales, inventory, purchasing, and other business systems.

- Develop management dashboards and reports that clearly identify trends, risks, opportunities, and areas requiring management action.

- Perform product, customer, and business-line profitability analysis.

- Work closely with Finance and IT to improve the accuracy, efficiency, and automation of financial analysis and reporting.

- Perform ad hoc financial modeling and analysis requested by senior management.

- Present findings in a clear and concise manner and provide actionable financial insights rather than simply reporting numbers.

Required Qualifications

- Minimum 5 years of experience in FP&A, corporate finance, financial analysis, or financial modeling.

- Demonstrated experience building sophisticated financial models from the ground up.

- Advanced Excel and/or Google Sheets skills.

- Strong understanding of revenue, COGS, gross profit, gross margin, EBITDA, operating expenses, and working capital.

- Strong experience with budgeting, forecasting, and variance analysis.

- Experience with pricing, profitability, margin, and scenario/sensitivity analysis.

- Ability to work with large and sometimes complex datasets.

- Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.

- Ability to identify the business drivers behind financial results rather than simply reporting variances.

- Strong attention to detail and ability to independently validate financial information.

- Ability to translate complex financial analysis into clear recommendations for management.

- Comfortable working directly with senior Finance and company leadership.

- Strong written and spoken English.

- Ability to work independently and manage multiple priorities and deadlines.

- Ability to work U.S. business hours as required.

Preferred Qualifications

- CPA, CMA, CFA, MBA, or similar professional qualification is a plus but not required.

- Experience with Power BI, Power Query, SQL, or similar business intelligence/data tools.

- Experience with QuickBooks Online, ERP systems, or similar accounting and operational systems.

- Experience working with manufacturing, distribution, wholesale, consumer products, inventory-intensive businesses, or landed-cost analysis.

- Experience analyzing freight, logistics, tariffs, duties, sourcing, or supply-chain costs.

- Experience using AI or other modern analytical tools to improve financial analysis, forecasting, scenario modeling, or reporting.

What Success Looks Like

The successful candidate should be able to take management questions such as:

“If we change our shipping method, what happens to landed cost and gross margin?”

“What selling price do we need to maintain our target gross margin?”

“Which products or customers are generating margins below our target, and why?”

“If product costs increase or decrease, what pricing changes are required to protect margin?”

“Where are our biggest opportunities to improve profitability?”

“What combination of pricing, margin improvement, sales growth, and cost reductions will allow us to achieve our annual EBITDA target?”

The expectation is not simply to provide numbers, but to build the model, analyze the results, identify the key drivers, and provide management with actionable insights.

Application Requirements

Please submit your resume along with a brief description of your FP&A and financial modeling experience.

In your application, please specifically describe:

- Financial models you have personally built.

- Your experience with pricing and gross-margin analysis.

- Your experience with forecasting and scenario/sensitivity modeling.

- Your experience building EBITDA or profitability forecasts.

- The most advanced Excel or Google Sheets model you have developed.

- Any experience with Power BI, Power Query, SQL, AI, or other analytical tools.

Examples of previous financial models or dashboards may be requested during the interview process. Please do not provide confidential information belonging to a current or former employer.

Shortlisted candidates will be required to complete a practical financial modeling assessment.

title: Operations & Administrative Specialist (Virtual Assistant) – Pest Control Company
description:
# Operations & Administrative Specialist (Virtual Assistant) – Pest Control Company

Rowland Pest Management is a local, family-owned business operating in several Florida markets. We have been in business for over 10 years and are one of the highest-ranked pest control companies in our market.



Our team members and their families are our top priority. It is our mission to grow this company as quickly as possible without losing integrity so that our team members can grow professionally and realize their full potential.



We hope you can come on this journey with us!



## About the Position



We are seeking a highly organized, detail-oriented, and dependable **Operations & Administrative Specialist** to support various aspects of our growing pest control business.



This is a versatile position involving auditing, data entry, human resources administration, reporting, and general operational support.

## Job Responsibilities

### Data Entry & Reporting

- Compile operational, sales, and employee data into reports.

- Verify information across multiple systems to ensure accuracy.

- Maintain organized digital records and company databases.

- Assist management with tracking key performance indicators and operational metrics.



### Human Resources & Employee Administration



- Assist with employee onboarding and offboarding.

- Maintain employee files, documentation, and records.

- Review employee timesheets, PTO, attendance, and holiday pay.

- Assist with payroll preparation and compensation verification.

- Track employee certifications, identification cards, and required documentation.

- Help maintain HR-related reports and administrative records.



### General Administrative & Operational Support



- Assist management with daily administrative tasks and special projects.

- Track business licenses, renewals, and compliance-related deadlines.

- Research information and prepare reports for management.

- Follow up with employees and departments to obtain missing information.

- Assist with improving internal processes and operational efficiency.

- Perform additional tasks and responsibilities as needed at management's discretion.



## Qualifications



**Preferred Industry Experience**



- Previous experience working for a U.S.-based pest control company is highly preferred.

- Experience using **FieldRoutes/PestRoutes** is a major advantage.

- Experience working in other U.S. home service industries, including HVAC, plumbing, electrical, lawn care, or similar businesses, will also be considered.

- Familiarity with recurring service agreements, technician scheduling, customer account management, and service-based operations is preferred.



**Required Skills & Experience**



- 2+ years of experience in administrative support, operations, auditing, data entry, or related roles preferred.

- Strong proficiency in Google Sheets and Microsoft Excel.

- Exceptional attention to detail and ability to identify errors and discrepancies.

- Strong analytical, organizational, and problem-solving skills.

- Excellent written and verbal English communication skills.

- Ability to manage multiple responsibilities and shifting priorities.

- Ability to work independently with minimal supervision.

- Strong time management and multitasking abilities.

- Ability to learn and navigate multiple software systems.

- High level of professionalism, integrity, and confidentiality.

- Prior night shift experience required.

- Minimum typing speed of 40 words per minute.



## What We're Looking For



Our ideal candidate is someone who:



- Has experience working behind the scenes for a pest control or home service company.

- Understands how service-based businesses operate.

- Is extremely detail-oriented and enjoys identifying mistakes and discrepancies.

- Is comfortable working with numbers, spreadsheets, and operational reports.

- Can switch between different administrative responsibilities throughout the day.

- Takes initiative and does not require constant supervision.

- Is dependable, trustworthy, and takes ownership of their work.

- Is comfortable learning new systems and procedures.



## Perks & Benefits



- 13th-month bonus

- 5 days of paid time off (PTO) during the first year

- 6 paid U.S. holidays

- Competitive starting salary

- Long-term, stable employment

- Opportunities for career advancement

- Supportive, team-oriented work environment



## Schedule & Compensation



**Compensation:** Starting at $6 USD per hour.



**Schedule:** Monday–Friday, 8:00 AM–5:00 PM U.S. Eastern Time, including a 1-hour unpaid lunch break.



Occasional additional hours or schedule adjustments may be required based on operational needs.



Applicants must be comfortable working overnight hours in the Philippines.



## Work-From-Home Requirements



- Reliable, high-speed internet connection

- High-quality microphone or headset

- Working webcam with clear video quality

- Quiet, organized, and professional home office setup

- Reliable computer capable of running multiple applications simultaneously

- Dependable and distraction-free work environment



## How to Apply



Please submit your updated resume and a cover letter or introductory message highlighting your relevant experience.



**All applicants must submit a video recording (or video link) speaking in English that is at least 60 seconds long.**



In your video, please:



1. Introduce yourself and briefly discuss your work experience.

2. Explain whether you have worked for a U.S.-based pest control or home service company.

3. Discuss your experience using FieldRoutes, PestRoutes, or other field service management software.

4. Describe your experience with auditing, spreadsheets, data entry, or administrative responsibilities.

5. Explain why you would be a good fit for this position.

Selected candidates may be invited to complete an examination, screening interview, typing test, and practical skills assessment.



**IMPORTANT: Include the word "Bug" in the subject line of your application.**



Applicants unwilling to participate in an interview or complete the required assessments need not apply.



Incomplete applications or those not following instructions will not be considered.



We look forward to welcoming another great team member to Rowland Pest Management!

title: Amazon Financial Reporting & VAT Analyst (Part-Time / Weekly)
description:
Job Type: Part-Time / Freelance (Approximately 5–10 hours per week)

Schedule: Weekly reporting, with flexible working hours



About the Role



We operate an established Amazon FBA business selling across multiple marketplaces, primarily the UK and Europe.



We're looking for an experienced Amazon financial reporting specialist to produce a comprehensive weekly business performance and profitability report, consolidating data from Amazon Seller Central.



This is not a full-time position. We need someone who can independently extract, reconcile, and analyse Amazon financial data to give us an accurate understanding of business performance.



Strong Amazon Seller Central experience and knowledge of UK/EU VAT are essential.



Key Responsibilities



1. Weekly Financial Reporting (Primary Responsibility)



Prepare a consolidated weekly financial report covering all our Amazon marketplaces, with individual marketplace breakdowns.



The report should include:



Total revenue (VAT-inclusive and VAT-exclusive)



Units sold and orders



Cost of Goods Sold (COGS)



Amazon referral and FBA fulfilment fees



Advertising expenditure



Storage fees and other Amazon charges



Refunds, returns and reimbursements



VAT liabilities and recoverable VAT



Net profit and profit margins



Week-over-week performance comparisons



The priority is an accurate macro-level financial picture for each marketplace and the overall business.



Where possible, we'd also like profitability broken down by individual ASIN/SKU.



2. UK & European VAT Analysis



We are particularly interested in candidates with practical experience managing VAT calculations for Amazon sellers operating in the UK and EU.



Responsibilities include:



Understanding VAT implications of sales across different European marketplaces.



Distinguishing VAT-inclusive revenue from actual revenue earned.



Identifying VAT charged on Amazon fees, advertising and other services.



Identifying potentially recoverable input VAT and applicable reverse-charge treatment.



Providing accurate VAT breakdowns by marketplace/country.



Highlighting VAT-related discrepancies or potential issues for accountant review.



Experience with high-volume, low-ticket Amazon products is particularly valuable, where VAT and fees significantly affect profitability.



3. Additional Performance Analysis (Secondary)



Ideally, the weekly report will also highlight:



Sales and profitability trends



Significant changes in fees or advertising costs



Refund and return trends



Customer complaints or recurring product issues



Underperforming or high-performing ASINs



Any financial irregularities or opportunities to improve margins



Requirements



Proven experience working with Amazon Seller Central financial reports.



Ability to independently locate, download and interpret all relevant Amazon reports, including settlement, transaction, fee, advertising and VAT reports.



Strong experience with UK/EU Amazon VAT treatment.



Excellent Excel or Google Sheets skills.



Understanding of Amazon FBA cost structures and profitability calculations.



Ability to reconcile different Amazon reports and explain discrepancies.



Highly analytical, detail-oriented and comfortable working independently.



Experience with Amazon accounting tools such as A2X, Link My Books, or Sellerboard is a plus, but not essential.



What We're Looking For



We don't need a general virtual assistant or someone who simply copies numbers into a spreadsheet.



We need someone who understands Amazon financial reporting, knows where to find the correct data, and can turn that data into an accurate, meaningful picture of business profitability.



You should be able to develop the reporting template initially and then update it independently every week.



How to Apply



Please answer the following questions:



How many years of experience do you have with Amazon Seller Central financial reporting?



Have you prepared profitability reports for sellers operating across the UK and EU?



What experience do you have with UK/EU VAT, particularly VAT on sales, Amazon fees and advertising?



Which Amazon Seller Central reports would you use to calculate accurate weekly net profit?
