title: Video Editor
description:
# Experienced Video Editor — YouTube Interviews | Excellent English Required



**Position:** Long-Form YouTube Video Editor  

**Work Arrangement:** Remote, Philippines  

**Initial Engagement:** Paid trial, followed by ongoing work for the right person  

**Compensation:** Negotiable based on experience and demonstrated ability



## About CleanCarnivore



CleanCarnivore is a growing YouTube channel featuring personal transformation stories, health journeys, and conversations with people throughout the carnivore community.



I'm a 78-year-old American creator who interviews guests from around the world. Our interviews typically run 45–75 minutes, and we publish new content regularly.



Our audience is primarily English-speaking, with a significant number of viewers in the United States.



I'm looking for an experienced, dependable video editor who can take responsibility for the technical editing process while preserving the natural conversation, personality, and emotional impact of each interview.



This is an ongoing opportunity for the right person.



## English Fluency Is Essential



**Excellent written and spoken English is my highest priority.**



You must understand conversational American English, including slang, idioms, humor, incomplete sentences, and the natural rhythm of spoken conversation.



This is essential because you will make editorial decisions about what should be removed, what should remain, and how sentences and conversations flow together.



You must also communicate clearly in English, understand detailed written instructions, ask intelligent questions when clarification is necessary, and provide timely progress updates.



If you cannot comfortably understand and edit an hour-long English conversation, this position is not a good fit.



## Primary Responsibilities



Your primary assignment will be editing long-form YouTube interviews.



You will:



- Review the complete interview before making significant editorial decisions.

- **Manually identify and remove unnecessary filler words**, including ums, ahs, repeated words, false starts, and distracting verbal habits.

- Preserve natural speech patterns and conversational flow.

- Remove unnecessary pauses, awkward interruptions, and obvious technical distractions.

- Make clean, professional cuts without chopping sentences unnaturally.

- Recognize when removing a word or phrase requires adjusting the surrounding edit.

- Maintain the guest's intended meaning and emotional expression.

- Identify and correct awkward transitions where possible without changing the substance of the conversation.

- Balance audio levels between speakers.

- Improve audio clarity and reduce background noise where appropriate.

- Check the completed video for editing errors, unnatural cuts, missing words, and audio problems.

- Deliver an organized, high-quality edited video ready for final creative review.



**Important: Filler-word removal must demonstrate your own listening, judgment, and editing skills.**



I am not looking for someone who simply runs an automated AI filler-word removal tool and accepts the results.



AI may assist with appropriate technical tasks, but it must not substitute for your editorial judgment.



You must personally review your edits and ensure that the resulting conversation sounds natural.



## Creative Responsibilities



I generally create my own opening hooks because I enjoy selecting and assembling the most compelling moments from each interview.



Your responsibility will primarily be preparing the interview itself.



However, you should be able to recognize emotionally powerful moments, surprising statements, and particularly interesting exchanges that could make excellent hooks or short promotional clips.



Please identify these moments with accurate timestamps.



Occasionally, you may also be asked to prepare YouTube Shorts,
 Reels, Instagram Reels, or short promotional videos.



Experience with user-generated content (UGC) advertising is a plus but is not required for the initial position.



## Software and Technical Skills



Experience with CapCut Desktop is preferred.



Experience with Adobe Premiere Pro or DaVinci Resolve is also welcome.



You must be comfortable with:



- Editing long-form, conversational videos.

- Working with separate audio and video tracks when available.

- Audio cleanup and volume balancing.

- Precise cuts and smooth transitions.

- Exporting high-quality YouTube videos.

- Organizing project files and sharing large files through Google Drive.



You must have a reliable computer capable of handling long-form video editing.



## Internet Reliability and Backup Requirements



**A dependable, high-speed internet connection is mandatory.**



You will regularly download and upload large video files, communicate with me, and deliver completed projects through Google Drive.



Because production deadlines are important, you must also have practical alternatives available when your primary internet connection fails.



These may include:



- A secondary internet provider.

- A mobile data connection capable of functioning as a hotspot.

- Access to another reliable location with internet service.

- Backup power or an alternative workspace during electrical outages.



Occasional interruptions are understandable. However, repeated internet failures, power outages, or equipment problems cannot become recurring reasons for missed deadlines.



You must be prepared to communicate promptly when technical problems occur and explain how you intend to continue working.



**Please describe your primary internet connection, backup internet arrangements, and contingency plans for power outages in your application.**



## Communication and Dependability



I maintain a regular production schedule, and reliability is extremely important.



I expect you to acknowledge assignments promptly, provide realistic completion estimates, communicate problems before deadlines are missed, and deliver work when promised.



I do not want to spend my time repeatedly requesting updates or reminding someone to complete an assignment.



If you encounter a problem, tell me. If you need clarification, ask.



I value initiative, honesty, consistency, and professional communication.



## How to Apply



Please include the following in your application:



1. A brief introduction describing your editing experience and English proficiency.

2. Links to two or three examples of long-form English-language interviews you personally edited.

3. The software you use and your experience with manual filler-word removal.

4. Your typical turnaround time for editing a 60-minute, two-person interview.

5. Your proposed rate for editing one complete 60-minute interview.

6. A description of how you ensure that cuts and transitions sound natural.

7. Your favorite color and why you like it.

8. Your availability for ongoing assignments.

9. Details of your primary internet connection, backup internet options, and arrangements for power interruptions.



Please be specific about which portions of your portfolio you personally edited.



Generic applications that do not address the requirements will not be considered.



## Paid Editing Trial



Shortlisted candidates will be invited to complete a paid editing test using actual CleanCarnivore interview footage.



The test will evaluate your understanding of spoken English, ability to remove filler words manually, quality of cuts, preservation of conversational meaning, audio quality, attention to detail, and ability to follow instructions.



The strongest candidate will be offered ongoing work.



**I'm looking for a professional editor who takes pride in doing the job correctly, communicates well, and can become a dependable part of the CleanCarnivore production team.**



Steve  

CleanCarnivore  

*Simple. Clean. Carnivore.*

title: Sales Closer, Phone and Telegram Calls (Full-Time, $1,000 Base + 20% Commission)
description:
We run an online service business for social media creators, agencies and brands. We fix banned and restricted accounts, protect accounts from bans, and grow accounts. We have thousands of leads and past customers, and nobody is calling them. That's your job.



THIS IS A PURE SALES JOB ON THE PHONE. No customer support and no chat replies. Our team and our AI handle that. You call, you book, you close. If you don't want sales targets, please do not apply.



WHAT YOU WILL DO

1) Cold call all day. Every shift you get a fresh list of leads and past buyers. You call them on
, open with their own history ("you bought X from us in May, still holding up?"), and find out what they need now.

2) Book as many calls as possible. If someone can't talk now, you book a set time and call them back. A short message to set the time is fine; selling happens on the call.

3) Get on calls and close. Run 20-minute sales calls, find the problem, send them to the right page in our app to pay, and price custom or big jobs. Deals over $5,000 you set up for the owner.

4) Log every call. Each call gets an outcome and a next date in our CRM. No lead is left without a next step.



TARGETS

- 80–120 call attempts a shift

- 8–12 calls held a day

- Every booked call happens, on time



PAY

- Base: $1,000 a month.

- Commission: 20% of the profit on every deal you close. No cap.

- Commission is paid monthly, once the customer's money has cleared plus 14 days. It is taken back on a refund or chargeback.

- Example only, not a promise: if your deals make $10,000 profit in a month, you earn $2,000 commission on top of your $1,000 base.



YOU MUST HAVE

- Real cold-calling or phone-closing results. Tell us your numbers: dials a day, calls booked, close rate, monthly revenue.

- Excellent spoken English: confident, warm, no script-reading voice.

- Daily use of ChatGPT or Claude to prepare calls and work faster, and you can show us how.

- Reliable night-shift availability, a quiet place to call, a good headset, stable internet and a backup connection.

- The confidence to push back on us when we are wrong, and to ask for a raise when you have earned it.



BIG PLUS

Experience selling to creators, creator agencies or social media businesses. Knowing how Instagram bans and appeals work.



BEING HONEST ABOUT THE JOB

- Many people won't pick up, and some will be rude. You need a thick skin and steady energy.

- Customers are often stressed: their account (and income) is gone. We never promise results or times we can't keep.

- It's a night shift, and the first month is hard.



HOW WE HIRE

Recorded voice test (5 minutes) → 3-day paid trial calling real leads → 20-minute call with the owner → start, with a 2-week probation.



TO APPLY, start your application with the word "CLOSER" and answer in your own words:

1. What have you sold by phone, at what price, and what were your numbers (dials a day, calls booked, close rate, revenue)?

2. Record a 1–2 minute voice note: call us as if we were a past customer whose account got banned last month. Send the link (Google Drive, Loom or Vocaroo).

3. Someone on the call says "how do I know you're not a scam?" What do you say?

4. Tell us about a time you told a boss they were wrong. What happened?

5. What would make you ask for a raise, and how would you ask?

6. Can you work 14:00–22:00 UTC, 6 days a week? Where are you based, and what is your internet backup?

Short-Form Video Editor for Instagram Reels | Long-Term | 5–7 Reels per Week



We’re looking for a reliable video editor to join us long-term. You’ll edit short-form content, mainly Instagram Reels, and help us refine and finalize our brand’s editing style as we grow.



ABOUT US

We’re a relationship coaching brand built around numerology. Our content covers love, compatibility, and personal growth. Check out our main 
 to get a feel for our style and the kind of Reels we make.



ABOUT THE ROLE

You’ll assemble Reels from assets we provide. Every Reel comes with a clear editing brief (exact instructions, footage, audio, text, and references), so you don’t need to come up with the concept. We need someone with a good creative eye who follows a brief closely and still adds touches that make the Reel better. You’ll work day to day with Christy, our operations lead, and with Lily, our founder.



Because this is long-term, we want someone who will stay with us, give input, and help shape our editing style over time.



WHAT WE’RE LOOKING FOR



* Proven experience editing short-form vertical video (Reels, TikTok, Shorts)

* Comfortable in CapCut, Premiere Pro, or similar

* Strong sense of pacing, hooks, trends, and captions

* Fluent written and spoken English (Tagalog a plus)

* Reliable, communicates clearly, and meets deadlines

* Takes feedback well and handles revisions without fuss

* Stable internet and a backup plan for brownouts

* Wants a long-term working relationship, not a short gig





WORKLOAD AND PAY



* 5–7 Reels per week, turned around within 48 hours of receiving the brief

* $8–10 USD per Reel to start, depending on experience

* Rate review after 90 days based on quality and reliability

* Long-term, ongoing work





HIRING PROCESS



* Applications close Monday, November 23, at 11:59 PM Philippine time.

* Shortlisted applicants complete a short PAID test edit. Everyone gets the same footage and brief so we can compare fairly.

* The test goes out Tuesday, November 24, and is due Wednesday, November 25, at 11:59 PM Philippine time. * If you apply, please keep some time free on those two days.

* Top candidates move on to a paid trial period.





HOW TO APPLY

Apply through OnlineJobs.ph. Start your message with the word “Reels” so we know you’ve read the full post, and answer these in order, numbered:



1. Links to 2–3 short-form vertical videos you edited (Google Drive, Instagram, or TikTok links. Set Drive links to “Anyone with the link can view.”)

2. What you did on each one (full edit from raw footage, captions only, etc.)

3. Editing software you use

4. Your availability (hours per week) and usual turnaround per Reel

5. Your expected rate per Reel

6. Pick one Reel 
 and tell us one thing you’d change in the edit, and why (2–3 sentences)

7. One line on why you want a long-term role





Applications that don’t start with “Reels” or skip the numbered answers won’t be reviewed.

title: SEO Manager - Senior SEO Specialist
description:
**Full time | Remote, Philippines | 40 hours per week**



### About Marketix Digital



Marketix Digital is a Sydney-based SEO and Search Intelligence agency working with Australian businesses, including industrial, manufacturing, equipment, B2B and eCommerce companies.



Our work connects search demand, competitive analysis and SEO execution to commercial outcomes: valuable enquiries, sales and business growth.



We are looking for an experienced SEO Manager / Senior SEO Specialist to take ownership of client SEO campaigns, from understanding the problem through to implementation and reporting.



You will work directly with our Managing Director and be responsible for moving accounts forward.



### The role



This is a hands-on senior position. You will analyse websites, diagnose performance issues, develop priorities, write and improve content, implement changes and prepare client reports.



You need to be comfortable taking an account, understanding the business, identifying what is holding it back and working through the solution.



For each account, you should be able to explain:



- What are we trying to achieve commercially?

- What is currently limiting performance?

- What evidence supports that diagnosis?

- What should we do next, and why?

- What have we implemented, and has it worked?



### What you will own



**SEO diagnosis and analysis**



Investigate weak rankings, traffic changes, underperforming commercial pages and gaps in enquiries or conversions.



Use Google Search Console, GA4, crawl data, competitor research and manual website reviews to understand what is happening. Assess technical issues, search intent, content quality, website structure, internal linking and authority.



Develop clear hypotheses, identify the evidence needed to test them and distinguish confirmed findings from assumptions.



**Strategy and prioritisation**



Understand each client’s products, services, customers and commercial priorities.



Build and maintain a practical SEO plan that prioritises work by its likely impact, urgency and effort. Explain your recommendations and adjust the plan when the evidence changes.



Manage your workload across accounts, keep deadlines visible and raise dependencies or capacity issues early.



**Content research, writing and optimisation**



Take responsibility for content from research through to publication and review.



This includes:



- Keyword research, search intent analysis and keyword mapping.

- Planning commercial pages, service pages, category pages and supporting informational content.

- Researching unfamiliar industries and understanding what their customers need to know.

- Personally writing, editing and improving content for Australian audiences.

- Checking facts, sources, claims and figures.

- Optimising headings, metadata, internal links and calls to action.

- Publishing and checking content in WordPress or the relevant CMS.



You must be able to produce clear, useful content that accurately represents the client’s business and helps customers make decisions.



**Implementation and quality control**



Carry out on-page and CMS changes yourself where appropriate.



Identify and address issues involving indexation, canonicals, redirects, duplicate content, internal linking, site architecture and structured data.



For changes requiring development support, provide clear instructions, explain the intended outcome and verify the completed work.



Assess backlink profiles and authority gaps, and deliver agreed link acquisition or digital PR activity with attention to relevance and quality.



Check your work after implementation and monitor whether it produces the expected result.



**Client reporting and communication**



Prepare clear monthly reports that explain:



- What changed in performance.

- What the available evidence tells us about why it changed.

- What work was completed and why it mattered.

- What is working, what remains unresolved and what needs attention.

- What we recommend doing next.



Connect reporting to enquiries, conversions and commercial priorities wherever reliable data is available. Explain the limits of the data when necessary.



Be comfortable discussing your findings, answering client questions and communicating concerns early.



**Processes and accountability**



Keep account plans, task records and documentation current.



Follow established processes, improve them where needed and document repeatable work so another team member can understand what was done.



When something is underperforming, investigate it, communicate what you have found and recommend the next action.



### What we are looking for



- Substantial hands-on SEO experience, including independently managing client campaigns.

- Strong diagnostic skills and the ability to explain your reasoning.

- Practical knowledge of technical SEO, content strategy, on-page optimisation, internal linking and authority building.

- Confidence using Google Search Console, GA4, Ahrefs or Semrush, Screaming Frog and spreadsheets.

- Experience implementing changes in WordPress or similar platforms.

- Strong written English, with the ability to produce content and reports suitable for Australian clients.

- The ability to research unfamiliar businesses and understand their products, customers and sales process.

- Good judgement about priorities, deadlines and when to ask for input.

- A habit of checking your own work and following through on recommendations.

- Reliable internet and availability for agreed working hours overlapping with Sydney business hours.



Agency experience and work with Australian businesses would be valuable. Experience with industrial, manufacturing, B2B, local service or eCommerce websites would also be useful.



You should be comfortable using AI tools in your work while taking responsibility for the accuracy, reasoning and quality of the final output.



### Working with Marketix



You will work directly with a Managing Director with more than 20 years of SEO experience.



You will have scope to recommend priorities, challenge assumptions with evidence and improve how we deliver client work.



The role offers exposure to Search Intelligence, original research, digital PR and evolving search behaviour, alongside responsibility for ongoing SEO delivery.



We are looking for someone who wants a long-term role and takes pride in understanding an account thoroughly.



### How to apply



**Your application subject line must include the word ENTITY.**



Write your application specifically for this position and answer the questions below.



**Write the answers yourself. Do not use ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini or another AI writing tool to generate, rewrite or polish them.** We want to assess your own experience, judgement and communication. Straightforward language and specific examples are welcome.



**1. Your experience**



Briefly explain your SEO background, the types of businesses you have worked with and the parts of their campaigns you personally owned. Include your strongest area of SEO and one area you are still developing.



**2. A problem you personally diagnosed and resolved**



Describe a difficult SEO problem you worked on.



What was happening? What did you investigate? What did the evidence show? What did you personally change, and what happened afterwards?



Include the timeframe and relevant figures where available. Be clear about your contribution and anything that remained unresolved.



**3. Examples of your work**



Share three websites you have worked on and briefly explain your contribution to each.



Include one example of content you personally wrote or substantially improved, plus a short client report or reporting extract you produced. Explain what these examples demonstrate.



Anonymised or redacted examples are welcome where client confidentiality applies.



**4. A short diagnostic question**



A client’s organic traffic has increased over the past three months, but qualified enquiries have fallen.



What would you investigate first, why, and what evidence would help you d
 what to do next?



Keep this answer under 200 words.



**5. Practical details**



Include your CV or profile, expected monthly salary in PHP, current availability, notice period and earliest start date.



Shortlisted applicants will be asked to talk through their examples and reasoning during an interview.



Applications must include ENTITY in the subject line and address the questions above. Generic cover letters will not be shortlisted.

title: HR Specialist - Marketing Agency - Remote
description:
## About CGA



We're a performance marketing agency for cash-pay healthcare clinics. We run patient acquisition for chiropractic, neurofeedback, functional medicine, HBOT, and aesthetic practices across the US. 65 active clients. Profitable, growing, and intentionally building a small team of high performers.



We're scaling from roughly 15 people toward 25 to 30. Founded 2019. Headquartered in Milwaukee, Wisconsin.



## Our Core Values



These are not posters. They are how we d
. You will screen every candidate against them, so you need to believe in them yourself.



1. **Put the Patient First.** MRR and CPL are the scoreboard. A person in need reaching a provider is the game.

2. **Own the Result.** Outcomes, not effort. Never hand over a problem with nothing attached.

3. **Be Direct.** Say the hard thing while it is still cheap to fix.

4. **Be Disciplined.** Do the work on the days you do not feel like it.

5. **Improve Something Every Day.** Today's version of the work, and of you, can be beaten.

6. **Move Fast and Own Failures.** Fail cheap, own it with zero spin, fix it the same day.

7. **Build Systems, Not Dependence.** If only you can do it, you have not finished it.

8. **Put the Team First.** Cover the gap, share the credit, bring energy.



## About This Role



**Fluent, natural English is a hard requirement for this seat.** Every candidate you interview is based in the US. They hear your voice on every call, and leadership reads your written screens, your notes, and your outreach. If English is not effortless for you, spoken and written, this is not your role and we will catch it in the first interview.



Right now when someone leaves, our founders stop what they're doing and go recruit. Sourcing, screening, first-round calls, chasing candidates. That's weeks of executive time and a seat sitting empty the entire time.



You exist so that never happens again.



Your job is to keep a warm bench of pre-interviewed A-players for every seat we run. When someone resigns, we don't start a search. We call three people you already vetted.



This is not a job-posting-and-waiting role. You source, you screen, you interview, and you keep the bench stocked whether or not a seat is open today. Most of the people you interview will not get hired this month. That's the design. You're building inventory, not filling a req.



**This role requires direct experience recruiting for a marketing agency.** Agency seats do not hire like corporate seats. A media buyer, a commission closer, and a video editor each need a different filter, and the people who are great at them rarely look great on paper the same way. We will sharpen your filter. We will not build it from scratch.



You own this function end to end: sourcing, outreach, screening, interviewing, pipeline, reporting. You work directly with leadership. There is no HR manager above you.



## You Screen For Five Different Seats



This is the part most recruiters underestimate. You are not filling one kind of role over and over. You run a bench across five distinct seats, and the filter is different for each one.



**Client Success Manager.** You're testing for retention instinct and calm under pressure. Can they hold a hard conversation with an unhappy clinic owner without caving or getting defensive? Do they read data and translate it into plain language a doctor understands?



**Media Buyer.** You're testing for technical depth and judgment, not platform vocabulary. Ask for specific accounts, specific spend, specific CPA movement, and what they did when performance dropped. Anyone can say "Meta Ads Manager." Few can walk you through a real account they turned around.



**Video Editor.** You're testing on the work, not the resume. Portfolio first, then pace, revision tolerance, and whether they can match an existing style instead of imposing their own.



**Sales Setter.** You're testing for phone presence, resilience, and tonality. This one is best screened live. Can they handle a cold objection on the call with you without folding? Volume rejection is the job, so you're looking for someone who doesn't flinch.



**Closer.** You're testing for discovery skill and real numbers. Close rates, average deal size, how they handle price resistance. You want evidence they diagnose before they pitch.



Almost every candidate you interview is US-based, and most are in sales seats. You need to read American communication norms well enough to tell confidence from arrogance and polish from rehearsal. We'll test for this in your interview.



We'll calibrate you on all five seats in your first two weeks: the scorecards, the questions that actually separate real from rehearsed, and what we've learned from the hires that worked and the ones that didn't. After that, you own the filter.



**You need direct experience hiring for these seats, or seats like them at another agency.** We'll sharpen your filter. We won't build it from scratch. If your recruiting background is corporate roles, technical roles, or one function repeated, this seat will break you by week three.



## What You'll Actually Do



### Sourcing and Outreach



- Source through LinkedIn, job boards, referrals, and industry communities. Active outbound every single day.

- Build the lists, send the messages, work the follow-up

- Personally handle high-value outreach. The A-player who isn't looking doesn't respond to a template.

- Test channels and report what produces hires, not what produces applications



**The interview minimum is the floor of this job: 3 qualified first-round interviews per week for every active role, and 1 per week for every non-active role on the bench.** The exception is a seat we can fill fast from scratch, and we'll tell you which ones those are. You hit this whether or not anyone has resigned.



- Review Typeform applications and Loom submissions, and kill the weak ones fast

- Score every candidate against that role's scorecard and against our core values

- Run first-rounds solo. We calibrate you in your first two weeks, then you own the filter.

- Surface only candidates worth leadership's time. Leadership spends 30 minutes on a strong person, not 3 hours filtering.



### Interviewing and Screening



### Bench Management and Candidate Experience



- Maintain a live bench of at least 3 interviewed, scored, ready-to-call candidates for every active role, and at least 1 for every non-active role

- Nobody goes dark. Every person in the pipeline knows where they stand.

- Keep the tracker clean: every candidate logged, scored, with a visible next step

- Stay in contact with bench candidates so they pick up when a seat opens

- Write rejections people respect. Everyone we decline is a future referral source or a future client.



### Reporting and Process Improvement



- Weekly pipeline report: bench depth by role, interviews run, channel performance, bottlenecks

- Flag problems with the 1-3-1: one problem, three solutions, the one you recommend

- Improve the screening questions, the outreach templates, the scorecards. You don't wait for permission.



## The Deliverable Bar



**Every week:**



- **3 qualified first-round interviews per active role**

- **1 qualified first-round interview per non-active role**, unless it's a seat we can fill fast from scratch

- Daily outbound sourcing activity

- Weekly pipeline report delivered, complete and actionable

- Tracker current, no candidate without a next step



**Every month:**



- **Bench at 3 or more ready-to-call candidates per active role**

- **Bench at 1 or more ready-to-call candidate per non-active role**

- Zero open roles sitting without qualified candidates in motion

- Zero candidates gone dark



A qualified interview means: cleared the Typeform and Loom screen, has role-relevant experience with numbers attached, and you would put them in front of leadership today.



We pull one interview recording at random each week. Padding the number to hit the number is the fastest way out of this seat.



## The Screening Filter



You're the first real gate. You're filtering for evidence, not vibes.



**Move forward:**



- Demonstrated experience in the role category with numbers attached

- Career progression that makes sense

- Clear communication, written and spoken

- Specific accomplishments, not generic skills-speak

- Evidence they actually read the job description

- Ownership language. "I built." "I missed." "I fixed." Not "we" and "they."



**Kill fast:**



- Generic applications with copy-paste energy

- Vague claims with zero proof

- Frequent short tenures with no explanation

- No measurable accomplishments anywhere

- Victim mentality. Every bad outcome was someone else's fault.

- Entitlement. They lead with what they want before they show what they do.



**Gray area, move to interview:**



- Right skills, slight experience gap

- Unclear career story but strong accomplishments

- Recent transition with relevant background



Rule of thumb: if you're unsure, interview them. The interview answers ambiguity. If it's a clear no, kill it fast and kill it warm.



## Compensation



**Base:** $2,500/month, paid monthly via invoice.



**90-Day Retention Bonus: $400 per hire.** Paid when someone you sourced and screened reaches 90 days and hits their performance milestones.



**On-target earnings: $32,000 to $34,000 annually. We expect to fill 10 seats a year at most.**



The bonus pays on one thing: the people you place are still here and performing at 90 days. Nothing else.



We don't pay for bodies through the door and we don't pay for speed. If you push someone through who washes out at day 60, you lose the money and we lose the seat. That math should shape every candidate you advance.



## Who You Are



- You've recruited before and you can show your work: roles filled, how you sourced them, whether they lasted

- You've hired agency people before. Sales, media buying, creative, and client-facing seats all live on your bench, and you've filled them for real.

- You've interviewed US-based candidates and can read American communication norms

- You have real interviewing instincts. You know which questions separate the genuine article from a well-rehearsed resume.

- You're relentless on sourcing. Outbound is the job, not the backup plan.

- You're comfortable interviewing people for seats that aren't open yet, and you stay in touch well enough that they pick up when one does

- You're organized and fast. Five role categories, dozens of candidates, nothing dropped.

- You communicate warmly and professionally. Your rejection
s don't suck.

- You're coachable. We'll say "tighten your screen" or "move faster." The right answer is "done, here's what I changed."

- You respect the bar. You don't sneak weak candidates through to look productive.



## Hard Requirements



- Location is open. We screen on English, timezone overlap, and track record, not country.

- Fluent, natural English, spoken and written. This is the single hardest requirement in the posting. You are on video with US candidates all day and your written screens go straight to leadership. A heavy accent is fine. Hesitation, grammar errors, or candidates asking you to repeat yourself is not.

- Live overlap with US Central Time sufficient to interview US-based candidates and sync with our team

- **Direct experience recruiting for a marketing agency, or for the seats agencies run: client success, media buying, paid social, commission sales, creative production.** This is a hard filter. We are not teaching you what a strong media buyer or a strong closer looks like from zero.

- Recruiting, talent acquisition, or hiring operations experience with proof attached

- Reliable internet, quiet space, working camera. You're on video all day.

- Comfortable with recruiting tools: LinkedIn (Recruiter a plus), an ATS or Airtable-style tracker, Google Workspace, Loom, Zoom, Calendly. You don't need to be an expert on day one. You need to pick things up fast.

- You run first-rounds solo by week two



## Who This Isn't For



- Your recruiting experience is all corporate, technical, or one repeated function. We need someone who has hired agency people.

- You post jobs and wait. Sourcing is the majority of this role.

- You only like interviewing for open seats. Most of your interviews feed a bench.

- You go quiet on candidates the moment there's no offer to dangle.

- You pass people through to look busy. A washout at day 60 costs you money here.

- You can't say no. Our bar is real. Your job is to enforce it warmly, not erode it.

- You go quiet when something stalls instead of flagging it with a fix.

- You get defensive about feedback.

- You're uncomfortable being measured. This role is measurable by design. That's the feature.

- You want to be a talent strategist. You're an operator who sources, screens, and moves people.

- You need a hiring manager on every first-round call.



## What We Offer Beyond Comp



**You build the engine.** The channels, the filter, the templates, the bench you create become the standard as we double the team.



**Direct founder relationship.** You work with leadership and see how hiring decisions actually get made.



**High leverage.** One person's judgment compounds across every seat in the company.



**Control over your process.** See a better way to source or screen? Implement it.



**Room to grow.** As we scale past 30, this role grows into owning the full people function: onboarding, 30/60/90 tracking, performance cadence.



## What Success Looks Like



**Month 1:**



- Calibrate with leadership on what strong looks like for all five role categories

- Audit the current pipeline and every active posting

- Run your first solo first-rounds by week two

- Stand up the tracker: every candidate logged, scored, decision path visible

- Build the weekly report template

- Start daily outbound on the two highest-priority categories



**Months 2 to 3:**



- Hit the weekly interview minimum across every active and non-active role

- Bench at 3 or more per active role, 1 or more per non-active role

- Know which channels produce hires and reallocate effort

- First placements made and tracked to their 30-day marks



**Ongoing:**



- A seat opens and we fill it fast because the people were already warm

- Improve conversion month over month: outreach to reply, reply to interview, interview to bench

- Your hires reach 90 days and hit their milestones

- Founders never touch recruiting again



## How to Apply



Apply here: 



The application includes a short video submission and questions about your sourcing and interviewing process. Name the agency-side roles you've personally filled and tell us how many of those people were still in the seat at 90 days.



Incomplete applications are not reviewed.



### Quick Facts



- **Company:** Clinic Growth Accelerator

- **Founded:** 2019

- **Founders:** Nick Urso (COO), Jeff Van Kampen (CRO)

- **Headquarters:** Milwaukee, Wisconsin

- **Work Mode:** Fully remote, offshore

- **Contract Type:** Independent Contractor, full-time

- **Hiring Timeline:** 1 to 2 weeks from application to contract



## Final Thought



One wrong hire in a 15-person company is 7% of the team, and the damage doesn't stay in their lane. One empty seat for six weeks is worse.



Right now our founders are still doing recruiting. That's time not spent on strategy, clients, or building the business. You absorb all of it.



If you're good, a resignation stops being a fire drill. It becomes a phone call to someone you already vetted.



That's the win, and that's what we pay for. If you want to build a talent engine for a fast-moving company, apply and show us your work.

title: Appointment Setter | $5 an Hour + $150 Commission | Neutral Accent Only (Voice Sample Required)
description:
Apollo Media

Appointment Setter



Overview

Apollo Media is a marketing company catered toward the kitchen and bathroom remodeling industry. We help business owners by building professional websites, automating customer relationship management, running
 ads, and helping them rank higher on Google. We are looking to hire two experienced cold callers to prospect local American businesses and set appointments for our sales team.



What We're Looking For

2+ years of cold calling, telemarketing, or appointment setting experience.

Excellent spoken and written American English: clear, neutral, and easy for U.S. business owners to understand.

Confident, professional phone presence and ability to follow a script without sounding robotic or overly "salesy."

Organized and proactive employees who are comfortable managing daily outreach activity with minimal supervision.



What You'll Do

Make outbound cold calls to U.S. kitchen and bathroom remodeling business owners using provided leads and scripts.

Introduce Apollo Media's services and explain how we help remodelers capture more inquiries and book more jobs.

Qualify prospects, handle basic objections, and book qualified discovery calls for our sales team.

Follow up with warm leads and past inquiries.

Maintain accurate records of every call, conversation, and appointment in our CRM (GoHighLevel).

Collaborate with the sales team to refine outreach and improve booking rates.



Performance Expectations

Specific targets will be set after training. Performance is measured on:

Completed outbound calls per day

Booked appointment show rate (those who actually attend)

Organized follow-up completion



Is This Job Right for You?

We'll let you know now, this job is hard. Most of your calls will end in a no, a hang-up, a gatekeeper, or voi
, and you have to keep dialing for the full 4 hours anyway with no one standing over you. Every call is logged and reviewed, and your performance is tracked daily. If you need someone pushing you to stay on task, do not apply. This is for hard workers who are willing and ready to learn and study their sales craft on their own to get better. If you put in the work and work well with us, we will do well by you.



Equipment & Workspace

Reliable power setup with a UPS (uninterruptible power supply) to bridge short outages without dropping calls; backup power for longer interruptions is strongly preferred.

Reliable wired internet connection (minimum 25 Mbps; 50+ Mbps preferred).

Quiet, dedicated workspace for calls.

Quality headset with microphone.

Desktop or laptop computer (Windows 10/11 or macOS).

Backup internet (mobile hotspot or secondary connection) in case of outages.



Compensation & Schedule

Pay: $5 USD per hour, part time

Performance bonus: $150 USD for each qualified appointment that turns into a closed sale.

ADDITIONAL BONUS - Pay Increase: Hit 12+ held demos in a month on your part-time schedule and earn $5.50/hour the next month. Hit 20+ and earn $6/hour the next month.

Hours: Monday to Friday, U.S. 10 AM to 2 PM EST / 11 PM to 3 AM PHT

Breaks: One paid 15-minute break per shift

Remote position



IMPORTANT

This role requires strong, reliable internet and clear English with a neutral accent that U.S. business owners can easily understand. When you apply, upload a voice sample and enter the code word ARTESIAN in the form.

If you do not meet these criteria, please do not apply.

Our job is to connect the two: we call Local Businesses and set up short meetings with the Local Publishers who run the magazines. The publisher handles the sales conversation. We find the right businesses and get the meeting on the calendar.

We are a small, founder-led team based in Warwick, Rhode Island. Our founders come from software sales and market research. That means you get a real script, a researched call list, and direct coaching. You will not be handed a phone book and left alone.



The role

You will call owners and managers of local US businesses on behalf of a local magazine. Your goal on every call is simple: book a 15-minute meeting between the business owner and the magazine's owner. You are not selling ads and you are not quoting prices. You are selling the meeting.

You will call businesses such as home service companies (HVAC, roofing, electricians), professional offices (dentists, attorneys, financial advisors), and restaurants, salons, and shops.



What you will do

• Make outbound calls from a researched list using our dialer

• Follow our proven call script and objection guide

• Get past front desks and receptionists to reach the owner or decision maker

• Book 15-minute meetings with the magazine owner

• Confirm each meeting: collect the prospect's
, send the calendar invitation, and ask them to accept it

• Log every call in the dialer with the correct outcome and short notes

• Join a weekly 1-hour call review and 1:1 with the founder



Schedule

• 10 hours per week, Monday to Friday

• All hours must fall between 11:00 AM and 4:00 PM US Eastern Time. That is 12:00 AM to 5:00 AM Philippine Time. Please make sure you can work these overnight hours

• Your weekly hours will be set together during onboarding



Pay

• $10–12 USD per hour, based on experience

• $50 USD bonus for every held meeting. A held meeting is one where the business owner actually shows up and meets with the magazine owner

• There is no cap on bonuses



Training and support

• A 3-hour onboarding and coaching session with the founder before you start dialing

• A weekly 1-hour call review and 1:1, where we listen to calls together and improve

• You report directly to the founder



Requirements

• At least 6 months of experience in cold calling or appointment setting

• Experience with a dialer (for example Aloware, PhoneBurner, Kixie, JustCall, Five9, or similar)

• Clear, conversational English without a heavy accent. You will be speaking with US business owners all day

• Your own computer

• A quality headset with a noise-cancelling microphone

• A stable, reliable internet connection

• A quiet, private place to work with no background noise

Nice to have: experience calling US small businesses, B2B appointment setting, or advertising and media sales.



How to apply

Applications without a voice recording will not be reviewed.

1.  Start your application message with the word "Neighborhood" so we know you read the full post.

2.  Include a voice recording of you reading the script below (see "Voice recording"). Send it as an attachment or as a link (Google Drive, Vocaroo, or similar). If you use a link, make sure anyone with the link can open it.

3.  Answer these questions in your message:

    ◦ How many months of cold calling or appointment setting experience do you have?

    ◦ Which dialers and CRMs have you used?

    ◦ What types of US businesses or industries have you called?

    ◦ Can you work between 12:00 AM and 5:00 AM Philippine Time, Monday to Friday?

4.  Attach your resume.

5.  Attach a screenshot of an internet speed test (for example from speedtest.net).



Voice recording

Record yourself in your normal work setup, using your headset, in the space you would work from. We want to hear what a prospect would hear. The full recording should be under 2 minutes.



Part 1: Introduce yourself (about 20 seconds). Say your name and your calling experience.



Part 2: Read this script out loud. Imagine the owner of a roofing company just answered the phone. Read it naturally, as if it is a real call. Do not rush.

"Hi, is this Mike? Hi Mike, this is [your name]. I'm helping a local magazine, Neighborhood Living, connect with local businesses that could use more visibility in the community. Do you have a quick minute?

A lot of contractors we talk to are spending real money on Google and social media. But that money gets spread across the whole county. It's hard to stand out in the neighborhoods where the best jobs come from.

Neighborhood Living is mailed every month to the homes of established families in your area. People trust the magazine, and that trust carries over to the businesses inside it.

Would it be worth setting up 15 minutes with the magazine's owner? She can show you how it has been working for other trusted home service pros in the area.

Great. Does Tuesday or Thursday work better for you?"



Part 3: Handle an objection (about 20 seconds). Imagine Mike says: "Just send me some information." Respond in your own words and try to get the meeting. There is no single right answer. We want to hear how you think on your feet.

title: Podcast Video Editor / VA — Final Cut Pro

title: Shortform and Trailer Video Editor
description:
Not just another "clipping" job



If you love short form content and get frustrated seeing mass produced clips that don't understand psychology, story telling and creating emotion ... this is for you.

A good clip is the difference between a great conversation nobody watches and content that builds someone's business, brand and community and that is what we create.



About Project C



After landing every podcast we've ever launched on the top charts, and working with some of Australia's favourite creators, we learned exactly what separates good content from content that actually builds your business, brand and community.



We spent years searching for a studio that understood what creators need ... then we stopped searching and started building.



We wanted to build a space that inspired every person who walked in the door, that encouraged better conversation and didn't just make you sound great but make you look and feel your best as well.

The studio has Netflix Approved 4K Cameras, the Microphones the best podcasters in the world use, lighting that makes you look like you've slept 10+ hours (even when you've only slept 4) and a team that are obsessed with helping you create content you can't wait to share.



About You.



- You love social media, learning the algorthims and creating content

- You edit for retention and engagement. You understand pace, tension, and why people keep watching instead of swiping.

- You check your work thoroughly

- You obsess over the small details. Framing, eye levels, making sure everything is optimised for the platform it is posted on and no typos

- You will always met a deadline or proactively tell us if there are ever any issues

- You have worked with a creators, a studio or agency before on high volume work across multiple clients

Our Non-Negotiables



- You use AI for efficiencies but still innovate and add in your own story telling and creativity  

- You are not an agency and you are not outsourcing the edit to someone else.

- Excellent communication. If a deadline is going to be missed, you are stuck, or you need a better brief, you tell us ASAP.

title: Heir Outreach Specialist
description:
We are hiring the person everyone tells things to.



JABO REI is a US real estate firm. We buy houses families inherited and never settled. The paperwork tells us what happened, never why a family left its largest asset untouched for ten years. Your job: be the first voice that family hears — and come back with the why, all of it, exactly as it was said.



Most callers stop at the first answer. Ours don't.



An heir says: "We just haven't gotten around to it." That's Level 1 — the reason given. Level 2 is the cause: what made it hard to get around to? "My brother won't return my calls." Level 3 is the root: why won't he? He cared for their mother in that house. He believes it's his.



Reaching Level 3 can't be scripted. It happens because the heir said one sentence that wasn't the whole story — and you noticed, and your next question walked through the door it opened.



Listening is only half of it. The other half is what you do with what you heard: the question that maps the whole family before it slips away, the fact you pin down instead of assuming, and a next step booked at a specific time before you hang up. Our best calls sound quiet. Their notes read like case files. If you already work this way — deep and precise — you know exactly what we're describing. If you don't, no training fixes it. That's why we test for it before we hire.



The work

- First calls to heirs from fully researched files — family tree, debts, documents — during US hours (overnight PH).

- You talk less than she does. No selling, no pitch, no commission — a separate team handles offers, by design.

- Every call ends with something real: a next step at a specific time, or a family that trusts you'll call back.

- Calls are recorded and graded on what you uncovered and what you booked, never on dial volume.

- Hours start at 4/day, growing as your deals close: 5 after your first, 6 after your second.



Don't apply if a script is your safety net, silence makes you fill it, commission is your fuel, or a problem that takes real thought makes you reach for the first easy answer.



Background: outbound calling experience is required — you must already be at home on live calls with strangers. Real estate and sales experience are not: sales habits usually have to be unlearned here. Our best people come from escalations, retention, intake, care coordination — anywhere the real job was hearing people in hard moments, and getting the details right.



Pay: $5/hr starting, flexible based on skill — the assessment d
 where you land. Remote.



How hiring works (same for everyone):

1. Answer the application question below.

2. A personal packet: résumé plus a free DISC assessment.

3. Three timed tests, each taken in one sitting: an aptitude test (logic and pattern problems against the clock), a Curiosity Test of real conversation fragments — you choose the next question — and a simulated first call: two scripted heir calls where every response you pick is graded the way we grade real calls — what you uncovered, what you pinned down, how much she talked, and whether you booked the next step. Most people finish these tests. Very few max them. We hire from these results more than from résumés — we're looking for the very few.

4. A short video, then an interview and a live roleplay call.



Application question (required): Tell us about a conversation where you heard the sentence everyone else missed — the one that changed what the conversation was really about. How far did you follow it, and was there anything you deliberately chose not to say? Specifics, please — vague answers are how we screen out.



— JABO REI

Appointment quality and completed sits are what count. You'll bring established cold-calling and roofing appointment-setting skills. Open conversations confidently and communicate the client's offer clearly.

Use approved scripts while keeping your delivery natural and engaging.

Handle repeated objections with timely, relevant responses.

Build trust and maintain call control without becoming confrontational.

Qualify homeowner interest and book in-home appointments with the client's sales team.

Set clear expectations so homeowners understand and attend their appointments.

Prioritize completed sits and appointment quality over booking volume alone.

Follow campaign instructions and apply coaching to strengthen your results.

Qualifications

Preferred Qualifications

Pay and Benefits



Your base is your floor. Your results create the upside.

title: Phone Sales & Booking Specialist
description:
=== JOB TITLE ===

Phone Sales & Booking Specialist (Part-Time, US Hours) - Pest Control / Home Services

 

=== JOB TYPE ===

Part-Time (independent contractor, remote). 2-week paid trial, then ongoing if it is a good fit.

 

=== SALARY ===

$3.00 USD per hour (about $90 to $150 per biweekly pay period for 30 to 50 hours), plus performance incentives

 

=== JOB DESCRIPTION (paste below) ===

 

ABOUT US

Bee Man Dan LLC is a Houston, Texas company that does bee removal and hive relocation. We locate hives with thermal imaging, we have served Houston-area families since 2015, and we are 5-star Google rated. Our operations team works remotely from the Philippines.

 

THE ROLE

We need a confident phone sales person who can call warm leads and turn them into bookings. This is a hands-on calling role: you will follow up with people who already showed interest in us, answer their questions honestly, and close. Over time the role grows into B2B outreach to referral partners.

 

WHAT YOU WILL DO (in order of priority)

1. Call back people who signed up for our Buzz for Gold collectible coin promotion and have not purchased yet. Answer their questions clearly and honestly, with no pressure tactics and no promises about results. (about 2 to 3 hours a day)

2. Help close hive removal bookings: call back quotes and warm leads, follow our call script, confirm the address and ZIP code, and book the job.

3. Build lead lists of referral partners (pest control companies, property managers, real estate agents, roofers). You research and record them in a tracker. B2B calling starts in the spring.

4. Log every call and outcome in our call tracker and ClickUp, and hand off bookings and open items to the right teammate.

 

WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR

- Proven outbound phone sales or cold calling experience (B2B or B2C), at least 1 year (required)

- Customer service and inbound sales experience, comfortable asking for the sale (required)

- Clear, natural spoken English, comfortable talking with US callers (required)

- Handles rejection well, coachable, follows a script, and stays honest with customers (required)

- US pest control, home services, lead generation, or promotion/sweepstakes callback experience (strongly preferred, not required: we will train you on our process)

- Comfortable researching prospects online (Google Maps, LinkedIn, company websites) and keeping a clean Google Sheet or CRM

- Quiet workspace, headset, stable internet, and a backup connection or power

- Dependable, detail-oriented, able to work with little supervision

 

PERFORMANCE INCENTIVES

Base pay plus performance incentives for bookings and sales you close. The incentive structure is discussed directly with the selected candidate.

 

SCHEDULE

Part-time, 3 to 5 hours a day, Monday to Friday (about 15 to 25 hours a week), during Central Time (Houston) daytime hours. That means evening or overnight hours in the Philippines. Exact shift hours are confirmed at hiring.

 

TERMS

Independent contractor, paid biweekly via Wise or direct to bank. The first 2 weeks are a paid trial with a check-in at the end of week 1 and a decision at the end of week 2.

 

HOW TO APPLY (3 simple steps)

1. Start your message with the word BEE so we know you read this post.

2. Attach your resume.

3. Send a short AUDIO recording (1 to 2 minutes, voice memo or any audio file or link, no video needed). Start by saying your name and the word BEE, then answer:

   a) Tell us about your calling experience: the industry, how many calls a day, and one result you are proud of (a number if you have one).

   b) A homeowner says "I'll think about it" after hearing the price. What do you say next to move toward a booking, without pressure?

Also write your available hours for Central Time and your earliest start date in your message.

 

Applications without an audio recording are not reviewed. Shortlisted applicants complete a short live phone role-play.

title: Senior Amazon Wholesale VA / Account Growth Manager
description:
I am looking for a highly experienced, reliable, and proactive Amazon Wholesale VA who has a proven track record of scaling Amazon seller accounts into consistent **$20,000–$100,000+ monthly profit businesses.**



I have previously worked with several VAs, so I understand the difference between someone who simply completes assigned tasks and someone who genuinely understands how to grow an Amazon business. I am looking for the latter.



This is not an entry-level position. I need someone who knows what they are doing, takes ownership of their responsibilities, communicates consistently, and can operate independently without constant supervision.



What I'm Looking For



- Proven experience scaling Amazon wholesale accounts, ideally to $20K–$100K+ in monthly net profit.

- Strong experience sourcing profitable wholesale products and establishing relationships with legitimate, reputable wholesale suppliers and distributors.

- Experience working with established brands and suppliers, including opportunities similar to **Hello Pharmacist** and other quality wholesale accounts.

- Ability to identify profitable, less-saturated brands and products with sustainable demand.

- Strong understanding of ROI, profit margins, Buy Box competition, sales velocity, inventory management, and pricing strategies.

- Experience identifying new wholesale accounts and negotiating or establishing supplier relationships.

- Ability to develop and execute a sourcing strategy that consistently brings profitable inventory into the business.

- Experience managing and growing an established Amazon Seller Central account.

- Ability to recognize opportunities, solve problems, and make strategic recommendations without waiting to be told what to do.



 Our Sourcing Strategy



I am specifically looking to expand into quality wholesale accounts and brands with long-term potential.



I am NOT interested in continuing to focus heavily on oversaturated opportunities like KeHE. I want to move toward better wholesale relationships, stronger brands, less competitive products, and opportunities that provide sustainable margins.



The goal is to build a much larger and more profitable wholesale operation rather than constantly competing over the same oversaturated products as everyone else.



Expectations



- Extremely reliable and consistent. Dependability is non-negotiable.

- Strong communication and regular progress updates.

- Proactive problem-solving and independent decision-making.

- Ability to meet deadlines and follow through on commitments.

- High attention to detail when analyzing products and calculating profitability.

- Must be results-driven and understand that the ultimate goal is growing net profit.

- Must be able to demonstrate previous results, not just claim experience.



Compensation



I am willing to pay above-average hourly rates for someone with advanced experience and a proven ability to scale Amazon wholesale businesses.



I would rather pay more for someone who knows what they are doing, produces results, and can help grow the business than hire someone at a lower rate who requires constant oversight.



Compensation will depend on experience, demonstrated results, and the level of expertise you bring to the business.



 To Apply



Please include the following in your application:



1. How many years of experience do you have with Amazon Wholesale?

2. What is the largest Amazon account you have personally helped scale?

3. What were the monthly sales and, more importantly, monthly net profits you helped achieve?

4. What wholesale distributors and brands have you successfully sourced from?

5. Have you established wholesale accounts with reputable brands or distributors? Please provide examples.

6. What tools do you use for product research, sourcing, and profitability analysis?

7. How would you approach scaling an existing wholesale account to $20K–$100K+ in monthly net profit?

8. Can you provide examples, references, or verifiable results from previous clients?



*Please only apply if you have substantial, hands-on Amazon Wholesale experience. I am looking for someone who can help take an existing business to the next level, not someone who is learning the wholesale model on the job.

This role is primarily focused on keeping real estate transactions and the CEO's commitments organized and moving forward. We need someone who can independently manage deadlines, coordinate with different parties, anticipate what needs to happen next, and take ownership of tasks from start to finish.

- Coordinate with title companies, buyers, sellers, agents, vendors, and other parties involved in transactions.

- Coordinate with MLS listing agents and assist with resale settlement.

- Support wholesale assignments and double closings.

- Follow up with responsible parties to ensure tasks are completed.

- Identify blockers, clarify priorities, and escalate issues when necessary.

- Prepare concise daily updates highlighting completed tasks, pending items, and issues requiring attention.



3. Sales Administration & CRM Support

- Prepare property research packets and approved contract templates.

- Coordinate signatures, appointments, and other administrative requirements.

- Maintain accurate CRM records and basic data quality.

- Monitor lead assignments and follow-up statuses, flagging missed tasks or gaps to the appropriate team member.

- Support the sales team with administrative tasks without taking ownership of lead management or sales conversion.



4. General Operations & Recruitment Support

- Coordinate recruitment interviews and candidate communication.

- Assist with onboarding paperwork and documentation.

- Coordinate vendors, invoices, records, and project follow-ups.

- Create and maintain SOPs, checklists, and process documentation.

- Support general administrative tasks within established workflows.



5. Marketing & Digital Support (As Needed)

- Update basic website pages and forms.

- Schedule approved social media posts.

- Create simple Canva graphics and marketing materials.

- Maintain business profiles and coordinate with marketing vendors.



Qualifications

- At least 2 years of experience in US real estate transaction coordination, real estate operations, or a closely related administrative role.

- Hands-on experience supporting real estate transactions, preferably in real estate investing, wholesaling, or property resale.

- Strong organizational skills and the ability to manage multiple deadlines and priorities independently.

- Excellent written and spoken English.

- Strong attention to detail and proactive follow-through.

- Experience working with CRMs, shared files, spreadsheets, and task management systems.

- Proficiency in Google Workspace, particularly Google Sheets, Docs, and Calendar.

- Experience creating SOPs, trackers, and process documentation.

- Ability to work independently with minimal supervision and collaborate during US Eastern business hours.

- Reliable internet connection and availability for approximately 20-25 hours per week.



Nice to Have:

Experience with REsimpli or similar real estate CRMs.

Experience coordinating with title companies and settlement providers.

Familiarity with Notion and project management tools.

Experience with Canva, WordPress, or basic website management.

Familiarity with Zapier and workflow automation.

Experience with MLS listing coordination and real estate resale transactions.



Work Schedule

Part-time, approximately 20-25 hours per week.

Must have availability to overlap with US Eastern business hours.



How to Apply

If you've read this far, please include "ABC" in your cover letter title.



Please also send a quick 1-2 minute voice or video introduction telling us about yourself, your relevant real estate experience, and why you would be a good fit for this role.

title: Specialist VA and Personal Assistant (Full-Time, Australian Home Services Business)
description:
Be the friendly, clear voice that helps people live their best life.





Day shift: 6am to 2pm Philippine time, Monday to Friday. PHP 30,000 to 35,000 a month.





An Australian home cleaning and gardening business on the Gold Coast needs a right hand for its owner. You answer the business phone, run the bookings and keep the owner organised. Many of the people who call are older, live with a disability (on Australia's NDIS scheme) or are war veterans. Some of them are lonely, and a kind, patient voice on the phone matters to them.





What you get





A day shift. You finish at 2pm and your weekends are your own.

About 20 calls a day, so you have time to slow down and be kind on each one.

PHP 30,000 a month during the three-month probation, then PHP 35,000 a month.

20 days paid annual leave, 10 days paid sick leave and 13th month pay.

One warm, easy-going owner who trusts you to get on with it.

A local Australian colleague who trains you and works with you every day.

Room to grow. Once the phones and bookings run smoothly, you take on hiring, compliance and payments.

How you speak matters most





Our clients need slow, gentle, easy-to-follow English with a soft, neutral accent. A fast call-centre pace or a strong accent of any kind is hard for them to follow, and that includes a strong American accent. Your interview is where we hear how you speak, so take it somewhere quiet and speak the way you would to an 80-year-old client.





What you'll do





In your first month:

Answer and make the business's calls.

Manage bookings, and confirm each one the day before and again that morning.

Rebook the day when a cleaner is sick, and call the client when a cleaner is late.

Be the main contact for the cleaners and gardeners, and check their timesheets and clock-ins.

Sort the owner's
 and remind her before every appointment.

From month two: hiring cleaners and gardeners, keeping police checks and insurance up to date, and preparing staff pay in Xero for the owner to approve.





This is you if





People tell you that you are easy to understand on the phone.

You are the organised one. You would rather organise your boss than wait to be organised.

You can be gentle with a lonely older client and firm with a cleaner who did not clock in, in the same morning.

When something goes wrong and the owner can't be reached, you work out what to do and do it.

This is not for you if





You speak quickly, or people often ask you to repeat yourself.

You like to be told each step before you start.

You find it hard to be firm with people.

You can't work 6am to 2pm Philippine time, Monday to Friday. The hours are fixed.

Good to have, not required: call centre or phone customer service, bookings or rostering, a CRM, Xero or ShiftCare (we train you on both), care, NDIS or home services, recruitment.





How to apply





Apply on our website with the link below. You answer a few short questions, do a skills test and have a short interview. Tell us in your application that you can work 6am to 2pm Philippine time, Monday to Friday.





Apply directly on our website:

title: Amazon Online Arbitrage Product Research VA | Creative Carioca
description:
Creative Carioca is looking for an experienced Amazon Online Arbitrage Product Research Virtual Assistant for a long-term collaboration focused on manual sourcing for Amazon US. You will evaluate FBA and FBM opportunities and submit complete, accurate, purchase-ready leads. This role is for product research and does not include purchasing products.



You should already have practical Amazon US OA sourcing experience and be able to manage your research independently. We provide an English SOP with our workflow, sourcing criteria, cost rules, and submission requirements to support your work. You should be comfortable applying detailed written instructions, checking your own work, and asking clear questions when information is uncertain.



WHAT YOU WILL DO

- Manually source profitable Amazon US FBA and FBM opportunities using Keepa and AsinZen/AZInsight.

- Verify exact product matches, reliable suppliers, selling eligibility, and brand/IP risks.

- Analyze pricing, demand, and competition, and calculate profitability including all fees, prep, and shipping costs.

- Submit at least 5 complete leads daily in our Google Sheet, with clear supporting evidence, following our SOP.

- Double-check your work, communicate reliably, and flag uncertainties before submitting.



QUALITY EXPECTATIONS

Each lead must meet all three minimum requirements: 20% ROI, 10% profit margin, and US$5 profit per unit, after all applicable costs, including prep and shipping. 

However, meeting the profitability requirements alone does not make a lead approved. Each lead must also satisfy the SOP's requirements for product matching, selling eligibility, Keepa analysis, accurate total costs, source validation, and purchase readiness.



The ongoing target is at least 5 qualified leads per working day, totaling at least 25 per week. Leads must be entered into the shared Google Sheet daily. Saving leads to submit together on the final day of the week is not acceptable. Each lead is reviewed against our SOP before approval. Quality, accuracy, and complete documentation are essential.



EXPERIENCE REQUIRED

- Proven, hands-on Amazon US Online Arbitrage experience, with manual product sourcing as a core part of your work.

- Confidence interpreting Keepa charts and evaluating both FBA and FBM opportunities.

- Practical experience with AsinZen/AZInsight or comparable profitability analysis tools.

- Accurate spreadsheet documentation, careful cost calculations, and strong attention to written instructions.

- The ability to work independently and communicate consistently.



TOOLS PROVIDED

We provide access to Tactical Arbitrage, AsinZen, and Keepa, plus a shared Google Sheet for your leads and analysis. Manual sourcing remains the primary focus; these tools support your research, analysis, and validation. Our SOP will be provided privately for the work.



AVAILABILITY AND COMMITMENT

You must have enough time available to research thoroughly, complete all required checks, and consistently submit at least 5 qualified leads per working day and 25 per week. We are looking for reliable, sustained availability for a long-term collaboration.



PAID INITIAL TRIAL

The selected candidate will start with a paid 3-day trial:

- Base pay: US$20 per day, for a total of US$60 across all 3 days.

- Additional pay: US$3 for each approved lead delivered during the trial.

- Trial deliverable: at least 5 fully researched leads submitted in the shared Google Sheet on each of the 3 trial days, totaling at least 15 leads, with complete analysis following our SOP.

- Daily submission is required. Submitting all 15 leads on the final day does not meet the trial requirements.

- Example: if 15 leads are approved, total trial pay is US$60 base + US$45 in approved-lead payments = US$105.



PAYMENT AFTER THE TRIAL

If we continue working together:

- Base pay: US$100 per week.

- Additional pay: US$3 per approved lead.

- Extra bonus: US$5 if all 25 weekly leads are approved.

- Weekly payments are made every Tuesday.

- Example: 25 approved leads = US$100 base + US$75 in approved-lead payments + US$5 bonus = US$180 for the week.

- Opportunities for pay increases based on skills and performance.



HOW TO APPLY

Start your application with SOURCING, attach your résumé/CV, and briefly introduce your relevant Amazon US Online Arbitrage sourcing experience.

title: Patient Coordinator – U.S. Healthcare
description:
Work Schedule: U.S. business hours



About the Role

We are looking for a highly motivated Patient Coordinator to support prospective patients in the United States who are interested in Genicular Artery Embolization (GAE), a minimally invasive procedure used in the treatment of knee pain.



Our marketing campaigns generate prospective patient leads through online channels including
 and Instagram. These leads are captured in GoHighLevel (GHL), where Patient Coordinators will be responsible for claiming leads, making outbound calls, answering basic questions, and helping qualified patients schedule an appointment with one of our clinics.



This is a patient-facing role where success depends on your ability to communicate clearly, build trust quickly, consistently follow up, and turn patient interest into scheduled clinical appointments.



Key Responsibilities

• Monitor new patient leads coming into GoHighLevel from online advertising campaigns.

• Claim and manage assigned leads through the patient follow-up process.

• Make outbound calls to prospective patients who have expressed interest in GAE.

• Explain the next steps in the patient journey and answer basic, non-clinical questions about the process.

• Help patients understand basic U.S. healthcare and insurance concepts, such as commercial insurance, Medicare, deductibles, copays, referrals, and insurance verification.

• Identify appropriate patient questions that should be escalated to clinical or insurance verification staff.

• Build rapport with prospective patients and help them feel comfortable moving forward with an appointment.

• Effectively address common questions or concerns that may prevent a patient from scheduling.

• Schedule qualified patients for clinical visits and ensure all necessary information is accurately captured.

• Consistently follow up with patients by phone, text, or other approved communication channels.

• Keep patient records and lead statuses accurate and up to date in GoHighLevel.

• Meet established performance goals related to contact rates, follow-up activity, appointments scheduled, and patient conversion.



Qualifications

• Excellent spoken and written English, with strong phone communication skills.

• Prior experience working with U.S.-based customers or patients.

• Experience in healthcare, patient scheduling, medical call centers, insurance verification, intake, or patient coordination is strongly preferred.

• Working knowledge of the U.S. healthcare and health insurance system.

• Comfortable making a high volume of outbound calls and following up consistently with prospective patients.

• Strong interpersonal skills with the ability to establish trust and rapport over the phone.

• Goal-oriented and comfortable working toward appointment and conversion targets.

• Strong organizational skills and attention to detail.

• Comfortable learning and working in CRM and patient lead management systems. Experience with GoHighLevel is a plus.

• Able to work independently in a remote environment during U.S. business hours.



What Success Looks Like



Success in this role isn't simply making calls. The goal is to help prospective patients take the next step in their care.

A successful Patient Coordinator will:

• Respond to new leads quickly.

• Make multiple appropriate follow-up attempts when patients cannot initially be reached.

• Create a professional and positive experience for prospective patients.

• Clearly explain the scheduling process and next steps.

• Accurately document every patient interaction.

• Consistently convert qualified patient leads into scheduled clinical appointments.

• Know when a patient's clinical or insurance question needs to be escalated rather than attempting to provide medical advice.



Ideal Candidate



You will do well in this position if you enjoy speaking with people, are comfortable making outbound calls, and don't get discouraged when a patient does not answer on the first attempt.



You should be warm and empathetic while also being confident enough to guide the conversation toward a clear next step: scheduling a clinical appointment.



Previous experience supporting U.S. healthcare organizations, medical practices, patient access centers, or healthcare call centers would be especially valuable.
