As the Transaction Coordinator Lead / AI Transaction Operations Manager, you will own the accuracy and progress of every active transaction. 



Our AI transaction coordinator, Aimee, drafts
s, creates contract packets, tracks deadlines, and updates our deal board. Your job is to review her work, correct errors, approve communications, handle human judgment, and ensure nothing important is missed. 



The standard is simple: 



Every deadline visible. Every document accurate. Every follow-up completed. Every risk escalated early. 



You must be comfortable working independently, asking precise questions, following fixed processes, and taking ownership without being chased. 



 



Core Responsibilities 



1. Transaction Management 



Manage each file from executed contract through closing, including the handling of: 



Purchase agreements and addendums 



Assignment or transaction coordination agreements 



Earnest money deposit confirmation 



Opening title and escrow  



Inspections and inspection responses 



Coordinating appraisals and lender conditions 



Insurance and underwriting requirements 



Closing statements and settlement documents 



Extensions and closing-date changes 



Final closing confirmation 



Post-closing document collection 



Own every important deadline, including: 



Inspection periods 



Earnest money deadlines 



Title commitment deadlines 



Appraisal deadlines 



Financing deadlines 



Extension deadlines 



Closing dates 



Document submission deadlines 



You are expected to identify upcoming deadlines before they become urgent. 



 



2. AI Quality Control 



You will manage and supervise Aimee, our AI transaction coordinator. 



Responsibilities include: 



Review Aimee’s
 drafts several times each business day and send them in a timely manner 



Confirm every draft is factually accurate before sending 



Correct Aimee’s mistakes and reinforce the correct rule 



Ensure one clear thread exists per deal and manage drafts or recipients on communications; condense multiple
s into one when needed  



Confirm no unauthorized promises, terms, or interpretations are included (check for AI Hallucinations) 



Monitor the TC TITANS Microsoft Teams channel 



Resolve blockers and escalate issues quickly 



Maintain consistent operating rules over time 



Aimee drafts. 



You review, approve, and send. Until you don’t and it’s automated.  



No external
 or e-signature request may be sent without proper human review. Documents also need review before sending.  



 



3. Contract Packet Quality Control 



Before any document goes for signature, confirm: 



Correct purchase agreement template is used 



Approved template language has not been changed 



Section 12.2 is removed when required 



Purchase agreement and addendum remain separate 



Seller-carry terms appear only on the approved addendum 



Required initials fields are present on every signed page 



Buyer and seller information is accurate 



Dates, prices, deposits, and deadlines match across documents 



All required parties are included 



No unauthorized LLC state information is added 



No unsupported underwriting or debt-stack numbers are inserted 



Garret has approved the packet before signature requests are sent 



You will upload documents to GoHighLevel, place signature fields, send approved documents, and confirm executed PDFs are saved correctly. 



 



4. Title, Escrow, Lender, and Closing Coordination 



Communicate professionally with: 



Title companies 



Escrow officers 



Listing agents 



Sellers 



Buyers 



Private lenders 



Mortgage lenders 



Inspectors 



Appraisers 



Wholesalers 



Closing attorneys 



You will: 



Confirm title has opened 



Confirm earnest money was received 



Track title commitments and title issues 



Coordinate wire instructions through approved channels 



Track appraisal and underwriting conditions 



Confirm insurance requirements 



Review settlement statements and HUD/ALTA documents 



Verify closing figures and transaction fees 



Coordinate extension requests 



Confirm clear-to-close status 



Follow up until closing is complete 



You will never handle client funds, provide legal advice, negotiate terms independently, or interpret law for clients. Questions involving contract changes, legal interpretation, negotiations, or licensed brokerage activity must be escalated to the appropriate U.S. team member. 



 



5. Asana, OneDrive, and Record Management 



Maintain the SELL SMART MASTER DEAL BOARD with complete accuracy. 



Every active deal must include: 



Correct deal stage 



Required subtasks 



Current status 



Next action 



Responsible party 



Due date 



Last Touch Point 



Relevant comments 



Uploaded attachments 



Client portal information 



Required task categories may include: 



EMD 



TC agreement 



Inspection 



Title 



Appraisal 



Lender 



Addendums 



Closing documents 



Buyer and seller follow-up 



TC fee collection 



You will also: 



Maintain OneDrive and SharePoint deal folders 



Use the correct folder structure 



Move folders as deals progress 



Save executed documents in the correct location 



Prevent duplicate, missing, or misplaced files 



Confirm all closing documentation is complete 



The checklist is not optional. It is how we prevent memory from becoming a business process.  



 



6. Communication and Follow-Up 



You are responsible for keeping deals moving through clear, timely communication. 



Communication standards: 



Warm, professional, and concise 



HTML format 



Arial, 11-point font 



Sell Smart signature 



Approved kickoff templates only for initial outreach 



No em dashes 



No unnecessary recipients 



Do not copy Garret on TC
s unless specifically requested 



Confirm facts before communicating them 



Document every meaningful phone call 



Leave a clear next action after each follow-up 



You must be comfortable making phone calls with agents, sellers, lenders, title companies, and buyers when
 is slowing the transaction down. 



 



Typical Daily Workflow 



Morning 



Review overnight messages and Aimee’s drafts 



Review unanswered threads and follow-ups 



Check new contract packets 



Confirm critical deadlines for the day 



Review new Asana submissions 



On Mondays, review closed-deal document follow-up 



Midday 



Review the midday deal-status flag 



Approve and send qualified communications 



Make required phone calls 



Upload approved documents to GoHighLevel 



Place signature fields 



Attach documents to Asana 



Follow up with title, lenders, buyers, and sellers 



Afternoon 



Review client portal status updates 



Clear remaining drafts 



Update deadlines and Last Touch Points 



Confirm open lender and title conditions 



Escalate any closing risk 



Verify tomorrow’s deadline calendar 



End of Day 



Review Aimee’s end-of-day report 



Confirm all open items have owners 



Confirm no deadline is unassigned 



Set priorities for the next business day 



Send a concise pipeline status report when required 



 



Required Qualifications 



Minimum 2 years of U.S. residential real estate transaction coordination experience 



English speaking with clear pronunciation of the English language 



Strong and reliable internet connection  



Proven experience managing files from contract to close 



Strong understanding of purchase agreements, addendums, escrow, title, inspections, lender conditions, and closing documents 



Experience coordinating with U.S. agents, title companies, escrow officers, lenders, buyers, and sellers 



Excellent written and spoken English 



Strong attention to detail 



Ability to manage multiple transactions simultaneously 



Demonstrated ability to meet deadlines without constant supervision 



Comfortable working Central Time zone (Chicago IL) business hours 



Strong experience with
, document management, spreadsheets, and task-management systems 



Ability to follow fixed processes exactly 



High level of integrity and discretion  



 



Preferred Qualifications 



Experience in real estate investing, wholesaling, assignments, seller financing, or subject-to transactions 



Experience with multi-state transactions 



Experience with Illinois, Tennessee, Missouri, South Carolina, North Carolina, Ohio, and other Midwest and southern USA  transactions.  



Experience with Asana, Go-High-Level, Microsoft Teams, Outlook, OneDrive, SharePoint, Earnest, Qualia, or similar systems  



Experience reviewing AI-generated work 



Real estate license or transaction coordinator certification 



Experience creating SOPs, checklists, and quality-control systems 



 



What We Are Looking For 



You are likely an excellent fit if you: 



Notice inconsistencies other people miss 



Create order without being asked 



Follow up before someone reminds you 



Can explain what is wrong and what should happen next 



Escalate early instead of hiding problems 



Stay calm when multiple deals become urgent 



Can work from a checklist without becoming robotic 



Can improve a process without changing approved rules 



Take responsibility for outcomes, not just assigned tasks 



Are comfortable saying, “I do not know yet, but I will find out”  



Remain honest under pressure  



You are not a fit if you: 



Need constant supervision 



Send messages without verifying facts 



Treat deadlines as suggestions 



Change contract language casually 



Hide mistakes 



Blame other people when a task is missed 



Cannot work within U.S. Central Time 



Prefer vague instructions and improvisation over documented systems 



Have experience only with lead generation, data entry, or general virtual assistance 



 



Success Metrics 



Your performance will be measured by: 



100% of critical deadlines tracked and assigned 



Zero missed inspection, EMD, extension, or closing deadlines 



Zero unauthorized
s or signature requests 



Same-business-day review of qualified Aimee drafts 



Accurate contract packets with no preventable errors 



Accurate and current Asana board 



Complete and organize OneDrive deal folders 



Timely escalation of title, lender, legal, and closing risks 



100% of TC fees tracked and handed off for collection 



On-time closing documentation 



Clear weekly pipeline reporting 



Consistent adherence to approved SOPs 



 



Hiring Process 



We do not hire based only on resumes or interviews. 



Stage 1: Application Review 



Submit: 



Resume 



Two-minute video introduction 



Written answers to the application questions below 



Two professional references 



Stage 2: Transaction Work Sample 



Qualified candidates will receive a fictional transaction packet containing: 



Purchase agreement 



Addendum 



Title information 



EMD instructions 



Inspection notice 



Lender
 



Closing date 



Entity information 



Within 90 minutes, you must: 



Identify missing signatures, inconsistent terms, missing deadlines, and closing risks. 



Build a deadline tracker. 



Draft an
 to title. 



Draft an
 to the lender. 



Draft an
 to the buyer or seller. 



Write an escalation memo showing what you would handle, what you would escalate to your supervisor - Garret. 



Explain your decisions during a live review. 



Do not provide legal advice. Do not rewrite the contract. We are testing accuracy, judgment, organization, communication, and escalation. 



Stage 3: Live Interview 



The live interview will focus on real transaction scenarios, including: 



A lender condition arrives one day before closing 



The EMD has not been confirmed 



A seller requests a contract change 



A title commitment contains an issue 



A buyer wants a repair credit 



A signature page is missing initials 



A closing date is approaching with no clear-to-close confirmation 



Aimee sends an inaccurate draft 



Stage 4: Reference Checks 



At least one reference must be a former manager, broker, attorney, lender, or transaction lead. 



Stage 5: Paid Trial 



The final candidate will complete a paid 3 to 5 business-day trial using fictional, limited, or low-risk workflows. 



The trial will measure: 



Deadline ownership 



Document accuracy 



Communication quality 



Speed of follow-up 



Escalation judgment 



Ability to use our systems 



Ability to supervise and correct Aimee 



Ability to work independently 



Full access to sensitive systems and live transactions will be granted only after the trial is successfully completed. 



 



Application Instructions 



Send the following here with the subject line: 



Transaction Coordinator Lead Application, [Your Name] 



Include: 



Resume 



Two-minute video answering: 



What types of U.S. real estate transactions have you coordinated? 



How many active files have you managed at once?

We look for the best candidates so we can hire the best long-term team members. Please consider the hiring process as your qualification to then be tested on our team rather than considering the hiring process as the test to be on our team.

title: Personal Injury Claims Specialist
description:
Company

The Chiro Place of Collierville PLLC 



Position Summary

The Personal Injury Claims Specialist manages billing and accounts receivable for chiropractic patients receiving care after motor vehicle a
 or other injuries. This role handles Medical Payments (MedPay), Personal Injury Protection (PIP), third-party auto liability, and attorney-represented accounts from intake through payment and account resolution.



The specialist works with chiropractic offices, insurance adjusters, and law firms to verify claim information, submit complete billing packets, follow up on outstanding balances, and document every action in ChiroTouch and the claims tracker.

Key Responsibilities

- Verify claim information. Confirm the date of loss, claim number, insurance carrier, adjuster contact information, billing instructions, and attorney representation. Verify applicable coverage, available benefits, and limits with the carrier.

- Prepare and submit billing packets. Review dates of service, charges, and supporting documentation for completeness. Submit CMS-1500 claim forms, itemized statements, and authorized medical records as required. Confirm receipt and address missing documentation or submission errors.

- Manage outstanding claims. Follow the company’s account-specific follow-up schedules for MedPay, PIP, third-party liability, and attorney accounts. Record each contact, the current claim status, payment or settlement updates, and the next follow-up date.

- Track and reconcile payments. Verify whether checks were issued, received, and posted to the correct patient ledger. Research missing, delayed, partial, or misapplied payments and request reissues when appropriate.

- Resolve billing issues. Investigate denials, underpayments, and requests for additional information. Coordinate corrections and resubmissions with the billing team. Escalate disputed balances, coverage concerns, and accounts approaching filing deadlines.

- Handle attorney and adjuster correspondence. Provide authorized bills and records, confirm receipt, and request case updates as appropriate. Route reduction requests to management for review and document the approved outcome.

- Maintain accurate records and reporting. Keep ChiroTouch and the claims tracker current. Complete daily activity logs and weekly reports covering collections, aged balances, pending payments, and accounts requiring management attention.

- Protect patient information. Follow company privacy procedures and verify authorization before releasing patient records or billing information.

Qualifications

- Experience in medical billing, insurance claims follow-up, or healthcare accounts receivable.

- Working knowledge of auto injury claims, including MedPay, PIP, third-party liability, and attorney-represented accounts.

- Familiarity with CMS-1500 forms, itemized statements, patient ledgers, and payment reconciliation.

- Strong written and verbal communication skills for working with adjusters, law firms, and clinic staff.

- Ability to prioritize aged claims, meet deadlines, and maintain accurate records across multiple clinics.

- Chiropractic billing experience and proficiency with ChiroTouch and Google Sheets preferred.

Performance Expectations

Success in this role is measured by timely follow-up, accurate claim documentation and payment posting, prompt escalation of unresolved issues, and consistent progress on aged receivables.

title: Moodle LMS Developer
description:
Job Type: Full-Time, Long-Term Remote

Schedule: 7–8 hours/day, 5 days/week

Working Hours: 10:00 AM to 6:00 PM Toronto Time (Eastern Time)

Compensation: CAD $4/hour

Probation Period: 1.5 months

Work Location: Remote

Hiring: Immediate



Job Description



Springfield College is seeking an experienced and reliable Moodle LMS Developer to lead the migration of our existing Learning Management System (LMS) from Classe365 to Moodle.



The primary focus of this position is to successfully migrate our existing courses, learning materials, student records, and relevant LMS data while establishing a fully functional, organized, and user-friendly Moodle environment.



The successful candidate will also be responsible for customizing Moodle's interface to closely replicate the structure, navigation, and user experience of our existing Classe365 platform, while incorporating Springfield College's branding and academic requirements.



This is a long-term remote position involving LMS migration, Moodle development, configuration, troubleshooting, and ongoing technical support. We are looking for someone who can independently manage technical tasks, solve migration challenges, and ensure a smooth transition with minimal disruption to academic operations.



Key Responsibilities



1. Classe365 to Moodle Migration



Assess the existing Classe365 LMS, including its course structures, user records, learning materials, and administrative configurations.



Develop and execute a structured migration plan from Classe365 to Moodle.



Extract, transfer, and import existing courses, course content, student and instructor records, enrolments, and other available LMS data.



Preserve course organization, learning resources, assessments, and student progress records wherever technically feasible.



Identify and resolve data compatibility, import, export, and migration issues.



Verify migrated information for accuracy, completeness, and proper functionality.



2. Moodle LMS Development & Configuration



Install, configure, customize, and maintain the Moodle LMS environment.



Recreate existing course structures, categories, modules, and learning pathways within Moodle.



Configure user accounts, roles, permissions, enrolment methods, grading systems, assessments, and course completion tracking.



Develop or modify Moodle functionality to meet the college's academic and administrative requirements.



Ensure the new Moodle environment operates reliably and efficiently.



3. Moodle Theme & Interface Customization



Develop or customize a Moodle theme to closely match the existing Classe365 user interface and experience.



Customize the homepage, student and instructor dashboards, course pages, login page, navigation, and other interface components.



Incorporate Springfield College's branding, logo, colours, and design guidelines.



Ensure a modern, responsive, accessible, and user-friendly experience across desktop, tablet, and mobile devices.



Implement interface improvements and revisions based on feedback from the college team.



4. Plugin Configuration & System Integrations



Research, install, configure, and customize Moodle plugins based on academic and operational requirements.



Modify existing plugins or develop custom functionality where necessary.



Configure integrations with external platforms, including WordPress, Zoom, Microsoft Teams, and other relevant services when required.



Support automated student account creation, enrolment, notifications, and administrative workflows.



Troubleshoot plugin conflicts, integration issues, and compatibility problems.



5. Testing, Documentation & Ongoing Support



Thoroughly test migrated courses, user accounts, enrolments, learning resources, and LMS functionality.



Identify and resolve errors, missing data, broken links, layout issues, and configuration problems.



Validate that the new Moodle environment meets the college's academic and administrative requirements before deployment.



Document migration procedures, customizations, configurations, and technical resolutions.



Assist college staff with Moodle course creation, content management, and system administration.



Provide ongoing technical support, maintenance, and improvements following the migration.



Required Skills & Experience



Demonstrated experience in Moodle LMS development, administration, configuration, theme customization, and plugin implementation.



Experience with LMS migrations, course content transfers, data imports/exports, and database management.



Strong working knowledge of PHP, HTML, CSS/SCSS, JavaScript, and SQL/MySQL.



Familiarity with Moodle's architecture, database structure, APIs, themes, and plugins.



Understanding of LMS course structures, assessments, user accounts, enrolments, grading, and progress tracking.



Ability to troubleshoot data migration issues and ensure data accuracy and integrity.



Experience creating responsive and accessible LMS interfaces.



Strong problem-solving, organizational, documentation, and communication skills.



Ability to work independently, coordinate with stakeholders, and meet agreed deadlines.



Additional Experience Considered an Asset:



Previous experience with Classe365 or migrations from similar LMS platforms.



Experience working with REST APIs and third-party LMS integrations.



Experience with Moodle course backups, restores, and bulk user imports.



Experience integrating Moodle with WordPress, Zoom, or Microsoft Teams.



Previous experience working with colleges, universities, or other educational institutions.



Application Requirements



Applicants must provide the following:



Resume: An up-to-date resume outlining relevant technical experience and qualifications.



Portfolio (Mandatory): Examples of Moodle websites, themes, plugins, or LMS migration projects you have worked on, including a brief explanation of your contributions.



Video Introduction (Mandatory): A short video introducing yourself and describing your relevant Moodle development and LMS migration experience.



Availability Confirmation: Confirmation that you can work 8 hours per day, 5 days per week, from 10:00 AM to 6:00 PM Toronto time.



Compensation Confirmation: Confirmation that you accept the starting rate of CAD $4/hour and the 1.5-month probation period.



Interview Contact: An active
 address for scheduling a Zoom or Microsoft Teams interview.



Important: Applications without a resume, relevant Moodle portfolio, and short video introduction will not be considered.



We are looking to hire immediately and are seeking a dependable developer who can contribute to the successful migration from Classe365 to Moodle and support the college's LMS development and maintenance over the long term.

title: Experienced Real Estate Assistant
description:
This Is Not a Basic Data-Entry Position



Just the Best Property Group is looking for a highly reliable, resourceful, and detail-oriented Virtual Assistant who can help keep our leads, clients, agents, transactions, and business systems moving forward. We are a growing company, and this role is intended to grow with the right person. A team member who consistently demonstrates reliability, initiative, sound judgment, and strong results can earn greater responsibility, increased compensation, performance bonuses, and the opportunity to develop into a higher-level operations or leadership role as the company expands.



We are not looking for someone who waits to be reminded, disappears when a task becomes difficult, or marks work complete without confirming the result. We need someone who communicates early, follows through consistently, and takes ownership from assignment through completion. The right person has a determined-to-learn attitude. You may not know every answer on day one, but you know how to research using Google, YouTube, help centers, training resources, and other available tools. You ask thoughtful questions after first making a reasonable effort to solve the problem. You can think quickly and adapt when plans change, while still valuing structured systems, checklists, and consistency. You are optimistic, coachable, and comfortable with accountability because you see it as a tool for growth and excellent performance. You communicate clearly about your progress, questions, needs, deadlines, and mistakes.



At your core, you lead by serving. You are willing to encourage and support others, and you understand that greater opportunities are earned through contribution, reliability, sound judgment, and results.



What Success Looks Like

In this role, you will:

• Complete commitments accurately and on time without repeated reminders.

• Keep Alex and the team informed before a deadline is at risk—not afterward.

• Maintain accurate CRM records so every lead has a clear status, notes, and next action.

• Follow up consistently so qualified opportunities do not fall through the cracks.

• Learn unfamiliar tools and processes independently, then document what you learned.

• Catch missing information, inconsistencies, and unfinished work before they become problems.

• Bring possible solutions when raising an issue.

• Protect confidential client, financial, and transaction information.



Core Responsibilities

1. CRM and Database Management

• Maintain a large and frequently changing client and prospect database in Brivity or a future CRM.

• Keep records, stages, tags, notes, tasks, and next-follow-up dates accurate and current.

• Identify duplicate, incomplete, stale, or incorrectly categorized records.

• Import, export, clean, organize, and validate CSV and Excel files without losing or corrupting data.



2. Lead Follow-Up and Communication

• Contact prospective and current clients by phone, text, and
.

• Use approved scripts, thoughtful questions, active listening, and motivational interviewing principles to qualify leads and move them through the pipeline.

• Maintain proactive short- and long-term follow-up so no viable lead is forgotten.

• Communicate warmly and professionally both on and off the phone.

• Accurately document every meaningful interaction and next step in the CRM.



3. Team Leader and Executive Support

• Learn Alex’s schedule, priorities, communication preferences, and work style.

• Take clear, concise meeting notes and convert decisions into assigned action items with deadlines.

• Manage, delegate, or minimize distractions that interfere with the team’s highest-value priorities.

• Monitor commitments and follow up with the appropriate person until each item is resolved.

• Prepare Alex for meetings and regularly scheduled Zoom calls.



4. Systems and Process Implementation

• Help build, implement, and improve processes for buyers, sellers, lead generation, database management, transaction support, and team operations.

• Use checklists, templates, automations, and quality-control steps to make work more consistent.

• Notice breakdowns and recommend practical improvements.



5. Operations Manual Management

• Create and maintain a clear, usable operations manual.

• Document workflows, responsibilities, scripts, templates, standards, and step-by-step procedures.

• Update documentation when a process changes rather than allowing instructions to become outdated.



6. Tracking and Reporting

• Track and report key activities and results, including calls, conversations, appointments, leads generated, contracts, closings, and follow-up completion.

• Build and maintain organized Google Sheets and Excel trackers.

• Use formulas, filters, lookups, conditional formatting, multiple-sheet references, and basic data analysis—not only data entry.

• Review reports for missing or inconsistent data and explain what the numbers indicate.



7. Agent and Client Support

• Assist multiple agents with contact management, client inquiries, appointment scheduling, reminders, and follow-up systems.

• Keep requests organized by priority and deadline.

• Provide professional, service-oriented communication while maintaining appropriate boundaries and confidentiality.



8. Marketing Support

• Assist with newsletters, follow-up campaigns, items of value, MOFIRs, and other
 marketing through platforms such as Flodesk or Mailchimp.

• Coordinate and, when needed, create social media posts and simple videos using Canva and CapCut.

• Proofread content, check links and details, schedule approved materials, and confirm successful publication or delivery.



9. Transaction Coordination Support

• Help track pending transactions from contract through closing.

• Monitor dates, documents, signatures, contingencies, and outstanding action items.

• Communicate professionally with agents, clients, lenders, attorneys, inspectors, vendors, and other parties as directed.

• Handle confidential documents and information carefully.



10. Client Event Coordination

• Assist with planning and executing client events.

• Research and communicate with venues and vendors, manage invitation lists and RSVPs, organize timelines, and track details through completion.



Non-Negotiable Qualifications

• A demonstrated record of excellent reliability, attendance, and follow-through in remote work.

• Strong spoken and written English suitable for professional client communication.

• Confidence making and receiving phone calls with U.S.-based prospects and clients.

• Strong attention to detail and the habit of checking work before submission.

• Ability to prioritize multiple assignments, maintain task lists, and meet deadlines without constant supervision.

• Intermediate or advanced Google Sheets and Excel skills, including formulas and working across multiple sheets.

• A dependable computer, stable high-speed internet, professional headset, quiet work environment, and a realistic backup plan for power or internet interruptions.

• Experience managing a CRM or another complex database.

• Strong research and problem-solving ability.

• Ability to learn software quickly and document repeatable processes.

• Consistent availability during the agreed schedule and for regular Zoom meetings.



Strongly Preferred

• Experience supporting a U.S. real estate agent, team, brokerage, or transaction coordinator.

• Experience with Brivity or a comparable real estate CRM.

• Experience with lead follow-up, inside sales, appointment setting, or client care.

• Experience with Google Workspace, Microsoft Excel, Canva, CapCut, Flodesk, Mailchimp, and task-management tools.

• Experience creating SOPs, maintaining operations manuals, or producing KPI reports.

• Familiarity with U.S. real estate transactions, terminology, and deadlines.



This Role Is Probably Not a Fit If You

• Frequently miss shifts, meetings, or deadlines.

• Need repeated reminders to complete routine responsibilities.

• Avoid phone calls or are uncomfortable initiating follow-up.

• Stop when instructions are incomplete instead of researching, thinking, and asking a focused question.

• Hide mistakes, delays, or uncertainty.

• Submit work without checking its accuracy or confirming that the intended result occurred.

• Are balancing another full-time job during the hours committed to this role.



How to Apply

Please follow every instruction below. Applications that omit a required item will not move forward.

1. Begin your application with the exact phrase: BEST — [Your Full Name].

2. Write 5–8 sentences explaining why this specific position fits your experience and working style.  Do not send a generic cover letter.  

3. State the U.S. Eastern Time hours you can work and describe your power and internet backup plans for when it may go out.

4. Include a link to a 60–90 second video introduction. 

Answer these questions:

• Describe what you're looking for in a role? Are you looking for full time, part time, long term etc.

• Rate your Excel/Google Sheets ability from 1–10 and your favorite features.

• Describe your experience with CRMs, lead follow-up whether through phones or other means, real estate transactions, SOPs, and reporting. Be specific about your responsibilities.



7. Include one redacted work sample that demonstrates organization or technical skill, such as a spreadsheet, KPI report, SOP, CRM workflow, project tracker, or marketing calendar. Remove all confidential information.



8. Provide the names, positions, and contact information of two recent professional references who directly supervised your work. References will be contacted only for finalists. Finalists should expect at least 2 rounds of live interviews. Employment will begin with a structured introductory period with clear expectations for attendance, communication, accuracy, learning, and completed results.



We are looking for a long-term team member who wants to grow through meaningful responsibility. This is an opportunity to join a growing company where successful performance can lead to expanded leadership roles, income and professional development, and advancement. Salary is starting salary, increases and Bonuses are incorporated and performance based. If you are dependable, thoughtful, highly organized, comfortable with accountability, and determined to find solutions, we would like to hear from you.

title: Follow-Up Specialist (Real Estate)
description:
We're Hiring: Follow-Up Specialist (Real Estate)

Location: Remote

Employment Type: Full-Time

Industry: Real Estate / Cash Home Buying



About the Role

We're looking for a highly organized, persistent, and relationship-driven Follow-Up Specialist to manage and nurture inbound seller leads.



In this role, you'll take ownership of the lead follow-up process, ensuring every inquiry receives timely attention and no potential opportunity gets lost in the pipeline.



You'll serve as the bridge between inbound leads and the acquisitions team, building meaningful connections with prospective sellers through consistent, personalized, and empathetic communication.



This position is ideal for someone who enjoys talking to people, thrives in a high-volume environment, and understands that successful follow-up requires both persistence and genuine relationship-building.

Key Responsibilities

1. New Lead Response & Management

- Contact every new inbound lead within 10 minutes of receiving an inquiry, primarily through phone calls.

- Make multiple contact attempts throughout the day for leads that have not yet been reached.

- Prioritize new inquiries to ensure timely engagement and prevent missed opportunities.

- Record all calls, conversations, and follow-up activities in the CRM.

2. Daily Lead Follow-Up & Campaign Management

- Work through prioritized lead lists daily, following the established urgency and contact cadence.

- Maintain consistent follow-up schedules across different lead stages:

  - Recent leads (0–7 days): 3–5 contact attempts per week.

  - Leads (8–30 days): 2–3 contact attempts per week.

  - Older leads (1–6 months and 6+ months): Maintain regular follow-up campaigns.

- Review and work through missed follow-up tasks at least once every two weeks.

- Alternate between dialer campaigns and click-to-call strategies to maximize contact and answer rates.

3. Relationship Building & Communication

title: Amazon Virtual Assistant – Inventory & Account Monitoring Specialist
description:
Job Title: Amazon Virtual Assistant – Inventory & Account Monitoring Specialist



Employment Type: Full-Time  

Work Setup: Remote  

Schedule: 9:00 PM – 6:00 AM Philippine Time  

Department: E-commerce / Amazon Operations



Job Overview:



We are looking for a detail-oriented and reliable Amazon Virtual Assistant to support our e-commerce operations, particularly in inventory monitoring, removal order tracking, customer review monitoring, and product performance reporting.



The ideal candidate must have hands-on experience with Amazon Seller Central, strong analytical skills, excellent attention to detail, and the ability to follow established Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs).



Experience with Walmart Seller Center is also a plus. Applicants who have experience managing both Amazon and Walmart accounts are highly encouraged to apply.



This role requires someone who can accurately collect, verify, organize, and report marketplace data while identifying discrepancies and escalating potential issues to management.



Key Responsibilities:



1. Amazon Customer Review Monitoring

- Monitor customer reviews across assigned Amazon ASINs.

- Review and classify customer feedback, particularly new 1-star and 2-star reviews.

- Identify potential violations of Amazon Community Guidelines and Customer Review Policies.

- Collect screenshots and supporting evidence for qualifying policy violations.

- Report reviews through Amazon-approved reporting channels when justified.

- Contact Amazon Community Help when appropriate and follow up on reported cases.

- Monitor cases and escalate to Seller Support if no response is received within 48 hours.

- Maintain an accurate review reporting and removal tracking log.

- Route legitimate product complaints and recurring feedback to the appropriate team.



2. Amazon Removal Order Tracking

- Generate and review Amazon Removal Order Detail reports covering the last 365 days.

- Identify removal orders and review all shipped units.

- Record tracking numbers, shipment dates, product details, Ionic colors, and bundle quantities.

- Update the Removal Google Sheet with accurate shipment information.

- Monitor UPS and other carrier tracking statuses.

- Update shipments as IN TRANSIT or DELIVERED.

- Notify the assigned team member when shipments are delivered.

- Reconcile expected versus received quantities.

- Identify missing or incorrect units and prepare supporting evidence.

- Open Amazon Support cases for confirmed removal shipment shortages.

- Create and monitor ClickUp tasks until each issue is resolved.



3. Amazon FBA Inventory Monitoring and Reporting

- Generate Amazon Inventory Ledger Reports through Seller Central.

- Configure reports using the correct date range, summary view, country-level aggregation, and daily reporting.

- Download and analyze CSV inventory reports.

- Filter inventory by SELLABLE disposition.

- Organize inventory data by ASIN and date.

- Calculate total packs and individual physical units using the correct product multipliers.

- Identify and consolidate multiple active SKUs under the same ASIN when applicable.

- Update the Master Inventory Tracker accurately.

- Verify category subtotals and grand totals.

- Identify and explain inventory fluctuations caused by inbound shipments, FC transfers, and customer returns.



4. Amazon Ionic Inventory Reconciliation

- Monitor all assigned Ionic products and variations across Amazon listings.

- Check every relevant ASIN and SKU, including Black, Blue, Green, and other Ionic variations.

- Record inventory quantities across relevant Amazon inventory statuses.

- Calculate the total number of individual Ionic pieces currently held by Amazon.

- Ensure bundle quantities are converted into individual units correctly.

- Double-check all figures and identify missing or duplicated listings.

- Prepare accurate inventory breakdowns and final reports for management.



5. Amazon Best Sellers Rank (BSR) Monitoring

- Monitor all assigned Ionic Black Amazon listings daily.

- Record main category and subcategory BSR rankings.

- Update the shared BSR tracking Google Sheet.

- Maintain consistent daily reporting before the required deadline.

- Monitor ranking trends and identify significant changes.

- Immediately escalate any listing that drops more than 5,000 BSR positions within one day.

- Include previous versus current rankings and relevant observations in escalation reports.



6. Walmart Marketplace Support (Plus)

- Assist with Walmart Seller Center monitoring and account management when assigned.

- Monitor Walmart inventory levels and product availability.

- Assist with order and fulfillment monitoring.

- Help identify inventory discrepancies and account-related issues.

- Maintain accurate tracking sheets and marketplace reports.

- Escalate account or operational issues to management.



7. Reporting and Administrative Responsibilities

- Maintain accurate Google Sheets and tracking logs.

- Document all completed actions, findings, and unresolved issues.

- Provide clear and timely updates to management.

- Create and monitor ClickUp tasks for pending issues and escalations.

- Follow established company SOPs and reporting deadlines.

- Coordinate with the appropriate teams when discrepancies or operational issues arise.



Qualifications and Requirements



- Previous experience working as an Amazon Virtual Assistant.

- Hands-on experience with Amazon Seller Central.

- Knowledge of FBA inventory management and reporting.

- Experience handling removal orders and shipment tracking.

- Familiarity with Amazon customer review policies and reporting procedures.

- Experience with Google Sheets, Excel, and data reconciliation.

- Familiarity with ClickUp or other project management tools.

- Strong attention to detail and numerical accuracy.

- Excellent written English communication skills.

- Ability to follow detailed SOPs independently.

- Strong organizational and problem-solving skills.

- Ability to identify discrepancies and escalate issues promptly.

- Reliable internet connection and a dedicated work setup.



Preferred Qualifications



- Experience managing multiple Amazon ASINs and SKUs.

- Knowledge of Amazon FBA inventory reconciliation.

- Experience handling Amazon Seller Support cases.

- Familiarity with inventory tracking and reporting systems.

- Experience working with US-based e-commerce brands.

- Experience with Walmart Seller Center, including inventory management, order monitoring, and reporting, is a plus.

- Applicants with experience managing both Amazon and Walmart accounts are highly encouraged to apply.



Working Schedule:



- Full-time position.

- 9:00 PM – 6:00 AM Philippine Time.

- 5 days per week.

- Must be available during the required working hours.



Performance Expectations (KPIs)



Performance will be evaluated based on:



- Accuracy and completeness of inventory reports.

- Timeliness of daily BSR monitoring.

- Accuracy of removal order and tracking records.

- Proper documentation of customer review policy concerns.

- Timely reporting and escalation of inventory discrepancies.

- Compliance with established SOPs.

- Consistency and reliability in completing assigned tasks.



How to Apply:



Interested applicants should submit:



1. An updated resume highlighting relevant Amazon experience.

2. A brief summary of their experience with Amazon Seller Central.

3. Examples of previous inventory monitoring, removal order tracking, or reporting tasks they have handled.

4. Details of any previous experience with Walmart Seller Center, if applicable.

5. A short Loom video introducing themselves and explaining their relevant Amazon and/or Walmart VA experience.



Important: We are looking for someone with actual hands-on marketplace experience who can independently handle data verification, inventory monitoring, reporting, and operational follow-ups. Amazon experience is required, while Walmart experience is an advantage.

title: Long-Term Growth Partner: Meta Ads + GoHighLevel for a Trading Education Company
description:
I run a trading education company. Leads come in from Meta ads, go into GoHighLevel, and turn into booked sales calls with our team.



I'm not hiring a vendor. I'm looking for a long-term growth partner. Someone I can call when something's off and think it through with, and who grows with the company. I'm not at the point where I've got 30 people each covering one lane, so I need someone who can wear more than one hat.



I move fast. You need to as well.



Read this whole post before you apply. It sets the standard, and your answers to the questions below are what I d
 on.



WHAT YOU'D OWN



Phase 1, from day one:

- Meta lead gen, end to end. Strategy, structure, launches, testing, and day-to-day management.

- Ad creative. You write the hooks and scripts and tell us what to shoot. We film and edit.

- Getting ads approved in a tough category. Aggressive is fine, dishonest isn't. Nothing that puts the Business Manager at risk.

- Tracking. Pixel and Conversions API set up right, with qualified-lead and booked-call events sent back from GHL so Meta optimizes for real prospects, not cheap form fills.

- GoHighLevel. Building and fixing workflows, pipelines and automations yourself.

- The systems around the calls. Speed to lead, confirmations, reminders, show rate, and finding where leads drop off between click and close.

- A short weekly update. What you changed, what happened, what's next.



Phase 2, once the ads are running and optimized:

Your time shifts. You help me in other areas of the business: the CRM, hiring and onboarding salespeople, and anywhere else growth needs it. Everything except fulfillment.



Whoever this is gets the chance to scale with the company.



WHO THIS IS FOR

- You've personally run Meta lead gen where the goal was booked calls.

- You build in GHL yourself. Not "familiar with it."

- You do the work yourself. No agency, no juniors, no hand-offs.

- You're open to a long-term commitment.

- You reply same day and can work Eastern hours.

- You're direct. You'll tell me when I'm wrong and own it when you are.

- You care about how the business grows, not just your piece of it.



THIS ISN'T FOR YOU IF

- You only do ads or only do GHL. This needs both, hands-on.

- You're an agency or juggling a lot of active clients.

- You send copy-paste applications. If your answer could go to any job, I'll skip it.



PAY

$1,000/month fixed. This is the real budget, not a placeholder. If $1,000 doesn't work for you, don't apply.



After a couple of months working together and hitting revenue milestones, I'm open to adding a percentage on top.



HOW TO APPLY

Start your application with the word "Partner" so I know you read this. Then answer every question below in writing, in your own words. "Let's discuss on a call" counts as no answer. A video link alone isn't an answer. Keep it short and specific. Real numbers and real examples beat long lists.



1. This is $1,000/month fixed, and the role grows past ads over time. Does that work for you, and why do you want this?

2. How many active clients or jobs do you have right now (give a number)? What hours do you work in Eastern time?

3. Walk me through a GHL workflow you built yourself: what triggered it, what it did, and what broke the first time.

4. Leads are fine but booked calls are low. What do you optimize the campaign for, and how do you get that event from GHL back to Meta?

5. Have you run ads in finance, trading, or another restricted category? What got rejected or restricted, and how did you get it running?

6. Tell me about a call you made on an ad account that turned out wrong. What did you do about it?



WHAT HAPPENS NEXT

- If your application fits, I'll reply here with a few follow-up questions. If it takes you more than a day to reply while we're talking, I'll assume that's how you'd work.

- Then a video call where you screen-share a GHL build you made and an ad account you run.

- Then we start.

title: Virtual Assistant – Admin + Sales Support for Physical Therapy Practice | Short-Term Coverage | PH-Based
description:
Location: Remote (Philippines-based only)

Schedule & Coverage Dates Needed:

Training: December 16 – 18 (4 hours each day)

Active Coverage: December 28, 29, and 30 | 9:00 AM – 3:00 PM Mountain Time (MT)

Compensation: $7 – $9 USD/hour (based on experience)

Type: \Short-Term Contract



About the practice

Our client is a specialty physical therapy clinic in the United States. It is a cash-based practice: it does not contract with insurance companies, its prices are fixed, and it does not discount. Its therapists are specialists, and patients pay up front because they come for fast, lasting results. The clinic aims to get people out of pain in fewer visits than traditional physical therapy, which also saves patients time away from work and family.

The care is hands-on. Most callers fall into three groups:

• Chronic pain: neck and back pain, stiffness, headaches and migraines. Many callers have lived with pain for years, have tried other physical therapy without results, and some can no longer work or leave the house.

• Pregnancy and postpartum: women who want care during or after pregnancy.

• Athletes: people who want to move and perform better.

The first phone call matters a great deal at this clinic. The people calling are often in real pain and unsure whether anyone can help, so the way we speak to them shapes whether they take the next step.

You would work alongside the clinic's therapists and its small team, which includes a manager, finance, marketing and social media.



The role

We are looking for a Philippines-based Virtual Assistant to cover the front desk for a short, fixed period. You will be the first voice patients hear.

What you will do:

• Answer incoming calls and respond to text messages and
s.

• Check the fax inbox (fax-to
), review doctors' referrals, and call the patients on them to get them booked.

• Make outbound calls and texts to book and follow up with new and returning patients.

• Keep the therapists' schedules accurate and handle reschedules.

• Follow the practice's existing call script, and explain how the clinic works, including that it is cash-based and hands-on.

• Pass anything clinical to the therapists. You do not give medical advice.

• Coordinate with the clinic team when you need an answer, a decision or a handoff.

Tools: Google Workspace, an EMR, and fax-to
. Medical or physical therapy experience is preferred.

Schedule (all dates are required):

• Paid training: Wednesday to Friday, December 16–18, 4 hours each day. [Start time to be confirmed.]

• Active coverage: Monday to Wednesday, December 28–30, 9:00 AM to 3:00 PM Mountain Time. That is midnight to 6:00 AM Philippine time.

Pay: $7–$9 per hour, depending on experience. This is a temporary role.



What we are looking for

1. Warm, compassionate phone presence. You speak to people who are in pain, sometimes after years of it. You are friendly and patient, you listen first, and you show that you understand what they are going through before you talk about booking.

2. Honest, confident handling of price hesitation. The clinic is cash-based and does not discount, so callers will sometimes say it costs more than they expected, ask why the clinic does not take insurance, or say they need to think about it. You stay on the call and help them see the value: faster results, fewer visits, and less time away from work and family. You do this with warmth and confidence, never pressure. You do not offer discounts or payment plans, ask callers what they can afford, or guess at a price. If you do not know something, you say you will confirm it and set a next step.

3. Comfort working with a team, not just patients. Even for a few days, you will communicate with several people at the clinic, including therapists, the manager and the rest of the team. You communicate clearly, take direction from more than one person, and know when to pass something on. Experience coordinating with several stakeholders, or acting as a lead or point person, is a strong plus.

4. Reliability for an overnight, short-term role. You can commit to every training and coverage date, work the overnight Philippine hours, and have a backup plan for power and internet.

Preferred: medical or physical therapy front-desk experience, experience with cash-pay or self-pay patients, EMR experience, and comfort with fax-to
 and Google Workspace.



How to apply

Send all three of the following. 

1.  Your resume. A link or attachment.

2.  Your availability. Confirm in your own words that you can attend all three training days (December 16–18) and all three coverage days (December 28–30, 9:00 AM to 3:00 PM Mountain Time, which is midnight to 6:00 AM Philippine time). Mention any other job or commitment that could overlap, and what you would use as backup for power and internet.

3.  A 1–2 minute voice recording. Record yourself answering this call in your own words, without reading from a script or AI:

"A caller has been in pain for years and has already tried other physical therapy. She says, 'I'd rather use my insurance. Why don't you take it? I'm not sure I can afford this. I need to think about it.' The clinic is cash-based, does not take insurance and does not discount. What do you say?"

We are listening for warmth, honesty and confidence, a clear explanation of the value without pressure, and a next step for the caller. Do not make up prices, and do not give medical advice.
